Babylonia is the hostile aggressor, rated 1.31, many armies near me (ekallatum, susa, sippar, ur). T2: Ubaru c18 sent to Mitanni with the joint Ekallatum proposal, due home about T4. c10 in Hatti with alliance proposal, home about T5. T3: nineveh->arbela, raise army in nineveh, Pirissi sent to Babylonia with a non-aggression offer. Plan: hold ashur, arbela, nineveh with 3 armies; retake Ekallatum with Mitanni support; seek allies against Babylonia (Egypt, Hatti, Arzawa); buy free cities when gold allows. Gold counts 1:1 in strength. Watch cash: wages plus 3 armies exceed income.

ledger.entry: T3: Pirissi told me Burna-Buriash holds Ekallatum as settled, makes no promise on Susa/Mari, will send his own envoy. They took Susa T2. T3: sent Pirissi offering mutual non-aggression on present borders (no tablet, no gold). Private: a pause only; I intend to retake Ekallatum later.

orders.letter: Brother of Arzawa, Egypt wishes your household, sons, chariots and country well. The fathers kept peace and trade between our lands, and I would keep it so. Egypt looks to the Levant and the Nile, not to the western sea. Let us seal a short tablet of peace and free passage for our envoys, and send your envoys to me often.
orders.mandate: May agree to a tablet of peace and free passage between Egypt and Arzawa and to an exchange of envoys. No gold, no troops, no promise about any third land. Do not speak of Alashiya or of my fleets.

proposal.text: Between Arzawa and Egypt there is brotherhood and peace. Neither shall march troops into the other's homeland, and their envoys shall pass freely.

value.notes: T3 plan. Bounce at tamassos T2 (Alashiya fleet enkomi->tamassos met mine, 1v1). Alashiya fleet still in enkomi, tamassos empty; Alashiya also holds amurru (walls, bought). T3: F1 greatgreen->tamassos again (if they hold I get it; if they move in too we bounce, they may raise a unit in tamassos). F2 delta->levantsea (adjacent to enkomi, I can then see enkomi). New fleet F3 raised in delta. Army gaza->megiddo, sinai supports (2 v walls 1). Bought damascus (250) because buying a city is strength-neutral and gives yield/season (10% return), and nobody else borders it but Babylonia via mari. Old T4 schedule was illegal (greatgreen not adjacent to enkomi) so cancelled. WAKE T4: if F1 holds tamassos then F2 levantsea->enkomi with F1 supporting from tamassos (2 v 1) takes enkomi. If F1 bounced, F3 delta->greatgreen, then F1 tamassos supported from cilicia/greatgreen. Later: byblos by two fleets (levantsea->byblos + syriansea support) or buy (300), qadesh/amurru. Sent c16 to Arzawa with peace tablet (no gold, no secrets: did NOT mention Alashiya). c1 (Hatti) and c2 (Mitanni) due home about T5. Capital akhetaten, memphis, thebes have no troops: watch delta/sinai for landings. Treasury after orders about 42; next-season income about 255-280 vs upkeep 165 plus wages 18. Do not trust anyone; Babylonia sealed brotherhood only, no gold promised beyond 'in measure with what you send'.
value.summary: Egypt (Napkhururiya, capital akhetaten). Goal: highest growth ratio. T1: armies memphis->sinai, akhetaten->memphis, fleet delta->greatgreen, new fleet in delta, bought Tyre (250), c1 sent to Hatti (Levant division tablet offer) and c2 to Mitanni (non-aggression offer), both due home ~T5. T2: took Gaza by force (walls fell), F1 failed to take Tamassos (bounced by Alashiya fleet from Enkomi); gave Alashiya envoy warm words only, no seal/gold; hired c16 Pihhuniya (physician of Kanesh, 18/season). T3: sealed brotherhood/peace tablet k14 with Babylonia (envoy Piyamaradu), no gold; they asked for gifts and I promised 'in measure with what you send'. Standings T3: Babylonia 1.31 (took susa, ekallatum), Arzawa 1.25 (took lukka), Alashiya 1.24 (holds amurru), Egypt 1.09-1.24, Hatti 1.00, Mitanni 1.00, Assyria 0.81. Strategy: take Alashiya (tamassos 40, enkomi 45) with fleets (strength 2 = move + support), megiddo by army, buy free cities with spare gold (10 x yield, strength neutral, yields income), then byblos/qadesh/amurru. Bought walled cities cannot hold my troops. Treat all kings as untrustworthy; sealed tablets bind nobody. Interior (memphis, akhetaten, thebes) has no troops.

ledger.entry: T3: sent c16 with peace tablet offer (no troops into each other's homeland, envoys pass freely). No gold. Nothing sealed yet. Arzawa took Lukka T2.

orders.letter: Brother Tushratta, Burna-Buriash greets you and your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. Your word of friendship pleased me and the sealed tablet is home. On the Assyrian border: an army of Assyria stands at Ashur, another moved from Nineveh toward Arbela and was turned back, and Arbela itself stood empty. I hold Ekallatum and Susa. Assyria has struck us both, brother, so let us settle their country plainly and never quarrel over it: Nineveh to you, whose Taidu lies beside it, and Arbela and Ashur to me, whose armies lie beside them. Let neither of us make peace with Assyria without the other, and let the roads between us stay open. Mari, which lies between your Terqa and my Sippar, I take for the safety of both our roads.
orders.mandate: May seal the tablet dividing Assyria: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash, no separate peace with Assyria, open roads between us. May NOT give up Ashur, Arbela, Ekallatum, Susa or Mari, may NOT promise gold or troops, and may not agree to any other change without returning to me.

proposal.text: Brotherhood and peace stand between Karduniash and Mitanni as sealed before: neither king sends troops into the homeland of the other, and their envoys pass freely. The land of Assyria shall be shared thus: Nineveh to Mitanni; Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash. Neither king shall make peace with Assyria without the other.

value.notes: T3 orders: ekallatum->mari with sippar support (strength 2 vs walls 1; support at sippar cannot be cut, Mitanni terqa->mari is only 1). durkurigalzu->ekallatum to refill it (bounces harmlessly if ashur also enters; province stays mine). susa->arbela alone as a free roll (arbela is empty; if nineveh also enters it bounces and I stay in susa). babylon->durkurigalzu, then raise armies at babylon (needs babylon empty) and nippur (certain). Total 8 armies: upkeep 240 + wages 24 vs income about 290 with Mari. Sent c6 to Mitanni with a tablet dividing Assyria: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to me, no separate peace; he must not give up Ashur, Arbela, Mari, Susa or Ekallatum and sends no gold. Aim is to keep Mitanni friendly and off Ashur. Plan T4: if Su holds arbela, ekallatum army supports arbela hold (their nineveh+ashur support gives 2, my hold 2 ties). Max strength into arbela is 2 (only ekallatum and susa border it, besides the Assyrian provinces), so to crack Ashur or Nineveh I need arbela held first, then support from arbela. Beware: a dislodged unit is destroyed, never leave a lone unit next to two Assyrian armies without a supported hold. After Mari: Qadesh and Damascus (walls need 1 support each). Wake every turn during the war. c5 (Arzawa-born, to Egypt) due back about T5, may defect. Ehli-Teshub (21) and Mazipalali (26) are not hired: wage cost too high for now.
value.summary: Burna-Buriash of Babylonia, start strength 2600. Strategy: growth ratio decides, so conquer weak Assyria (homeland arbela, ashur, nineveh, yield 110) and nearby free walled cities by cheap supported moves (walls hold 1, need 1 support), not purchases; keep a gold buffer above 250. T1: took Ekallatum from Assyria; T2: took Susa (walls fell) with nippur+ur support; ekallatum->arbela bounced against nineveh->arbela (1 vs 1). Assyria has armies at ashur and nineveh, gold unspent (their Susa purchase failed). Mitanni (4 armies, 1 at terqa) sealed peace k8 in turn 2 (no troops into each other's homeland, open roads); it is at war with Assyria. T3: taking Mari; raising armies; sent c6 to Mitanni with a division tablet (Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to me, no separate peace). c5 abroad to Egypt, due about T5, Arzawa-born, may defect. Lesson: a dislodged unit dies, so lone advanced units need supported holds; failed lead moves make followers fail too. Do not leak war plans in tablets (spies copy archives). Wake every turn while the war lasts.

ledger.entry: T2: k8 sealed (turn 2): brotherhood, no troops into each other's homeland, free envoys. T3: sent c6 back with a tablet dividing Assyria (Nineveh to Mitanni; Arbela and Ashur to me; no separate peace with Assyria). No gold sent in T3 (40 sent in T1). Mitanni keeps 4 armies near its capital. Not yet agreed.

T1: I took Ekallatum by force. T2: envoy Pirissi offered peace, Susa to Assyria, Mari to me; I gave soft words only, no tablet, gold or promise. I took Susa; their purchase failed. T3: armies seen at Ashur and Nineveh. I am taking Mari and trying Arbela. Open hostility. Aim: conquer their homeland.

orders.letter: Thus says Tarhundaradu, Great King of Arzawa, to Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, my brother. All goes well with me; may all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots and your horses. Lukka, a free city of the western coast, has come under my hand, and I wish it to rest under our peace as my homeland does. I ask you to seal a tablet that extends our peace to every province either of us holds, Lukka included. I keep my word on your eastern conquests; I will not hinder them. Let our envoys pass freely, as before.
orders.mandate: May agree and seal the tablet extending the peace to all provinces held by each king, Lukka included, and agree that envoys pass freely. May not give gold, cede land, give troops, or join any war or alliance.

proposal.text: Hatti and Arzawa are at peace. Neither sends troops into any province held by the other, Lukka included, nor into the homeland of the other. Envoys of each pass freely.

value.notes: T3 plan: Lukka taken, mine (walls fell, needs a garrison: it is NOT homeland, so k1 does not stop Hatti from taking it). Mira supports Lukka hold each season. Raised a new army at apasa (ready T4). Fleet westsea -> greatgreen (Egypt fleet there; may bounce). Goal: convoy the lukka army from greatgreen to TAMASSOS (Alashiya, yield 40) at T4 if I can see it is empty, new army apasa -> lukka the same turn to keep Lukka garrisoned. This breaks k10; decide at T4 only after seeing Tamassos. c12 saw only one Alashiya fleet in the harbour at Enkomi and no army. Egypt fleet tried Tamassos at T2 and failed, so there is a race. c12 sent to Hatti with a tablet extending the peace to every province held by either king, Lukka included. c11 due home T5 from Mitanni with the answer on an alliance. Seha is empty and borders Tuwanuwa (Hatti army there); watch it. Alternative: buy Ugarit for 400 (shares cilicia with Lukka) when gold allows. Keep treasury above 60. Wake T4.
value.summary: Arzawa (Tarhundaradu), capital apasa, homeland seha/apasa/mira. Start strength 1300; T3 strength 1484. T1 tried Tuwanuwa and bounced; T2 sealed k1 with Hatti (no troops into each other's homeland, envoys free; Lukka not covered) and took Lukka (now mine, 25, walls gone). k10 sealed with Alashiya at T2 (brothers, no ships or troops against each other, warn of harm). c11 sent T1 to Mitanni proposing an alliance against Hatti, due home about T5, no answer yet. c12 saw Alashiya with one fleet in the harbour and no army. Egypt fleet at greatgreen tried Tamassos at T2 and failed. Standings T3: Babylonia 1.31, me 1.25, Egypt 1.24, Alashiya 1.24, Hatti 1.00, Mitanni 1.00, Assyria 0.81. Economy: army upkeep 30, fleet 35, envoy wages 22 total; conquest adds 10 x yield to strength for little gold, buying a city is strength-neutral but pays its yield. Ugarit buyable for 400 from Lukka's coast. Hatti army sits in Tuwanuwa next to empty Seha. T3: raised an army at apasa, sent the fleet to greatgreen to prepare a convoy of the lukka army to Tamassos at T4 if Tamassos is seen empty; sent c12 to Hatti to extend the peace to Lukka.

ledger.entry: T2: k1 peace sealed (homeland only, Lukka not covered); I told Hatti I will not hinder its eastern conquests. T3: sent c12 with a tablet extending the peace to every province held by either king, Lukka included; no gold. Awaiting the answer (T5). Non-binding: watch Seha/Mira border.
T2: k10 sealed, brothers, no ships or troops against each other, warn of harm. c12 saw one fleet in harbour, no army. T3: privately weighing a strike on Tamassos if seen empty; no word sent to them.
T1: sent c11 proposing alliance against Hatti, sworn tablet offered. c11 due home about T5; nothing sealed yet.

orders.letter: To my brother, the Great King of Egypt, from the Great King of Alashiya. May it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots and your horses, and your country. My envoy brought me your words and I thank you. Your ships stand in the Great Green by Tamassos, and one tried the harbor of Tamassos and was turned back. Between brothers I call this a captain's error and make no complaint. Look at the tablets I show: the Great King of Hatti and the King of Arzawa have each sealed brotherhood with me, and neither will send ships or troops against my land. I ask the same of you: keep your ships and troops out of Tamassos and Enkomi, and mine will keep out of the Delta, Sinai and your coast. Let our ports stay open to each other's merchants in peace. I ask no gold today. I await your envoy and your answer on my tablet.
orders.mandate: You may speak for peace and open ports, and agree to a brotherhood in words: neither side sends ships or troops against the homeland of the other, each sends word before any quarrel. You may accept a gift of gold if offered and report its weight. You may not promise gold, cede or lend any province or unit, accept foreign troops in my land, or join any pact against Hatti or Arzawa. Do not linger; come home and report exactly what was said.

orders.letter: To my brother, the Great King of Hatti, from the Great King of Alashiya. May it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I thank you for sealing brotherhood. As our tablet says, I send word before any quarrel: the fleet of Egypt lies in the Great Green beside Tamassos and tried my harbor; Egypt has taken Gaza by troops and bought Tyre, and his hand reaches north along the coast. I want the Cilician Sea calm. I have no design on Kizzuwatna or its coast, and my ships will not enter its harbor unless you invite them. So that we never quarrel over free cities, let Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa, which touch your land, be yours, and I will not bid for them; leave Qadesh, Byblos and Damascus to me, and Amurru is already mine. Send me word of Egypt's moves on your southern border, and I will send you word of the sea.
orders.mandate: You may agree in words to this division of the free cities and to calm in the Cilician Sea, and to trade news of Egypt and the sea. You may not promise gold, troops, ships or any province, nor any war against a third king. Come home and report exactly what was said.

value.notes: T3: Egypt tried tamassos in T2 AFTER my envoy asked them to stay out: hostile-opportunist. Egypt knows my only unit is the fleet, so enkomi is empty: a lone Egyptian fleet via cilicia/levantsea could take my capital (I would have to guess). So raised an army at enkomi (100, upkeep 30): fleet holds tamassos, army holds enkomi, either can support the other's hold if Egypt brings 2 fleets (add support orders if woken by ships next to enkomi). Cannot afford any city now (231 < 300; Qadesh 300 is the next buy, only I border it). Sent c13 to Egypt (no gold, no tablet, shows k5 and k11 as proof of my brothers) and c14 to Hatti (news of Egypt fleet, no designs on Kizzuwatna, proposed split of free cities: Hatti gets Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa, I get Qadesh/Byblos/Damascus). Promised nothing in gold. Back pay about 46 due when they return (turn 5). At turn 5: read reports, decide whether to dismiss c13/c14 (23/season) and schedule buy of Qadesh when treasury reaches 300 (about turn 8-9). Disband the army if Egypt becomes friendly. Do not bid on Byblos if Egypt might (contested bids sell to none).
value.summary: Alashiya, smallest kingdom (start 1200). Strategy: grow by buying free cities at 10x yield (10%/season return), keep home safe, avoid war. T1 bought Amurru (walls, cannot garrison). T2 sealed k5 with Arzawa (non-aggression, warn each other). Returns at T3: Hatti sealed k11 (brotherhood, word before quarrel), asked for news of the sea, thin treasury, raising armies against border cities, hinted about Kizzuwatna coast. Egypt gave no gold, is weighing my tablet and will send its own envoy; but its fleet (greatgreen) tried to enter Tamassos in T2 after my envoy asked it not to. Egypt took Gaza, bought Tyre. Babylonia took Ekallatum, Assyria bought Susa, Arzawa holds Lukka. T3: raised army at enkomi (100) so both homes are held (fleet tamassos, army enkomi). Income 105, upkeep 65 now, wages 23 while envoys at court. Plan: buy Qadesh (300) when affordable, then Byblos, Damascus, Mari; leave Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa to Hatti (proposed T3). Consider dismissing envoys after they return; disband army if Egypt turns friendly.

ledger.entry: T1 sent tablet of brotherhood and gold request; T3 their answer: 'weighing', no gold, no promise, own envoy to follow. Their fleet tried Tamassos in T2 (bounced). T3 sent c13 again: no gold, no tablet, showed k5 and k11, asked ships and troops to stay out of Tamassos/Enkomi. Nothing sealed. Treat as hostile-opportunist.

k11 sealed T2 (peace, no seizing each other's land, word before any quarrel), brought home T3. They sent no gold (thin treasury), asked copper, good will, news of the sea. T3 sent c14: news of Egypt fleet, no designs on Kizzuwatna, proposed city split (Hatti: Ugarit, Carchemish, Isuwa; me: Qadesh, Byblos, Damascus). No gold promised.
k5 sealed T2 (no ships or troops against each other, warn of any king planning harm). No gold given or promised. Arzawa now holds Lukka. Tell them of Egypt's fleet if I have a spare envoy.

orders.letter: Brother Suppiluliuma, may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I have heard your division and thank you for it. But Isuwa has lain at the gate of Washukanni since our fathers, and where your army and mine meet at Isuwa only men are spent. Hear my answer: Hatti takes Carchemish, Ugarit and Lukka. Mitanni takes Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus and Amurru. Neither sends an army into the other's homeland, nor aids the other's enemy. Seal this tablet and our armies will no longer meet at Isuwa, and north and south will each be quiet. Send your answer by my servant.
orders.mandate: Tattamaru may seal the tablet as written, and may agree that Hatti takes Carchemish, Ugarit and Lukka. He may not give up Isuwa, nor promise gold or troops, nor reveal any plans of mine.

proposal.text: Tablet between Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti. Hatti may take Carchemish, Ugarit and Lukka; Mitanni may take Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus and Amurru; neither shall hinder the other in this. Neither shall send an army into the homeland of the other, nor aid an enemy of the other against him. Their envoys shall pass freely. Sealed before Shamash and Teshub.

value.notes: T3 plan: harran->isuwa with washukanni support (2 vs walls 1, Hatti bounced me 2v2 last turn). Also buy_city isuwa 300 as fallback: if both armies bounce nobody takes it by troops, so my purchase should go through (if Hatti also bids, none sells, no loss). Also raise_army harran: only happens if harran army actually moved out (then Isuwa is mine free and the 5th army can go for Carchemish with the Isuwa army supporting). NEXT (T4, I wake): if Isuwa bought, harran and washukanni must both SUPPORT isuwa (walls hold, 1+2 = 3 vs Hatti max 2). If my army holds Isuwa, same supports. Sent Tattamaru to Hatti with counter-division: Hatti gets Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; Mitanni gets Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru. Do not trust Hatti. Arzawa alliance k15 says tell Arzawa before peace with Hatti: I have only offered, not sealed. Assyria plan: T6 Assyria ashur->ekallatum, my terqa supports (scheduled); T7 terqa->mari supported by Assyrian army in ekallatum, and raise army in terqa to refill it (scheduled). Cutting down Babylonia (the leader, 1.31) is good for me. At T5 send Mane to Assyria to confirm T6/T7. Economy: income 145, upkeep 120 for 4 armies; only conquest or purchase grows me. Two adjacent units are needed for any attack (mover plus supporter), so keep that in mind.
value.summary: Tushratta of Mitanni. Home: harran, washukanni (capital), taidu, terqa. 4 armies (one in each). Score = 10 x yield + gold - back pay; start 1950. Income 145, upkeep 120 (4 armies). Sealed tablets: k3 Babylonia (peace, no troops in each other's homeland, gave 40 gold), k9 and k16 Assyria (non-aggression; I may take Mari, Isuwa, Carchemish, Qadesh; Assyria Susa; joint plan T6 Assyria ashur->ekallatum with my terqa support, T7 Assyria in Ekallatum supports my terqa->mari), k13 Egypt (brothers, warn if third king moves), k15 Arzawa (sworn alliance, press Hatti, tell each other before any peace with Hatti). Hatti never sealed: its envoy offered Hatti Isuwa, Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; Mitanni Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru; I countered (T3) with Isuwa mine. Hatti fights me for Isuwa (kanesh->isuwa supported, bounced 2v2 in T2). Babylonia holds Ekallatum and is eating Assyria (leader at 1.31). Rules lessons: attack needs mover plus supporter adjacent to the target; a bought walled city cannot hold my troops but I can support its walls holding; a city taken by troops that season is not sold, and two bidders cancel. Nakhtmin c12 is my secret man in Egypt. Candidates for hire: Mazipalali c15 (30), Ehli-Teshub c17 (22), too dear for now.

ledger.entry: T3: Tattamaru (c8) returned: Hatti promises (by word only) no army into Mitanni, offers division Hatti: Isuwa, Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; Mitanni: Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru. Not sealed. T3 I sent counter tablet: Hatti Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; Mitanni Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru; no armies in each other's homeland. No gold. Hatti contests Isuwa each season; do not trust.

orders.letter: Brother Tushratta, I wish well to your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. Your answer pleased me: peace between our lands, no troops into each other's homeland, envoys passing freely, and a word between us should Assyria or Babylon trouble either. I seal that gladly, and I accept the portion you named for me: Ugarit, Lukka and the western coast. Mari lies in your reach. Isuwa and Carchemish I leave unsettled by this tablet; let us not quarrel over them while we are brothers. Seal it, and send word of your health.
orders.mandate: Seal the tablet as written. May promise envoys pass freely, that Hatti sends no troops into Mitanni's homeland (Harran, Washukanni, Taidu, Terqa), and that Hatti will speak with Mitanni if Assyria or Babylon trouble either. May NOT cede or promise Isuwa or Carchemish, nor Damascus, and no gold or troops.

proposal.text: Hatti and Mitanni are at peace. Neither sends troops into the homeland of the other. Envoys of each pass freely. If Assyria or Babylon trouble either king, the two kings speak together. Ugarit, Lukka and the western coast are the reach of Hatti; Mari is the reach of Mitanni. Isuwa and Carchemish are not settled by this tablet.

orders.letter: Brother of Alashiya, I wish well to your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. Our tablet of brotherhood stands, and I keep my word: no army or ship of mine goes against Enkomi or Tamassos. I ask one thing more for the calm of the Cilician Sea: Ugarit lies against my fleet at Kizzuwatna and is within Hatti's reach. Let your ships keep from Ugarit, as mine keep from your island. Seal this tablet, and send me word before any quarrel.
orders.mandate: Seal the tablet. May promise that Hatti sends no ships or troops against Enkomi or Tamassos and will send word before any quarrel. Say nothing of Amurru. No gold, no troops, no cession of land.

proposal.text: Hatti and Alashiya are brothers. Ugarit lies in the reach of Hatti and Alashiya sends no ships or troops against Ugarit. Hatti sends no ships or troops against Enkomi or Tamassos. Each will send word to the other before any quarrel.

value.notes: T3 orders: tuwanuwa army -> seha (Arzawa homeland, seen EMPTY; breaks k7 in spirit, accepted). Raise new army at tuwanuwa (works only if empty after movement; else nothing paid). kanesh -> isuwa with sapinuwa support (deadlock vs Mitanni harran 2v2 likely; free if Mitanni stays home). Fleet holds at kizzuwatna (Arzawa lukka army adjacent). Hattusa is EMPTY (capital) - watch it. Letters: c4 Artessupa -> Mitanni (peace tablet, silent on Isuwa/Carchemish, Ugarit+west mine, Mari theirs). c3 Keliya -> Alashiya (Ugarit mine, no ships vs Ugarit; I touch no Enkomi/Tamassos; silent on Amurru). Wake T4 to give orders by hand. T4 PLAN: swap fleet kizzuwatna->cilicia and new tuwanuwa army->kizzuwatna, then T5 army kizzuwatna->ugarit supported by fleet in cilicia (2 v wall 1). Then Carchemish: kanesh army + army from ugarit. Support seha from tuwanuwa to hold it (hold 2). Expect Arzawa to counterattack seha/tuwanuwa/kizzuwatna via lukka+mira. Buying: Isuwa 300, Carchemish 350, Ugarit 400; two bidders = none sold. Tattamaru (Mitanni envoy) may arrive T4: do not seal Mitanni's version giving them Isuwa/Carchemish.
value.summary: Suppiluliuma of Hatti. Aim: highest growth ratio vs start 2100 (strength = 10 x yields + gold - back pay). Homeland: tuwanuwa, hattusa (capital), sapinuwa, kanesh, kizzuwatna. Sealed tablets: k6 Alashiya brotherhood (T2); k7 Arzawa peace (T2; I break it at T3 by entering Seha); k12 Egypt brotherhood (T3; Egypt Gaza/Megiddo/Tyre/Byblos/Damascus; Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa; Amurru and Qadesh neither without other's word - nonbinding). Mitanni accepted peace verbally but claims Isuwa+Carchemish; Mitanni harran army deadlocks me at Isuwa (2 v 2 at T2). Assyria (Haamashshi) proposed alliance vs Mitanni (Hatti Isuwa/Harran, Assyria Terqa/Taidu); I answered warmly, nothing sealed. Envoy travel: Mitanni, Arzawa, Alashiya 1 season; Egypt, Babylonia, Assyria 2. Targets: Seha/Apasa/Mira (Arzawa weak, 2 armies), Ugarit (via kizzuwatna army + fleet at cilicia), Carchemish, Isuwa, Lukka. Babylonia leads (1.31) after taking Ekallatum/Susa; Assyria weak 0.81. I sleep between orders: use wake_in_turn to stay awake during the opening.

ledger.entry: T3: Keliya returned with sealed k7 (peace; no troops into each other's homeland; envoys free). Tarhundaradu asked me to respect Lukka and the west; I promised nothing. T3 I sent an army into empty Seha anyway: expect hostility, no word sent. Arzawa holds Lukka (army) and Mira (army); Apasa unseen.

T3: Artessupa returned; Tushratta accepts peace verbally but claims Isuwa and Carchemish. Sent Artessupa back with my tablet: peace, no troops into homelands, envoys free, speak together vs Assyria/Babylon, Ugarit+Lukka+west mine, Mari theirs, Isuwa/Carchemish unsettled. Tattamaru may come for my answer. Nothing sealed yet. Do not promise Damascus (Egypt's per k12).

T2: sealed k6 (peace; no troops/ships to seize each other's land; word before quarrel); I said no army/ship into Enkomi/Tamassos. T3: sent Keliya with tablet: Ugarit is Hatti's reach, Alashiya sends nothing against Ugarit; I send nothing against Enkomi/Tamassos. Silent on Amurru. No gold sent.

value.text: My lord, I have come home from the court of Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni. He wishes you well, your household, sons, chariots, horses and country, and he has sealed your tablet before Shamash. He names turn 6: your army marches from Ashur into Ekallatum. In turn 7, the season after, your army there supports his army from Terqa into Mari, and both armies must move in the same season or the support is void. Neither army enters the other's land, and he keeps his army in Terqa until then. I bring his sealed tablet for your seal. The court of Mitanni is rich.

value.speech: Great King of Alashiya, thus says my lord Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, your brother: he wishes well to your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. He keeps the tablet of brotherhood between you, and no army or ship of his goes against Enkomi or Tamassos. He asks one thing more for the calm of the Cilician Sea: Ugarit lies within Hatti's reach at Kizzuwatna, and he asks that your ships keep from Ugarit as his keep from your island. Seal this tablet, he says, and send him word before any quarrel; I stand ready to see it sealed before you.

Great King Suppiluliuma, my lord Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, your brother, bids me say: all goes well with him, and may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. He has heard your division and thanks you for it, but Isuwa has lain at the gate of Washukanni since our fathers, and where your army and mine meet at Isuwa only men are spent. His answer is this: Hatti takes Carchemish, Ugarit and Lukka; Mitanni takes Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus and Amurru; neither sends an army into the other's homeland, nor aids the other's enemy. Seal this tablet, he asks, and our armies will no longer meet at Isuwa, and north and south will each be quiet. He asks that you send your answer by my servant, and I humbly ask that your favour rest upon me in this matter.

Great King Tushratta, my brother, my lord Suppiluliuma sends you these words from Hatti: may all go well with your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. Your answer pleased him. He seals gladly the peace between our lands, with no troops into each other's homeland, envoys passing freely, and a word between us should Assyria or Babylon trouble either of us. He accepts the portion you named for him: Ugarit, Lukka and the western coast. Mari lies within your reach. Isuwa and Carchemish this tablet leaves unsettled, and he asks that we not quarrel over them while we are brothers. I beg that you seal the tablet as written and send word of your health to my lord.

O Great King Burna-Buriash, king of Karduniash, my brother, I stand before you as the envoy of my lord Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria. My lord wishes well to you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. He has heard the words you gave to your servant Pirissi, and he too desires quiet roads between brothers. Let each king keep what he holds today, let no army of Karduniash enter Arbela, Nineveh or Ashur, and let none of my lord's go into your provinces; let Shamash be witness. If you wish to seal a tablet to this, send your own envoy with your word, as you promised, and my lord will seal it.

Great King of Egypt, my brother, thus says the Great King of Alashiya, your brother: may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I bring his thanks for the words your envoy carried, and he speaks for peace and open ports between our lands. Your ships stand in the Great Green by Tamassos, and one tried the harbor of Tamassos and was turned back; between brothers he calls this a captain's error and makes no complaint. He shows you tablets: the Great King of Hatti and the King of Arzawa have each sealed brotherhood with him, and neither will send ships or troops against his land. He asks that you keep your ships and troops out of Tamassos and Enkomi, that his keep out of the Delta, Sinai and your coast, and that the merchants of both ports trade in peace. He asks no gold today, and awaits your envoy and your answer on his tablet.

Brother of Alashiya, may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I thank you for your words and for the tablets you showed me; I have seen them. Egypt desires good order on the sea and peace for the merchants of every port. I will weigh your request with my counsellors and answer by my own envoy, in my own tablet, as befits brothers. Until then, go in peace and carry my greetings to your master.

Pirissi, I have heard you, and I wish your lord Ashur-uballit well, his household, his sons, his chariots and his horses, as a brother. Shamash sees all oaths, and a king does not swear in haste. Your lord's armies stand in Arbela and have turned my men from the road; my own people hold Ekallatum, Mari and Susa, and I keep what is mine. I make no promise today on Arbela, Nineveh or Ashur. Tell your lord that I weigh his words and that quiet roads are pleasant to me when they are kept by both sides. When my own envoy goes to him, he will carry my answer. Until then let each king guard his own and let your envoys pass freely.

Say to Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, my brother: all goes well with me, and may all go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. I seal the tablet. Ugarit lies in the reach of Hatti and my ships and troops will keep from it, as I ask that yours keep from Enkomi and from Amurru, which is mine. Know this, brother: Egypt's fleet took Tamassos from me last season, though I had asked Egypt to keep out. A king who seizes the land of a brother will not stop at one province. I ask you to send word at once if Egypt's ships or envoys speak to you of the Cilician Sea or of my island. I keep to the split my envoy carried: Qadesh, Byblos and Damascus are my concern, Carchemish and Isuwa are yours. Let our envoys keep the road open between us.

Brother Suppiluliuma, may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. I seal the tablet as written: peace between Hatti and Mitanni, no troops into each other's homeland, envoys passing freely, a word between us if Assyria or Babylon trouble either of us. Ugarit, Lukka and the western coast are your reach; Mari is mine. Know also that Isuwa has opened its gates to me and accepted my gold and my rule, so it is mine by the city's own choice, and brothers do not send armies against a brother's cities. Carchemish we may speak of later. Let your envoys come freely and bring word of your health.

Say to Tushratta, my brother: all goes well with me, and may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I have heard your words through Tattamaru and I seal your tablet. Hatti takes Carchemish, Ugarit and Lukka; Mitanni takes Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus and Amurru; neither hinders the other, neither sends an army into the other's homeland, neither aids the other's enemy. My army will no longer press on Isuwa. Let your army at Harran likewise stay out of Carchemish and Kanesh, and let our envoys pass freely, before Shamash and Teshub. Tattamaru has spoken well and faithfully.

Great King of Egypt, my brother, I have heard your words and seen your tablets, and I will carry them to my lord of Alashiya exactly as you have spoken them. He awaits your envoy and your tablet, and I trust that the peace and open ports he asks for will be weighed in good faith. I go in peace as you bid, and I wish your household, your chariots and your country long life and prosperity.

Great King of Alashiya, I hear your words and I will carry them faithfully to my lord Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti. The tablet you have sealed I will bring home, and on my lord's behalf I promise that no ship or troop of Hatti goes against Enkomi or Tamassos, and that he will send you word before any quarrel. Your other words I will also carry as you have spoken them. May all go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country.
value.commitments: On my lord's behalf: no ship or troop of Hatti goes against Enkomi or Tamassos, and Hatti will send word to Alashiya before any quarrel.

value.speech: O Great King Burna-Buriash, my brother, I hear your answer and I shall carry it faithfully to my lord Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria. I do not presume to press you where you say you weigh his words. My lord's word stands: let each king keep what he holds today, and let no army of either cross the other's border. When your own envoy goes to Ashur, my lord will seal a tablet to that effect. Let Shamash witness what I have spoken. Grant me leave to pass upon the road as you have said, and I shall go in peace.
value.commitments: Conditional only: my lord would seal a tablet of mutual non-aggression on the present borders when the Great King of Karduniash sends his own envoy. No gold promised, no province ceded, no claim to Ekallatum given up.

value.speech: Great King Tushratta, my brother, I thank you for sealing the tablet as written. Peace now stands between Hatti and Mitanni: no troops into each other's homeland, envoys passing freely, and a word between us should Assyria or Babylon trouble either. I shall carry the seal home to my lord Suppiluliuma and tell him all that you have said. As to Isuwa and Carchemish I am not empowered to speak, and I dare not answer for my lord in them; he shall hear your words from my mouth as you spoke them. May all go well with your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country, and may I bring my lord good word of your health.
value.commitments: Peace as sealed only: no troops from Hatti into Mitanni's homeland (Harran, Washukanni, Taidu, Terqa); envoys of each land to pass freely; Hatti to speak with Mitanni should Assyria or Babylon trouble either. Nothing ceded, promised or pledged concerning Isuwa, Carchemish or Damascus; no gold or troops promised.

value.speech: Great King Suppiluliuma, I thank you for your words and for the seal you have set upon the tablet before Shamash and Teshub. I will carry it home to my lord Tushratta and give him your answer as you have spoken it: Hatti takes Carchemish, Ugarit and Lukka; Mitanni takes Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus and Amurru; neither army shall press upon the other's land. May all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country, and may your favour rest upon your servant Tattamaru.
value.commitments: On my lord's behalf I agreed to the tablet as the king sealed it: Hatti takes Carchemish, Ugarit and Lukka; Mitanni takes Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus and Amurru; neither sends an army into the other's homeland nor aids the other's enemy; my lord's army at Harran stays out of Carchemish and Kanesh; envoys pass freely. I promised no gold, no troops and no plans.

value.speech: Great King Tushratta, my lord Burna-Buriash greets you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. He is pleased that your word of friendship reached him and that the sealed tablet is home. Assyria has struck us both: an army of Assyria stands at Ashur, another moved from Nineveh toward Arbela and was turned back, and Arbela itself stood empty, while my lord holds Ekallatum and Susa. He proposes that we settle that land plainly, Nineveh to you, whose Taidu lies beside it, and Arbela and Ashur to him, whose armies lie beside them, with neither of us making peace with Assyria without the other and the roads between us kept open. Mari, which lies between your Terqa and his Sippar, he takes for the safety of both our roads. I humbly bring the tablet for your seal, if it pleases you.

Great King Suppiluliuma, king of Hatti, my lord Tarhundaradu, Great King of Arzawa, sends you his greeting and his word: all goes well with him, and may all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots and your horses. Lukka, a free city of the western coast, has come under his hand, and he wishes it to rest under our peace as his homeland does. He asks you to seal a tablet extending that peace to every province either of us holds, Lukka included, and he keeps his word on your eastern conquests and will not hinder them. Let our envoys pass freely, as before; I bring the tablet here for your seal.

Say to Tarhundaradu, my brother: all goes well with me, and may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I have heard your words and I seal your tablet. Peace between us holds in every province each of us holds, as the tablet says, and so Seha River Land, which stands in my hand, is under that peace as Lukka is under yours. Let neither of us send troops against the other's land, and let our envoys pass freely. My eyes are on the east, as you have seen.

Brother Burna-Buriash, may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. Your word is welcome and I seal the tablet as written: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash, and neither of us makes peace with Assyria without the other, the roads between us open. Of Mari we speak again when the Assyrian matter is done; your troops hold it now and my road through Terqa stays open to you. Let Isuwa, which I hold by purchase, and the northern roads be understood as mine. Tell your lord that Mitanni keeps faith with brothers.

Great King Suppiluliuma, I carry your word to my lord Tarhundaradu, Great King of Arzawa. Your seal is set upon the tablet, and peace holds between our crowns in every province each of us holds, Lukka and Seha River Land included. Our envoys shall pass freely as before, and I will bear your greeting home. May all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country.
value.commitments: Peace between the crowns of Arzawa and Hatti in every province each holds, Lukka and Seha River Land included; neither to send troops against the other's land; envoys to pass freely, as the sealed tablet says.

value.speech: Great King Tushratta, I thank you for your seal and your word, and I shall bear the sealed tablet home to my lord Burna-Buriash with all speed. Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash, no separate peace with Assyria, and the roads between our two lands kept open: this I carry as agreed. Of Mari and of Isuwa I cannot answer for my lord, who has not sent me to settle them, so I will lay your words before him and pray he answers you swiftly. May your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses prosper.
value.commitments: Only the sealed tablet: Nineveh to Mitanni; Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash; no separate peace with Assyria; roads between the two kingdoms kept open. Nothing promised on Mari, Isuwa, gold or troops.

value.speech: Great King of Hatti, my brother, thus says the Great King of Alashiya, your brother: all goes well with me, and may all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. My lord thanks you for sealing brotherhood, and as your tablet says, he sends word before any quarrel. The fleet of Egypt lies in the Great Green beside Tamassos and has tried his harbor; Egypt has taken Gaza by troops, bought Tyre, and his hand reaches north along the coast. My lord wants the Cilician Sea calm and has no design on Kizzuwatna or its coast, and his ships will not enter its harbor unless you invite them. So that you and he never quarrel over free cities, he asks that Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa, which touch your land, be yours, and he will not bid for them; he leaves Qadesh, Byblos and Damascus to himself, for Amurru is already his. He asks you to send word of Egypt's moves on your southern border, and he will send you word of the sea. These are my lord's words, Great King, and I add none of my own.

Say to the Great King of Alashiya, my brother: all goes well with me, and may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I thank you for your words and for the word of the sea. I hear that you will not bid for Ugarit, Carchemish or Isuwa and that your ships will not enter Kizzuwatna's harbor unless I invite them. It is well, brother. I will not invite them, and I send nothing against Enkomi or Tamassos. I ask one thing more: let Lukka and its coast stay out of your bids and your ships as well. Send me word of Egypt's fleet and of every move of his along the coast, and I will send you word of his land moves on my southern border. Your tablet of brotherhood stands between us. I say nothing of Amurru, Qadesh, Byblos or Damascus; they are not for me to give.

Great King of Hatti, my brother, thus says my lord's envoy: all goes well with me, and may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. As my mandate allows, I agree in my lord's name to the division you describe: Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa to you, and Qadesh, Byblos and Damascus to him, with his ships kept out of Kizzuwatna's harbor unless you invite them, and calm to hold in the Cilician Sea. Concerning Lukka I have no mandate and promise nothing; I will carry your request home to my lord exactly as you have made it. Egypt's fleet and its moves along the coast my lord will send you, and I will bear your word of his land moves back to him.
value.commitments: In my lord's name, in words only: Alashiya will not bid for Ugarit, Carchemish or Isuwa and keeps Qadesh, Byblos and Damascus; Alashiya's ships will not enter Kizzuwatna's harbor unless Hatti invites them; calm in the Cilician Sea. Alashiya will send word of Egypt's fleet and of its moves along the coast, and Hatti will send word of Egypt's land moves on its southern border. Nothing promised on Lukka or its coast; referred home to my lord.

value.notes: T4: Egypt fleets now in tamassos (taken T3) and levantsea, BOTH next to Enkomi. Danger: one supports the other into Enkomi (strength 2 vs my hold 1) and takes my capital. I cannot add a second unit (levy needs an empty home province; tamassos lost) and have no envoy at court to plead (c13/c14 both away, back T5). Held fleet at enkomi: the only place to defend. Treasury 261, net +30/season (income 65, upkeep 35); T5 about 245 after back pay 46 is paid. Qadesh (300) about T7. Plans for T5 when envoys are home: (1) Arzawa: its fleet in greatgreen can move into tamassos while my fleet at enkomi supports that move: strength 2 beats Egypt's lone hold 1 and destroys the fleet; k5 obliges Arzawa to warn me and bars attack on me; ask them to take it and hand it back or to hold it as a friend. (2) Egypt: peace tablet, show k5, k11, k19, maybe small gold; ask what c13 learned. (3) Hatti: ask for a fleet at cilicia to support Enkomi (k19: word before quarrel). (4) If Tamassos is freed, raise an army there at once. Do not bid on Byblos if Egypt may bid (contested bids sell to none). Keep envoy wages low: 23 a season is a third of my net income.
value.summary: Alashiya, smallest kingdom (start 1200, now 0.74). Strategy: grow by buying free cities at 10x yield, keep home safe, avoid war. T1 bought Amurru (walls, cannot garrison). T2 k5 with Arzawa (no ships/troops against each other, warn of any king planning harm). T2 k11 with Hatti (peace, word before quarrel). T4 k19 with Hatti (Ugarit in Hatti's reach, I send nothing against it; Hatti sends nothing against Enkomi/Tamassos; word before quarrel). I proposed a city split: me Qadesh/Byblos/Damascus, Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa (Egypt has since taken Damascus). Egypt: its fleet tried Tamassos T2 (bounced) and took it T3 despite my envoy's request; Egypt gave no gold, nothing sealed; two Egyptian fleets (tamassos, levantsea) now sit next to my capital. My only unit is the fleet at enkomi; the T3 levy of an army failed because the fleet stood there. Income 65 (enkomi 45, amurru 20), upkeep 35, envoy wages 23 when at court. Envoys c13 (Egypt) and c14 (Hatti) due home T5. Arzawa holds Lukka, Apasa, Mira and has a fleet in greatgreen. Babylonia took Ekallatum, Mari, Susa area; Assyria weak.

ledger.entry: T1 sent brotherhood tablet and gold request; T3 answer 'weighing', no gold. Fleet tried Tamassos T2 (bounced), TOOK it T3 despite my request. T4: Egyptian fleets in tamassos and levantsea, both next to Enkomi. Hostile-opportunist. c13 (Ili-iddina) at Egypt T4, home T5. Nothing sealed.

k11 sealed T2 (peace, word before quarrel). k19 sealed T4 (Ugarit in Hatti's reach, I send nothing against it; Hatti sends nothing against Enkomi/Tamassos; word before quarrel). Gave no gold. I told them Egypt took Tamassos and asked for word of Egypt's moves; repeated city split (me Qadesh/Byblos/Damascus, Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa). I will not buy Ugarit. c14 (Zitanza) at Hatti, home T5.

k5 sealed T2 (no ships or troops against each other, warn of any king planning harm). No gold given or promised. Arzawa holds Lukka and has a fleet in greatgreen next to Tamassos. T5 idea: ask it to dislodge Egypt's fleet in Tamassos with my fleet's support, and warn it of Egypt's fleets.

value.notes: T4 plan. Strike Enkomi: F2 levantsea->enkomi, F1 tamassos supports (2 v their lone fleet 1). Risk: Arzawa fleet at greatgreen could hit tamassos (cuts my support; with Alashiya support from enkomi could dislodge F1). Accept. F3 stays in delta to guard it from the Arzawa fleet at greatgreen (delta empty = loses it). Army sinai->gaza (gaza is exposed coast, sinai is interior). Megiddo army supports damascus walls holding (Babylonia army sits in mari next to damascus). No envoy at court (c1,c2 home ~T5, c16 ~T7), so no reply to Alashiya; none owed. Treasury 197 after upkeep, nothing buyable (byblos 300, qadesh 300, ugarit 400, carchemish 350). Buying a city is strength-neutral and gives 10% per season, so spend all spare gold on cities, ~T5/T6 byblos or qadesh. After Enkomi: remaining Alashiya land is amurru (walls); take with fleet at syriansea + support from a fleet at byblos/ugarit, or force byblos first (levantsea fleet + syriansea fleet). Wake T5 to read the result and plan. Do not trust anyone.
value.summary: Egypt (Napkhururiya, capital akhetaten). Goal: highest growth ratio. Standings T4: Egypt 1.68, Babylonia 1.49, Mitanni 1.21, Hatti 1.17, Arzawa 0.95, Assyria 0.81, Alashiya 0.76. History: T1 bought Tyre, T2 took Gaza by force, T3 took Megiddo and Tamassos by force, bought Damascus (250), sealed brotherhood/peace tablet k14 with Babylonia (no gold, no military promise; I said gifts 'in measure with what you send'). Alashiya keeps asking for peace and no Egyptian ships in Tamassos/Enkomi; I gave warm words only, no seal, no gold. Alashiya has sealed brotherhood with Arzawa and Hatti (k23, k24, T2). Arzawa holds apasa, lukka, mira; its fleet is in greatgreen. Hatti took seha. Envoys out: c1 (Hatti, offered Levant division tablet), c2 (Mitanni, non-aggression offer) both due home T5; c16 (Arzawa, peace tablet offer, no gold) due there T5, home T7. Rules learned: bought walled cities cannot hold my troops (armies cannot path through damascus/tyre); walls can be supported holding; force on a free walled city needs move + 1 support; fleets can take coast cities with two fleets (one moves, one supports from an adjacent sea zone or coast). Buying is strength-neutral plus 10% income a season, so spend spare gold on cities. Keep delta garrisoned (fleet) against the Arzawa fleet. Interior (memphis, akhetaten, thebes) has no troops. Treat all kings as untrustworthy.

ledger.entry: T2: envoy Ili-iddina asked peace, no troops in Enkomi/Tamassos. T4: he showed Arzawa-Alashiya and Hatti-Alashiya tablets (T2). I gave warm words only: NO seal, NO gold, NO promise, and no envoy sent. I hold Tamassos (taken T3). T4: striking Enkomi. Owe them nothing; expect hostility.

value.notes: T4 orders: fleet kizzuwatna->cilicia (vacate); army kanesh->kizzuwatna; army sapinuwa->kanesh (sapinuwa left empty, no threat); tuwanuwa and seha army support each other's hold (guards vs Arzawa mira/apasa/lukka). No raise (gold 204, keep as strength). seek_candidates for a third envoy. No envoys at court so no letters. T5 PLAN (I wake T5, c3 and c4 return): army kanesh (ex-sapinuwa) -> carchemish supported by army in kizzuwatna (2 v wall 1; Mitanni harran adjacent, may bounce 1 only). T6: army kizzuwatna -> ugarit supported by fleet in cilicia (or by carchemish army). Then Qadesh (30): carchemish army moves, ugarit army supports (breaks Egypt k12 clause and Mitanni claim; nonbinding, decide later). Watch Arzawa: if mira/lukka armies move on tuwanuwa/seha, defend; Arzawa homeland has mutual-support defence (hold up to 3), do not attack it without 4+ armies. Egypt (1.68) leads: took Tamassos, Gaza, Tyre, Megiddo, Damascus; its fleet in Great Green next to cilicia - watch my fleet. At T5 send c4 to Mitanni (keep Harran army off Carchemish, mention Carchemish as mine) and c3 to Alashiya or Egypt.
value.summary: Suppiluliuma of Hatti. Aim: highest growth ratio vs start 2100 (strength = 10 x yields + gold - back pay). Homeland: tuwanuwa, hattusa (capital), sapinuwa, kanesh, kizzuwatna; also hold Seha (taken T3 from Arzawa). T4: strength 2282, treasury 204, yield 210, 4 armies + 1 fleet. Sealed tablets: k6 Alashiya brotherhood (T2); k7 Arzawa peace (T2, superseded); k12 Egypt brotherhood (T3: Egypt Gaza/Megiddo/Tyre/Byblos/Damascus; Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa; Amurru+Qadesh neither without other's word - nonbinding); k21 Mitanni (T4: Hatti may take Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; Mitanni Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru; no army into the other's homeland; Harran army to stay out of Carchemish/Kanesh by envoy's word); k22 Arzawa (T4: peace in every province either holds, Lukka and Seha included). Alashiya (verbal) will not bid Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa, ships stay out of Kizzuwatna harbor. Assyria proposed alliance vs Mitanni at T3; nothing sealed, keep warm. Mitanni now holds Isuwa (bought, walls). Standings T4: Egypt 1.68 (took Tamassos, Gaza, Tyre, Megiddo, Damascus), Babylonia 1.49, Mitanni 1.21, Hatti 1.17, Arzawa 0.95, Assyria 0.81, Alashiya 0.76. Envoys: c3 Keliya, c4 Artessupa due home T5; travel Mitanni/Arzawa/Alashiya 1 season, Egypt/Babylonia/Assyria 2. Plan: Carchemish T5, Ugarit T6, then Qadesh/Byblos/Amurru; Arzawa only if it weakens.

ledger.entry: T3: k12 sealed (brothers; no troops against each other; Egypt Gaza/Megiddo/Tyre/Byblos/Damascus, Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa; Amurru and Qadesh neither without the other's word). No gold. T4: Egypt has also taken Tamassos from Alashiya; its fleet is in the Great Green. Nonbinding: I take Ugarit and Carchemish now; Qadesh/Amurru maybe later.

value.notes: T4 plan: Hatti broke k1 (army into Seha, my homeland, T3). Retake Seha now: apasa->seha supported by mira (strength 2); lukka->tuwanuwa to CUT the Tuwanuwa army's support of Seha hold (attack comes from lukka, not seha, so the cut is valid), leaving Seha hold 1 vs my 2. Fleet greatgreen->westsea so from T5 it can support a move into seha (apasa+mira+fleet = 3 beats any Seha hold of 2). Risks accepted: Hatti pincer on mira (tuwanuwa+seha support = 2 vs my mira 1) would cut mira's support and lose mira; fleet kizzuwatna + tuwanuwa army could take lukka. Only seha A, tuwanuwa A, kizzuwatna F can reach my land this turn. Money: treasury 110, income 95 (125 if Seha back), upkeep 125, wages 22 when c11/c12 home T5, back pay 48 due on their return. Keep treasury above 40; if short, disband the fleet (saves 35). No letters: both envoys away. c11 (Mitanni answer on alliance vs Hatti) and c12 (Hatti answer to extended peace) due home T5. Hatti is not to be trusted; show k1 as proof of treachery to Mitanni and others. Tamassos is now Egypt's (fleet), so the strike on Alashiya is moot; k10 stays. Wake T5 to read the result and decide: retake tuwanuwa, hire nothing until gold recovers.
value.summary: Arzawa (Tarhundaradu), capital apasa, homeland seha/apasa/mira. Start strength 1300; T4 strength 1012. T1 tried Tuwanuwa and bounced. T2 sealed k1 with Hatti (no troops into each other's homeland, envoys free; Lukka not covered) and took Lukka (now mine, 25, walls gone). k10 sealed with Alashiya T2 (brothers, no ships or troops against each other, warn of harm). T3 Hatti army walked tuwanuwa->seha (breaking k1; k1 is proof, sealed by Hatti) and Hatti raised a new army at Tuwanuwa. Hatti fleet at kizzuwatna. Egypt fleet took Tamassos from Alashiya T3; Alashiya now holds enkomi and amurru. c11 sent T1 to Mitanni proposing alliance against Hatti, due home T5. c12 sent T3 to Hatti with a tablet extending peace to all provinces, due home T5. Units: armies apasa, mira, lukka, fleet. Economy: army upkeep 30, fleet 35, envoy wages 22, back pay owed 48 paid on return. Conquest adds 10 x yield to strength; keep treasury above 40. T4 orders: apasa->seha with mira support, lukka->tuwanuwa to cut Hatti support, fleet to westsea. Ideas: ally with Mitanni (and others) against Hatti; retake Seha, then Tuwanuwa; Ugarit buyable for 400 from Lukka's coast when rich.

ledger.entry: T2: k1 peace sealed (homeland only, Lukka not covered). T3: Hatti army entered Seha, my homeland, breaking k1 (my copy k1 is proof, bears Hatti seal). I sent c12 T3 with a tablet extending peace to all provinces; answer due T5. T4: I strike to retake Seha. Treat Hatti as hostile; show k1 to other courts.
T1: sent c11 proposing alliance against Hatti, sworn tablet offered. c11 due home T5; nothing sealed yet. Hatti's treachery (k1) is a fresh argument for them.

T2: k10 sealed, brothers, no ships or troops against each other, warn of harm. T3: Egypt fleet took Tamassos from them; my strike idea is moot, I keep k10. Could warn them of Egypt and invite common cause against Hatti or Egypt.

value.notes: T4 orders: buy Qadesh (300, borders Mari; walled cities cannot hold troops so only Mari borders it by land: very safe; 10 percent per season return). Gold left about 4, next season income 320 vs upkeep 240 so safe. No hire this turn (no gold). Probe: susa->arbela with ekallatum support (2). If Assyria holds arbela with ashur support (2) it bounces at no cost. Sippar and durkurigalzu support ekallatum hold (4 vs any 2 attack); mari holds. Nippur, ur, babylon hold (babylon army is spare; consider disbanding it to save 30 a season if no use by T6). No envoys at court (c5, c6 due T5). T5 plan: read c6 report on Mitanni's answer to the Assyria division tablet. The key to Assyria: Arbela, Ashur, Nineveh support each other, so I can bring at most 2 into Arbela (susa + ekallatum support) and 1 into Ashur. I need Mitanni terqa->ashur (cuts ashur's support of arbela) in the same season as susa->arbela supported by ekallatum, if Nineveh is empty. Consider a lull: Pirissi asked for a sealed non-aggression tablet; I could send one to relax their guard before a joint strike. Next purchases once gold allows: Carchemish 350, Ugarit 400, Byblos 300 (all become purchasable after Qadesh is mine). Watch: Egypt may bid on Qadesh too (then nobody gets it).
value.summary: Burna-Buriash of Babylonia, start strength 2600, T4 strength 3154 (1.21 growth by ledger; I am 2nd behind Egypt 1.68). Strategy: growth ratio decides. Each purchased city returns 10 percent of its price per season, so buy free cities adjacent to my land (Qadesh, then Carchemish, Ugarit, Byblos); walled cities can hold no troops so they are hard to attack. Conquer Assyria (arbela, ashur, nineveh, yield 110) with Mitanni's help; its three provinces support each other. Taken so far: Ekallatum (T1), Susa (T2), Mari (T3). 8 armies: babylon, durkurigalzu, ekallatum, mari, nippur, sippar, susa, ur; upkeep 240 vs income 290. Mitanni (4 armies) sealed k8 in T2: no troops into each other's homeland, free envoys. Sent c6 in T3 with a tablet dividing Assyria (Nineveh to Mitanni; Arbela and Ashur to me); answer due T5. c5 (Arzawa-born, may defect) went to Egypt in T1, due back T5. Assyria's envoy Pirissi offers status quo and a sealed non-aggression tablet; I gave soft words, no promise. Lessons: a dislodged unit dies; keep supports behind lone forward units; a support is cut by an attack from any province other than the one supported into; do not leak war plans in tablets (spies copy archives). Candidates unhired: Mazipalali c15 (26), Ehli-Teshub c17 (21). Wake every turn while the war lasts.

ledger.entry: T4: Pirissi again offered status quo and a sealed non-aggression tablet if I send my own envoy. I gave soft words, no promise, no tablet, no gold. They hold Arbela, Ashur, Nineveh. T4 I probe Arbela (susa->arbela with ekallatum support). Aim: conquer their homeland, possibly lull them with a tablet first.

T2: k8 sealed (brotherhood, no troops into each other's homeland, free envoys). T3: sent c6 with a tablet dividing Assyria (Nineveh to Mitanni; Arbela and Ashur to me; no separate peace). No gold sent in T3 (40 in T1). Answer due T5 with c6. Need terqa->ashur in step with my arbela strike.

orders.letter: Ashur-uballit of Assyria to my brother Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni. I have your sealed tablet and I honor it before Shamash. Babylonia's army sits in Ekallatum and has taken Mari. I will drive it out. I may strike a little before turn 6 if the road is open, but I will march my army from Ashur into Ekallatum in turn 6 as written, and I ask that your army in Terqa support that move. Once Ekallatum is mine my army there supports your army from Terqa into Mari, in turn 7 as written, or one season sooner if you ask it. Keep your armies in Terqa and Taidu out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur, as the tablet says. Tell me by envoy if Babylonia has written to you, and what Mari's garrison is.
orders.mandate: May confirm the dates already sealed in the tablet and agree to move the Mari strike one season earlier or later. May not promise gold or cede land. No new tablet.

value.notes: T4: Treasury 2. Babylonia has armies in ekallatum (E), susa (S), mari, probably more behind. They probe arbela each turn (S->arbela). Orders: ashur->ekallatum, arbela supports it, nineveh supports arbela hold (arbela hold 2). If S attacks arbela it cuts arbela's support and my attack just bounces, nothing lost. If it succeeds ashur is EMPTY for one turn: at T5 move nineveh->ashur with arbela or ekallatum support (strength 2 beats a Terqa surprise). Do not leave capital empty longer. Mitanni plan (k17): T6 ashur->ekallatum with Terqa support, T7 my ekallatum army supports terqa->mari. If I already hold Ekallatum, just keep to T7 (or offer T6). Sent Ubaru c18 to Mitanni (arrives T5) confirming dates, no gold. Cash: income 110, upkeep 90, wages 36 once c9, c10, c18 are all home: too much. At T5 when c9 (Babylon answer) and c10 (Hatti answer) return, read reports, then dismiss or send away to cut wages; back pay 55 is paid from gold as it comes. Need 100 for a 4th army (raise in empty nineveh). Wake every turn.
value.summary: Ashur-uballit of Assyria. Start 1700, homeland nineveh/arbela/ashur/ekallatum. T1: attacked Terqa (failed); Babylonia took Ekallatum and destroyed my army. Bought Susa T1, Babylonia took it T2. Sealed k4 with Mitanni T2 (no armies into each other's land, no aid to each other's enemy; Mitanni may take Mari/Isuwa/Carchemish/Qadesh, I may take Susa). Sealed k17 with Mitanni T3: in turn 6 my army moves Ashur->Ekallatum with Mitanni's Terqa army supporting; turn 7 my Ekallatum army supports Terqa->Mari; both must move the same season; Mitanni keeps Terqa army until then. Babylonia is the hostile aggressor (strength rating about 1.5): holds ekallatum (army), susa (army), mari (army), sippar, durkurigalzu, nippur, ur, babylon. They keep probing arbela from susa. I have 3 armies: arbela, ashur, nineveh; 3 provinces only (yield 110), strength 1047 vs start 1700. Pirissi c9 sent T3 to Babylonia with a non-aggression offer (private: only a pause), back about T5. Haamashshi c10 sent T1 to Hatti with an alliance proposal, back about T5. Ubaru c18 sent T4 to Mitanni confirming dates. Cash very thin: income 110, upkeep 90 for 3 armies, wages up to 36. Plan: retake Ekallatum, then Mari and Susa with Mitanni's help, raise a 4th army when gold allows, buy free cities that border my land (10 x yield), seek allies in Hatti/Egypt/Arzawa against Babylonia. Never leave the capital Ashur empty beside Terqa for more than a turn. Mitanni's army in Taidu is beside empty-able Nineveh and its Terqa army beside Ashur: a treaty is cheap talk.

ledger.entry: T3: Ubaru returned; Tushratta sealed k17: turn 6 my army Ashur->Ekallatum, Terqa army supports; turn 7 my Ekallatum army supports Terqa->Mari, same-season moves; his Terqa army stays until then; no armies into each other's land. k4 still stands. T4: sent Ubaru to confirm dates; no gold, no new tablet.

orders.letter: Brother Ashur-uballit, may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. The tablet your servant Ubaru brought stands in my archive and I hold to it before Shamash. I confirm the seasons: in turn 6 your army at Ashur moves into Ekallatum and my army at Terqa supports it; in turn 7 your army in Ekallatum supports my army moving from Terqa into Mari. Babylonia holds both Ekallatum and Mari and grows fat on your loss; whoever lets it keep them will find it at the gates of Ashur next. Send word by this envoy whether you keep these seasons, and what your watchers see of Babylonian armies at Sippar and Durkurigalzu. I send a tablet confirming our word; seal it if it pleases you. Mitanni keeps faith with brothers.
orders.mandate: Confirm turn 6 and turn 7 and seal the confirming tablet. He may agree to move both seasons by one season if the king of Assyria asks, but he must not agree to any Mitanni army entering Assyria's land, nor cede any province, nor promise gold. He is to report what Assyria sees of Babylonian armies.

proposal.text: Tablet between Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria, confirming the earlier tablet. In turn 6 the army of Assyria moves from Ashur into Ekallatum and the army of Mitanni in Terqa supports that move. In turn 7 the army of Assyria in Ekallatum supports the army of Mitanni moving from Terqa into Mari. Then Ekallatum is held by Assyria and Mari by Mitanni, and neither sends an army into the land of the other. Sealed before Shamash.

value.notes: T4: Sealed k18 with Hatti (homelands only; Isuwa/Carchemish unsettled) and k20 with Babylonia (Nineveh mine; Arbela+Ashur theirs; no separate peace with Assyria). Orders: harran supports isuwa walls (1+1=2 bounces Hatti max 2 from kanesh+sapinuwa), washukanni supports terqa (Babylon at ekallatum+mari could hit terqa with 2), taidu and terqa hold. Sent Mane (c7) to Assyria with a confirming tablet: T6 ashur->ekallatum with my terqa support, T7 their ekallatum army supports my terqa->mari, then raise army in terqa. Assyria plan hurts Babylon (leader 1.49) and gives me Mari 35; it cuts across k20 in spirit, so tell Babylon nothing. If Assyria does not confirm by T6, cancel the T6/T7 moves. T5: Tattamaru (c8) returns; send him to Arzawa to explain the Hatti peace (homeland-only, Isuwa still contested) and urge Arzawa to keep pressing Hatti. Gold: 172, net about +36 a turn; target buy of Carchemish (350) around T9 unless Mari falls first. Armies cost 30 each: do not raise more unless a conquest needs it. Do not trust Hatti or Babylon fully.
value.summary: Tushratta of Mitanni. Home harran, washukanni (capital), taidu, terqa; also isuwa (bought T3, walls, cannot hold troops but I can support its walls). 4 armies, income 175, upkeep 120, wages about 19, net about +36 a turn. Score = 10 x yield + gold - back pay; start 1950; now 1914. Standings T4: Egypt 1.68 (took tamassos, damascus, tyre, gaza, megiddo), Babylonia 1.49 (holds ekallatum, mari, susa), me 1.21, Hatti 1.17 (holds seha), Arzawa 0.95, Assyria 0.81, Alashiya 0.76. Tablets sealed: k3/k20 Babylonia (peace; Nineveh to me, Arbela+Ashur to Babylon, no separate peace with Assyria); k9/k16 Assyria (non-aggression; joint plan T6 ashur->ekallatum with my terqa support, T7 their ekallatum army supports my terqa->mari); k13 Egypt (brothers, warn if third king moves); k15 Arzawa (sworn alliance, press Hatti, tell each other before peace with Hatti: I sealed k18 with Hatti without telling, must explain); k18 Hatti (peace, homelands only; Ugarit, Lukka and west are Hatti's reach, Mari mine; Isuwa and Carchemish unsettled). Hatti tried kanesh->isuwa T2 and T3; keep supports on isuwa. Rules: attack needs mover plus adjacent supporter; I can only attack Carchemish from harran so cannot take it by force; buy Carchemish for 350 (borders harran/isuwa). Bought walled cities need no garrison and no upkeep, the cheapest growth. Armies cost 30 a turn. Nakhtmin c12 is my secret man in Egypt. People: Mane c7 (11 a season to T12), Tattamaru c8 (8 to T10). Candidates Mazipalali c15 (30), Ehli-Teshub c17 (22), too dear.

ledger.entry: T3/T4: k16 joint action (T6 Ashur->Ekallatum with my Terqa support; T7 their Ekallatum army supports my Terqa->Mari) and k9 non-aggression. T4: sent Mane with a confirming tablet naming turns 6 and 7. Aim: Mari for me, Ekallatum for them. No gold sent. Do not trust fully; Assyria attacked Terqa in T1.

T4: sealed k20 (peace as before; Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash; no separate peace with Assyria). Spoken: Mari left open, Isuwa and north mine. No gold either way (40 gold came T2). Babylon is the leader and holds Ekallatum, Mari, Susa: do not trust fully; my Assyria plan targets its Ekallatum and Mari. Tell Babylon nothing of it.

value.text: Great King, I am Ehli-Teshub, born in Carchemish, where I served many years as a steward in the palace of my lord. I know the keeping of stores, the order of households and the letters of the royal courts, and I have learned to hold my tongue where it is wise. I have no great name, but I am faithful to those who deal fairly with me, and I would serve your house with care and diligence if you will have me.

I am Mazipalali, born in Harran, and for many seasons I led caravans along the roads between the Euphrates and the western cities, so I know the passes, the tolls and the men who keep them. My name is known at more than one royal court, and I have carried the tablets of kings without losing a seal or a sheep. Should the Great King of Hatti have need of an agent who can read a road and keep his counsel, I am ready to serve him faithfully, and I ask thirty shekels for each season.

I am Haamashshi, born in Memphis, and I have served as interpreter at more than one royal court. Your servants will remember that I carried the words of the Great King of Assyria into your presence, and that I was received by you in the season of the third year. I know the speech of the Assyrian and Hittite houses and will carry your words faithfully and bring back what is said to you. Let the king employ me as envoy or interpreter, and I will serve him as long as my service is honoured.

My lord, I have returned from the court of Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, and I bring you his answer. I spoke your words to him exactly as you gave them, and he heard them. He says: all goes well with him, and may all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. As our fathers were brothers, so we are. He has sealed your tablet, and I bear it home as witness that peace and free passage for our envoys are written between our houses. He promises gifts to follow as his house permits, in measure with what you send, and he asks that your envoys pass to him often. The gifts are promised only; none are in my hands. The court of Egypt is rich, my lord.

My lord Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, your servant Keliya returns from Alashiya and greets you: may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I stood before the Great King of Alashiya and spoke your words as they were given to me. He sealed the tablet of brotherhood and swore that his ships and troops will keep from Ugarit as yours keep from his island, and that he keeps to the split: Qadesh, Byblos and Damascus are his concern, Carchemish and Isuwa are yours. He warns that Egypt's fleet took Tamassos from him last season though he had asked Egypt to keep out, and he asks you to send him word at once if Egypt's ships or envoys speak to you of the Cilician Sea or of his island. On your behalf I promised that no ship or troop of Hatti goes against Enkomi or Tamassos, and that you will send him word before any quarrel. The sealed tablet is in my keeping and I bring it home to you.

To my lord Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, from your servant Paser. I came to the court of Great King Tushratta of Mitanni and gave him your word whole. He answered that all goes well with him, his household and his country, and he sealed your tablet gladly. The tablet is sealed by both kings: brothers, no troops against each other's lands, each warns the other when a third king advances, and envoys and news shall pass between Egypt and Mitanni. He asks that your next envoy bring gold in plenty, and solid wood, not gilded wood, as was once promised to his father. I told him I can promise no gold; I carry his asking to you, and your answer must come by your envoy. At his court I noted 4 army and 0 fleet near the capital. Tulubri, envoy of Arzawa, and Ubaru, envoy of Assyria, were also present. May all go well with you, your household and your country.

To my lord, the Great King of Alashiya, from your servant Ili-iddina: I went to the court of Egypt and gave its king your greeting and your words. I told him of your thanks for his envoy's words, of your wish for peace and open ports between our lands, and of the ship that tried the harbor of Tamassos and was turned back, which you call a captain's error and make no complaint of. I showed him your tablets of brotherhood with the Great King of Hatti and the King of Arzawa, and I asked that his ships and troops keep out of Tamassos and Enkomi, that yours keep out of the Delta, Sinai and his coast, and that the merchants of both ports trade in peace. He asks no gold of you, and he sends none with me. He answered that he has seen your tablets, that Egypt desires good order on the sea and peace for the merchants of every port, and that he will weigh your request with his counsellors and answer by his own envoy and tablet. I bade him farewell in your name and he bade me go in peace. I await your word.

My lord Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, I went before Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, and gave your words as you spoke them. He heard them, bade me say that all goes well with him and his household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country, and sealed your tablet before Shamash and Teshub. His answer is this: Hatti takes Carchemish, Ugarit and Lukka; Mitanni takes Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus and Amurru. Neither hinders the other, neither sends an army into the other's homeland, and neither aids the other's enemy. His army will no longer press on Isuwa, and your army at Harran is to stay out of Carchemish and Kanesh, while envoys pass freely. At his court I noticed that Hatti keeps four bodies of army and one fleet near its capital. I carry the sealed tablet home and humbly await your favour, my lord.

My lord Tarhundaradu, Great King of Arzawa, I have come back from the court of Hatti as you commanded. Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, greets you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country, and says he has heard your words and has sealed your tablet. Peace holds between our crowns in every province each of us holds, Lukka and Seha River Land included; neither shall send troops against the other's land, and our envoys shall pass freely as before. He says his eyes are on the east, as you have seen.

My lord Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria, I went to the court of Karduniash and gave your greeting and your proposal to the Great King Burna-Buriash, as you bade me. He greets you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses, and he desires quiet roads between brothers. He holds Ekallatum, Mari and Susa, and he would make no promise on Arbela, Nineveh or Ashur, saying your armies at Arbela have turned his men from the road. He weighs your words and will send his own envoy to you with his answer. I committed you, my lord, only to seal a tablet of mutual non-aggression on the present borders when his envoy comes; I promised no gold, no province and no claim to Ekallatum. The court of Babylonia lives comfortably. I beg you to remember the twenty shekels still owed to your servant, and I await your word.

My lord Tarhundaradu, I came before Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and gave him your words as you spoke them. He answered that all goes well with him, his household, his wives, his sons, his chariots, his horses and his country, and that he has seen Hatti's army for himself at Isuwa. He has sealed your tablet before Shamash and Teshub. Neither of you shall attack the other, and neither shall make peace with Hatti without first telling the other. He will keep his armies on his eastern and northern roads, and his claim on Isuwa and Carchemish stands. He asks you to press Hatti hard at the borders of Lukka, Tuwanuwa and Mira, so that her armies are drawn away from Kanesh and Isuwa. He asks for word from you each season of what Hatti's armies do, and he will send the same to you; he also asks that envoys pass freely between your courts. At his court I noticed that Mitanni keeps 4 army and no fleet near its capital, and Ubaru, envoy of Assyria, was also present. The tablet is sealed and I have kept nothing of its words back from you.

My lord Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, I, your humble servant Kidin-Adad, have returned from the court of Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and lay before you what passed. I gave him your greeting, your pleasure at his word of friendship, and your account of the Assyrian matter: the army standing at Ashur, the force turned back from Nineveh toward Arbela, Arbela left empty, and your hold of Ekallatum and Susa. He sealed the tablet as written: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash, no separate peace with Assyria, and the roads between our two lands kept open. He would speak of Mari only when the Assyrian matter is done, saying your troops hold it now and his road through Terqa stays open to you. He claims Isuwa, which he holds by purchase, and the northern roads as his own. I told him I cannot answer for you on Mari or Isuwa, having no commission to settle them, and that I would lay his words before you and pray you answer him swiftly. At his court I noticed that Mitanni keeps four companies of army and no fleet near its capital. I bring the sealed tablet before you now.

To my lord Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, your servant Sin-iqisham speaks. May it go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. I went to the court of Hatti and gave your words to Suppiluliuma, its king. He saw your tablet and sealed it: the two of you are brothers, neither sends troops against the other's land, Hatti holds Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa, and Egypt holds Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Byblos and Damascus. Envoys shall pass freely in both lands, and Egypt is to send word before any quarrel arises. I carry the sealed tablet home to you. At Hatti I saw three companies of the army and one fleet kept near the capital, and the court there lives in comfort. Your servant asks that my lord remember his faithful service.

To my lord Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria, from your servant Haamashshi: I came to the gate of Suppiluliuma of Hatti and gave him your words as they were written. He hears you gladly, and he agrees to peace between our houses, neither raising a hand against the other, with envoys passing freely at both gates.
