He accepts your division: Harran and Isuwa to Hatti, Terqa and Taidu to Assyria, and Washukanni to be settled between us when the time comes. He counts Carchemish within Hatti's reach, and since my lord did not name it, I could not bind you to it and have brought that question back. He binds himself to no troops or gold, but he will weigh a tablet in his own form, sent with your envoy to his gate, for sealing. He warns that whoever strikes first at Terqa will find Hatti watching, and not unfriendly. Hatti keeps three armies and one fleet near its capital, and its court lives comfortably.

My lord, Great King of Alashiya, I have returned from the court of Hatti and give you the words as they were given. Suppiluliuma wishes all well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. He thanks you for your words and for the word of the sea, and he will send no army or ship against Enkomi or Tamassos. He will not invite your ships into Kizzuwatna's harbor, and he asks that Lukka and its coast stay out of your bids and your ships. He asks that you send word of Egypt's fleet and of every move of his along the coast; in return he will send word of his land moves on his southern border. Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa are to be his, and Qadesh, Byblos and Damascus yours, for Amurru is already yours. In your name, and as my mandate allowed, I agreed to this division in words only: Alashiya will not bid for Ugarit, Carchemish or Isuwa, its ships will stay out of Kizzuwatna's harbor unless Hatti invites them, calm shall hold in the Cilician Sea, and you will send word of Egypt's fleet and its moves along the coast. Concerning Lukka I have no mandate and promised nothing; I carried his request home exactly as he made it. At his court I noticed that Hatti keeps four armies and one fleet near its capital.

My lord Suppiluliuma, I am home and give you the king's answer as he spoke it. Great King Tushratta, your brother, wishes all well to your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. He seals the tablet as written: peace between Hatti and Mitanni, no troops into each other's homeland, envoys passing freely, and a word between us should Assyria or Babylon trouble either of us. He holds that Ugarit, Lukka and the western coast are within your reach and that Mari is his. He also says that Isuwa has opened its gates to him and accepted his gold and his rule, so that it is his by the city's own choice, and that brothers do not send armies against a brother's cities. Of Carchemish he said only that we may speak of it later. I told him that I am not empowered to speak of Isuwa or Carchemish and dared not answer for you in them, and that you would hear his words from my mouth as he spoke them. I think, my lord, that his claim upon Isuwa is a matter for your attention. I carry the sealed tablet home. At his court Mitanni keeps four companies of troops and no fleet near its capital, and Kidin-Adad, envoy of Babylonia, was also there.

value.speech: Tarhundaradu, Great King, king of Arzawa, my lord Napkhururiya bids me speak to you as his brother. Egypt wishes your household, your sons, your chariots and your country well. The fathers kept peace and trade between our lands, and he would keep it so. Egypt looks to the Levant and the Nile, not to the western sea. He proposes a short tablet of peace and free passage for our envoys, and asks that you send your envoys to him often. I bring the tablet for your seal: between Arzawa and Egypt there is brotherhood and peace; neither shall march troops into the other's homeland, and their envoys shall pass freely.

Thus speaks my lord Ashur-uballit, Great King, to you, his brother Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni. He has your sealed tablet and honours it before Shamash. Babylonia's army sits in Ekallatum and has taken Mari, and my lord will drive it out. He may strike a little before turn 6 if the road is open, but he will march from Ashur into Ekallatum in turn 6 as written, and asks that your army in Terqa support that move. Once Ekallatum is his, his army there will support your march from Terqa into Mari in turn 7 as written, or one season sooner if you ask it. Keep your armies in Terqa and Taidu out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur, as the tablet says. Tell him by envoy whether Babylonia has written to you, and what garrison Mari holds.

Great King Ashur-uballit, king of Assyria, my lord's brother, Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, sends these words by my mouth: may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. His tablet brought by your servant Ubaru stands in his archive, and he holds to it before Shamash. He confirms the seasons: in turn six your army at Ashur enters Ekallatum while his army at Terqa supports it, and in turn seven your army in Ekallatum supports his army marching from Terqa into Mari. Babylon holds Ekallatum and Mari and grows fat on your loss, and whoever lets it keep them will find it at the gates of Ashur next. He asks that you send word by me whether you keep these seasons, and what your watchers see of Babylonian armies at Sippar and Durkurigalzu. I bring a tablet confirming their word; he asks that you seal it if it pleases you, for Mitanni keeps faith with brothers.

Pihhuniya, tell Napkhururiya, my brother, that Tarhundaradu receives his words gladly and wishes him, his household, sons, chariots and horses well. I seal the tablet of brotherhood and peace: no troops into each other's homeland, and envoys pass freely. I look to the west and the Hatti border, not to the Nile. I would see the peace also cover Lukka, which is mine, and I will send my own envoy to your court when my treasury allows.

Say to Ashur-uballit, my brother: all goes well with me, my household, sons, chariots and country. The tablet stands before Shamash. In turn 6 my army in Terqa will support your march from Ashur into Ekallatum, as written. In turn 7 your army in Ekallatum supports my march from Terqa into Mari, as written; I do not ask it sooner, for my Terqa army is bound to your move in turn 6. Do not strike before turn 6 without a sure road, for a bounce warns Babylon. My watchers saw one Babylonian army holding in Mari and one in Ekallatum, which is how they held against you before. Babylon has written me only brotherhood, nothing that binds my hand against you. My army in Taidu stays out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur. My envoy Mane brings you my confirming tablet with the turns named; seal it and send him home.

Brother Tushratta, may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. I keep the seasons before Shamash: in turn six my army at Ashur enters Ekallatum with your Terqa army supporting, and in turn seven my army in Ekallatum supports your army from Terqa into Mari. I seal your tablet. My watchers see Babylonian armies at Ekallatum, Susa and Mari. Last season Ekallatum held against me with strength three, so Sippar and Durkurigalzu lend it support. Your Terqa army must therefore stand ready and support exactly in turn six, not a season sooner or later, and my Arbela army will add its support to the same move. Let your lord keep the Terqa army in place until then, and let no army of either house enter the land of the other. Send me word by your next envoy of anything you see at Mari.

Great King Tarhundaradu, king of Arzawa, I bear your words to my lord Napkhururiya, and I shall tell him that you receive his brotherly greeting gladly and wish him, his household, sons, chariots and horses well. The tablet of brotherhood and peace bears your seal: no troops shall enter each other's homeland, and envoys shall pass freely. Concerning Lukka I have no power to speak for my lord; I shall carry your wish to him faithfully, and I trust he will answer it as a brother should.
value.commitments: The sealed tablet of brotherhood and peace between Egypt and Arzawa: no troops into each other's homeland, and free passage for envoys. Nothing promised concerning Lukka or any third land.

value.speech: Great King Ashur-uballit, I hear your words and I carry your answer home. Before Shamash you keep the seasons: in turn six your army at Ashur enters Ekallatum with the Terqa army supporting it, and in turn seven your army in Ekallatum supports the march from Terqa into Mari. I confirm the same for my lord Tushratta. I take your sealed tablet back to him, with your word of the Babylonian armies at Ekallatum, Susa and Mari, and your request for word of what is seen at Mari.
value.commitments: On behalf of Tushratta, Mitanni confirms turn six and turn seven as the king of Assyria has stated them. The army at Terqa stays in place, stands ready and supports exactly in turn six, neither sooner nor later. No army of Mitanni enters the land of Assyria.

value.speech: Thus my lord Ashur-uballit answers, his brother Tushratta: he is glad that all goes well with you, your household, sons, chariots, horses and country. The tablet sealed before Shamash stands and he honours it: in turn 6 his army marches from Ashur into Ekallatum, and in turn 7 his army in Ekallatum supports your march from Terqa into Mari, as written and not sooner. I have no charge to receive a new tablet, so I cannot seal the one Mane carries, but I will bear your word home faithfully. As for a strike before turn 6, my lord will judge the road himself, and I do not answer for it.
value.commitments: Confirmed the sealed dates only: Ashur into Ekallatum in turn 6, and the Ekallatum army to support the Mari march in turn 7, as written. No new tablet sealed; no gold or land promised; no promise on any strike before turn 6.

orders.letter: Tushratta, my brother: Tarhundaradu thanks you for sealing our oath before Shamash and Teshub. Word of Hatti as you asked: one army stands in Tuwanuwa, one in Kizzuwatna, and a fleet in the Cilician Sea; I have not seen Hattusa or Kanesh. Hatti once broke his peace and sent an army into my homeland at Seha; I destroyed it and took Seha back. In honesty, as our oath asks: Hatti sought a short peace for my lands and I sealed it only to hold his armies off my coast. It binds me to nothing, and this very season I press Tuwanuwa. I ask that you press Hatti in the east in the same season. My war drains my treasury; send gold to my court as brothers do.
orders.mandate: May agree to joint pressure on Hatti, to a seasonal exchange of word on Hatti's armies, and to free passage of envoys; may receive gold. May not give gold, cede land or promise troops beyond the oath.

orders.letter: Napkhururiya, my brother: Tarhundaradu thanks you for the tablet of brotherhood, now sealed on both sides. As I said, I send my own envoy. Lukka is my province on the coast, taken from no brother of yours; I ask that Egypt's ships keep from it as from my homeland, and the tablet I send says so. Hatti troubles my borders and my treasury is thin with the war. Gold flows in Egypt like sand; send what a brother sends, and I shall remember it. Send your envoys to me often.
orders.mandate: May seal the tablet brought, may agree to free passage of envoys and exchange of word, and may receive gold. May not cede land or promise troops against anyone.

proposal.text: Between Arzawa and Egypt there is brotherhood and peace. Neither will march troops or send ships into any province held by the other, Lukka included, nor into the homeland of the other, and their envoys shall pass freely.

value.notes: T5 plan: Seha retaken T4 (Hatti army there destroyed). Hatti sealed k34 (peace incl. Lukka) at T4 audience yet put army at kizzuwatna and fleet at cilicia, both next to Lukka: a threat posture. Tuwanuwa held by one Hatti army; unseen armies may stand at hattusa/kanesh. T5 orders: seha->tuwanuwa, mira and lukka support it, westsea fleet supports lukka hold (so Lukka holds 2 even if its own support is cut). If Hatti hits Lukka with kizzuwatna+cilicia (2) it bounces at 2. Downside of a bounce is small: units only cost upkeep. This breaks k34 which I sealed last season; Hatti broke k1 first (my proof). Money: treasury 40, income 125 = upkeep 125; wages are saved while envoys are away. Tablet to Egypt costs 20. If cash gets short disband the fleet (35). Sent c11 to Mitanni (report on Hatti armies, honest disclosure of k34, ask joint pressure and gold) and c12 to Egypt (tablet extending peace to Lukka, ask gold). Both due home about T9. Wake T6 to read the battle. If Tuwanuwa is mine: keep seha/mira/lukka garrisoned, next look at hattusa (50) if Hatti is empty; consider a spy at tuwanuwa. Never let treasury fall under 20.
value.summary: Arzawa (Tarhundaradu), capital apasa, homeland seha/apasa/mira, plus Lukka (25, taken T2). Start strength 1300; T5 strength 1290. Treaties: k1 Hatti peace T2 (Hatti broke it T3 by entering Seha), k10 Alashiya brotherhood T2, k29 Mitanni sworn alliance T3 (both press Hatti, neither makes peace with Hatti without telling the other), k34 Hatti peace T4 incl. Lukka (Hatti sealed it yet keeps army at kizzuwatna and fleet at cilicia), k35 Egypt brotherhood T5 (homelands only; Lukka not covered). Egypt is the leader (1.92), holds Tamassos/Enkomi/Levant; Alashiya nearly dead (amurru only). Hatti lost an army at Seha T4; it keeps armies at tuwanuwa and kizzuwatna, fleet cilicia. Mitanni keeps 4 armies near its capital, claims Isuwa and Carchemish, asks me to press Hatti at Lukka/Tuwanuwa/Mira and for seasonal word on Hatti armies. Economy: income 125, upkeep 125 (3 armies, 1 fleet), envoy wages 22 when both at court, back pay paid on return. Targets: Tuwanuwa 30, then Hattusa 50, Kanesh 35, Kizzuwatna 35, Sapinuwa 30; Ugarit buyable for 400. Units only cost upkeep; a bounce costs nothing. Envoys c11 (Taidu, copper trader) and c12 (Thebes, soldier) serve through T8.

ledger.entry: T5: sealed k35 brotherhood/peace (homelands, envoys free); Lukka not covered. T5 sent c12 with a new tablet covering Lukka and all provinces, and a request for gold. Egypt took Tamassos and Enkomi: expansionist, watch my coast. No gold sent or received.

T2 k1 broken by Hatti (T3 army into Seha); k34 sealed T4 (no troops into any province incl. Lukka) but Hatti keeps army at kizzuwatna and fleet at cilicia next to Lukka. T5 I attack Tuwanuwa, breaking k34 (Hatti broke k1 first). Hostile. Show k1 as proof.

k29 sworn alliance T3: neither attacks the other, both press Hatti, neither makes peace with Hatti without telling the other. T5 sent c11: Hatti army report, honest word about k34, strike on Tuwanuwa, ask for joint pressure and gold. Mitanni wants seasonal word on Hatti armies.

orders.letter: To Arzawa, my brother: may all go well with you, your household, sons, chariots and horses. Egypt took Tamassos and then Enkomi, my capital, with two fleets that hold each other up, though I asked it to keep out. I hold only Amurru. Egypt stands far above every king and now has ships a few days from Lukka and Apasa. By our tablet we warn each other: this is my warning. Your fleet in the Great Green is one move from Tamassos. To break two linked fleets you need three ships: one to strike Enkomi and cut its support, one to strike Tamassos, one to support it. I ask Hatti, whose fleet is in the Cilician Sea, to join you. Any province of mine you free, I ask you to return to me; I will pay 150 shekels for each when it is in my hands. I have no ships left, only my word. Tell me by your envoy what you will do, and what you see of Egypt's ships.
orders.mandate: May agree to seal a tablet of joint action against Egypt's ships in Cyprus; may promise 150 shekels for each of Tamassos and Enkomi returned to me, paid only on receipt; may promise to send word of Egyptian fleet moves. May not give gold now, cede Amurru, or promise ships or troops (I have none).

proposal.text: Arzawa and Alashiya are brothers. Each warns the other of Egypt's fleets. Arzawa will strike Egypt's ships in Tamassos and Enkomi when Hatti or another king joins, and any province of Alashiya so freed it returns to Alashiya, which pays 150 shekels for each on receipt.

orders.letter: To Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, my brother: may all go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. I have your word: no ship against Enkomi or Tamassos. Egypt took both, Tamassos first and then my capital, and holds them with two fleets that support each other, a day from Kizzuwatna. I keep my word on Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa; they are yours, I bid for none. The runaway king is Egypt, and Cyprus is its door into your coast. Your fleet in the Cilician Sea is one move from both. Arzawa's fleet in the Great Green is one move from Tamassos; I have asked Arzawa to join you. To break two linked fleets you need three ships. Any province you free I ask you to return to me; I pay 150 shekels for each on receipt. As promised: Egypt's ships stood in Tamassos and Enkomi, with others in the Levantine Sea. I claim nothing of Egypt's coast cities beyond Cyprus; they are yours to take.
orders.mandate: May agree to seal a tablet of joint action against Egypt's ships in Cyprus; may promise 150 shekels for each of Tamassos and Enkomi returned to me, paid only on receipt; may agree to trade word of Egypt's moves. May not give gold now, cede Amurru, or promise ships or troops (I have none).

proposal.text: Hatti and Alashiya are brothers. Each sends the other word of Egypt's fleets. Hatti will strike Egypt's ships in Tamassos and Enkomi when Arzawa or another king joins, and any province of Alashiya so freed it returns to Alashiya, which pays 150 shekels for each on receipt. Alashiya bids for none of Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa.

value.notes: T5: Lost fleet and Enkomi T4 (Egypt F levantsea->enkomi, F tamassos supporting). I hold only Amurru (20/season, walls, cannot garrison). Treasury 235. No units; cannot levy until I hold Tamassos or Enkomi again AND it is empty after movement. Province passes to whoever has a unit standing in it, so I need an ally to take it and CEDE it to me (cession fails if their troops still stand in it), then I raise a unit there at once. Strength math: buying a city is strength-neutral (gold -10y, yield +10y), so only recovering Enkomi (45) and Tamassos (40) can move my ratio (+850). Egypt's two fleets in tamassos/enkomi support each other (hold 2): breaking them needs three fleets (one attacks enkomi to cut its support, one attacks tamassos, third supports from cilicia/greatgreen). Sent c14 to Arzawa and c13 to Hatti with a tablet each: they strike Egypt's ships in Cyprus, any province freed is returned to me, I pay 150 shekels per province on receipt only. No gold sent now. Both envoys home T7: read answers. Expect Egypt's own envoy (promised answer by envoy and tablet): listen, keep Amurru safe, ask Egypt to leave Amurru alone. Money: wages 23 while both at court exceed my income 20; dismiss both after they return unless a mission is needed. If I get a province back: raise an army (100) there at once, ask allies to support its hold. Never bid on Byblos/Ugarit with Hatti or Egypt bidding (contested = sold to none); Ugarit is promised to Hatti in words.
value.summary: Alashiya, smallest kingdom (start 1200). T1 bought Amurru (walls, 20 yield, cannot garrison). T2 k5 with Arzawa (no ships/troops against each other, warn of any king planning harm). T2 k11 with Hatti (peace, word before quarrel). T4 k19 with Hatti (Ugarit in Hatti's reach; Hatti sends nothing against Enkomi/Tamassos; word before quarrel). Verbal deal via c14: I will not bid for Ugarit, Carchemish, Isuwa (Hatti's); I keep Qadesh/Byblos/Damascus in words (Babylonia now holds Qadesh, Egypt Damascus); my ships stay out of Kizzuwatna harbor; I send Hatti word of Egypt's fleets; Hatti sends word of land moves on its southern border. Hatti asks Lukka stay out of my bids (Lukka is Arzawa's). Egypt fleets took Tamassos (T3) and Enkomi (T4) despite my envoy's plea; my fleet was destroyed. I hold only Amurru; treasury 235, income 20, no units. Hatti keeps four armies and one fleet near its capital; Hatti fleet at cilicia, Arzawa fleet at greatgreen. T5 plan: coalition against Egypt (1.9 growth, the runaway leader) to free Tamassos/Enkomi and cede them to me for 150 each on receipt; envoys c14 (to Arzawa) and c13 (to Hatti) home T7. Egypt promised an answer by its own envoy and tablet.

ledger.entry: T4 Egypt took Enkomi (F levantsea, F tamassos supporting) after taking Tamassos T3; hostile-opportunist, took both despite my pleas. Nothing sealed, no gold either way. c13 asked at Egypt (T4) that fleets keep out of Tamassos/Enkomi; Egypt said it will weigh and answer by its own envoy and tablet. T5: I sent nothing; will hear its envoy.

k11 T2, k19 T4 sealed (peace; Ugarit in Hatti's reach; word before quarrel). Verbal city split via c14: Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa, I Qadesh/Byblos/Damascus; I send word of Egypt's fleets. T5: sent c13 asking Hatti to strike Egypt's fleets in Cyprus with Arzawa and return freed provinces to me for 150 shekels each on receipt, tablet offered. No gold sent.

k5 sealed T2 (no ships or troops against each other, warn of harm). No gold given. T5: sent c14 with a warning that Egypt's fleets sit in Cyprus, asking Arzawa's fleet at greatgreen to join Hatti in freeing Tamassos/Enkomi and return them to me for 150 shekels each on receipt, tablet offered. No gold sent.

orders.letter: Say to Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, my brother: all goes well with me, my household, my wives, my sons, my chariots, my horses and my country. May all go well with you. The tablet we sealed stands before Shamash and Amun: brothers, no troops against each other's lands, a warning if a third king moves. In that spirit I ask two things. First, let us mark our reach so no quarrel rises between brothers: Egypt keeps Damascus, Tyre, Gaza, Megiddo and the south; Mitanni keeps Isuwa, Carchemish, Qadesh and Mari; neither hinders the other there. Second, send me gold, brother. In your land gold is as common as dust, and my father received great gifts from yours; let yours to me be no smaller, and of pure gold, not gilded wood. As a brother I warn you: Karduniash grows stronger than any king and holds Ekallatum, Mari, Susa and Qadesh; Hatti keeps many armies near its capital. Send your answer and your gold with my envoy Tattamaru.
orders.mandate: May seal the tablet of reaches (Egypt: Damascus, Tyre, Gaza, Megiddo, Sinai, the Nile lands and Cyprus; Mitanni: Isuwa, Carchemish, Qadesh, Mari). May concede Byblos and Amurru to Egypt if pressed. Promise no gold and no troops. Bring home all gold Egypt sends, with its inventory.

proposal.text: Egypt and Mitanni mark their reach as brothers. Egypt: Damascus, Tyre, Gaza, Megiddo, Sinai, the Nile lands and Cyprus. Mitanni: Isuwa, Carchemish, Qadesh and Mari. Neither hinders the other in these lands, and neither sends troops against the other's. Each warns the other if a third king moves against him. Sealed before Shamash and Amun.

value.notes: T5: Ubaru (Assyria) confirmed k16: T6 Ashur->Ekallatum with my Terqa support, T7 their Ekallatum army supports my Terqa->Mari. If Babylon backs Ekallatum from Mari it is 2v2 and bounces; check at T6/T7 before committing. Orders T5: harran supports isuwa (Hatti max 2 vs walls1+1), washukanni supports terqa (Babylon ekallatum+mari could hit terqa with 2), taidu and terqa hold. Sent Tattamaru (c8) to Egypt: asks reach-tablet (Egypt keeps Damascus/Tyre/Gaza/Megiddo/south; Mitanni keeps Isuwa/Carchemish/Qadesh/Mari) and gold. Mane (c7) back about T6: then send him to Arzawa to explain the Hatti peace (k15 duty) and urge them to keep pressing Hatti. PLAN T6/T7: instead of raising a 5th army (100 + 30/turn) after terqa->mari, move washukanni->terqa (washukanni is interior and safe empty) and drop the raise_army in terqa. Gold plan: hoard to 350, buy Carchemish (~T8-9) but k33 gave it to Hatti, weigh Hatti's anger; Ugarit 400 next if Hatti does not. Do not trust Babylon or Hatti fully.
value.summary: Tushratta of Mitanni. Home harran, washukanni (capital), taidu, terqa; isuwa (bought T3, walls, cannot hold troops, I support its walls). 4 armies; income 175, upkeep 120, wages about 19, net about +36. Score = 10 x yield + gold - back pay; start 1950; T5 1930. T5 standings: Egypt 1.92 (akhetaten, damascus, delta, enkomi, gaza, megiddo, memphis, sinai, tamassos, thebes, tyre), Babylonia 1.64 (babylon, durkurigalzu, ekallatum, mari, nippur, qadesh, sippar, susa, ur), Arzawa 1.25, me 1.21, Hatti 1.00, Assyria 0.81, Alashiya 0.24 (only amurru). Buying a walled free city is strength-neutral at once and then pays its yield every turn: best use of gold. Free cities left: byblos, carchemish (350, borders harran/isuwa), ugarit (400). Walled cities cannot hold troops, so force against them is nearly impossible: purchase is the way. Tablets: k3/k20 Babylon (peace; Nineveh to me, Arbela+Ashur to Babylon; no separate peace with Assyria); k9/k16 Assyria (T6 ashur->ekallatum with my terqa support, T7 their ekallatum army supports my terqa->mari); k13 Egypt (brothers, warn); k15 Arzawa alliance (I owe an explanation of the Hatti peace); k18/k33 Hatti (peace, homelands only; Hatti may take Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; I may take Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru; Hatti army to stop pressing Isuwa; my harran army to stay out of Carchemish/Kanesh; Hatti has 4 armies+fleet near its capital). Washukanni is interior and safe empty. People: Mane c7 (11 a season to T12), Tattamaru c8 (8 to T10), Nakhtmin c12 my secret man in Egypt. Candidates c15 (30), c17 (22) too dear.

ledger.entry: T5: sent Tattamaru (c8) with a tablet proposing reaches (Egypt: Damascus, Tyre, Gaza, Megiddo, south; Mitanni: Isuwa, Carchemish, Qadesh, Mari) and asking for pure gold, no gift sent. k13 stands (brothers, warn). Nakhtmin c12 is my man there. Reply expected about T9.

T5: Tattamaru brought home k33 (sealed T4): Hatti may take Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; I may take Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru; no armies into homelands; no aiding the other's enemy. Plus k18 (peace). Hatti says it stops pressing Isuwa; my harran army stays out of Carchemish and Kanesh. No gold either way. Buying Carchemish would cut across k33: weigh it. Keep harran supporting isuwa.

orders.letter: Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria, wishes well to my brother the pharaoh, his household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. Karduniash has grown greedy: it holds Ekallatum, Susa and Mari and presses my borders. What it gains from me today it will take from Egypt's Qadesh and Damascus tomorrow. I propose friendship between our houses, and that if Karduniash marches on one of us the other hinders it and takes what it can. Gold in your land is as dust, brother. Send me gold, as is given between brothers, that I may raise chariots and armies and keep the roads quiet. Your gift will be read as the measure of your respect for the place I hold beside Mitanni and Babylon. Send word of what you see of Karduniash's armies at Qadesh and Mari.
orders.mandate: May pledge friendship and that Assyria will press Babylonia, and that Assyria will not attack Egypt or its provinces. May accept any gold and carry it home, and may seal a friendship tablet that Egypt brings. No gold, no province, no troops from me, and no claim on any Egyptian land.

value.notes: T5: Treasury 0 (nothing can be bought or sealed; scribe fee 20 refused). Net per season: income 110 - upkeep 90 = +20, minus wages: stagnating. Cut wages: decide on c18 (11, term to T7) when he returns T6; c9 (10, term to T8) sent to Egypt (2 seasons each way, back about T9) asking friendship and gold gifts, no tablet, no gold. Orders T5: ashur supports arbela hold, arbela supports ashur hold, nineveh supports arbela hold (Arbela hold 3 vs Babylon max 2; Ashur hold 2). T6 scheduled: ashur->ekallatum, arbela supports it, nineveh supports arbela hold (Mitanni Terqa supports per k36). Ekallatum held at strength 3 last time (2 Babylonian supporters from sippar/durk/mari). My max into Ekallatum is 3 (ashur + arbela + Terqa), and Susa's attack on arbela cuts arbela support, so it will probably bounce: harmless. Wake T6 to re-plan with fresh news. Babylon may send an envoy with a non-aggression answer; Pirissi committed me to seal a tablet on present borders only (no gold, no Ekallatum claim). If their envoy comes: accept peace, it protects Arbela; still intend to retake Ekallatum later. Never leave Ashur empty beside Terqa. T7 support of Terqa->Mari only works if I hold Ekallatum (cannot schedule without a unit there). Hatti wants a tablet in its own form (peace, Carchemish question unresolved). Mitanni treaty is cheap talk: Terqa beside Ashur, Taidu beside Nineveh.
value.summary: Ashur-uballit of Assyria. Start 1700, homeland nineveh/arbela/ashur/ekallatum. T1: attacked Terqa (failed); Babylonia took Ekallatum, destroyed my army. Bought Susa T1, Babylonia took it T2. Sealed k4 with Mitanni T2 (no armies into each other's land, no aid to each other's enemy; Mitanni may take Mari/Isuwa/Carchemish/Qadesh, I may take Susa). k17 T3 and k36 T5 with Mitanni: T6 my Ashur army to Ekallatum with Terqa army supporting; T7 my Ekallatum army supports Terqa->Mari. Babylonia (rating about 1.6) holds ekallatum, susa, mari armies, plus sippar, durkurigalzu, nippur, ur, babylon, qadesh; it probes arbela from susa each turn and wants a pause (will send its own envoy; I committed to a non-aggression tablet on present borders only). Hatti (T5 report): accepts peace, neither raises a hand, envoys pass freely; accepts my earlier split (Harran/Isuwa Hatti, Terqa/Taidu Assyria) but counts Carchemish as within its reach; will weigh a tablet in its own form sent with my envoy. Hatti has three armies and one fleet. I have 3 armies (arbela, ashur, nineveh), 3 provinces (yield 110), treasury 0, strength about 1031 vs 1700. Income 110, upkeep 90, so wages must be minimal. Geometry: Ekallatum can only get 3 strength from me (ashur, arbela, Terqa); Taidu and Terqa can only be attacked with strength 1 from my land, so my pocket depends on Ekallatum. Pocket defence: ashur/arbela support each other, nineveh supports arbela. Mitanni armies at Terqa and Taidu border my capital and Nineveh: never leave them empty. Plan: peace with Babylonia, gold gifts from Egypt/others, raise a 4th army (100) when gold allows, retake Ekallatum when its supporters leave.

ledger.entry: T5: sent c9 Pirissi asking friendship, shared pressure on Babylonia and a gold gift (no tablet, no gold sent). Back about T9.

T5: sealed k36 with Mitanni (via Mane): T6 my Ashur army to Ekallatum with Terqa army supporting; T7 my Ekallatum army supports Terqa to Mari. Told Mane Ekallatum held strength 3. No gold sent. Private: Terqa and Taidu armies border Ashur/Nineveh, a treaty is cheap talk; never leave Ashur empty. Watch Mitanni after Mari falls.

orders.letter: Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, to Tushratta my brother: I wish well to you, your household, sons, chariots, horses and land. Your sealed tablet lies in my archive. Isuwa and the northern roads I do not contest. Of Mari I will speak when Assyria is finished; my garrison holds it, and your road through Terqa stays open as mine through Ekallatum stays open to you. Assyria's three provinces prop each other up, so we must strike all at once, in the season of turn 7, before they can be warned. In that season: your army at Terqa supports my army at Ekallatum moving into Ashur; your army at Taidu moves into Nineveh, which cuts its support; my army at Susa moves into Arbela, which cuts Arbela's support. Then Ashur falls to me as sealed, and once it is mine my men will support your army into Nineveh. Tell no one. Send word back by this envoy that you agree and that your orders stand for turn 7.
orders.mandate: May agree to the joint strike in turn 7 as described, or fix another season if Mitanni asks, and may concede Isuwa and the northern roads to Mitanni. May not cede or discuss Mari, Ekallatum or Susa. No gold, no new tablet. Bring back his answer and any plan of his own.

value.notes: T5 orders: hold the ring (ekallatum holds, sippar and durkurigalzu support it = hold 3; susa, mari hold). Disband spare armies babylon, nippur, ur (saves 90 a season; interior is only reachable through ekallatum, susa, mari, and Assyria can bring at most 2 into ekallatum, 1 into susa/mari). Sent c6 to Mitanni with a spoken joint-strike plan for turn 7: terqa supports ekallatum->ashur, taidu->nineveh (cuts its support), susa->arbela (cuts arbela support); Ashur then falls to me with strength 2 vs hold 1. I conceded Isuwa and the northern roads, nothing on Mari. No gold, no tablet (treasury only 10). T6: wake, gold about 180. c6 should be back T7 with his answer: if he agrees, give the T7 orders: ekallatum->ashur, susa->arbela, durkurigalzu->ekallatum (refill), sippar and mari hold. If he refuses or is silent, do not attack; instead buy Byblos (300) then Ugarit (400), Carchemish (350) as gold allows. c5 kept home as a spare envoy (13 a season). Do not send new tablets that leak plans.
value.summary: Burna-Buriash of Babylonia, start strength 2600; T5 strength 3210 (1.23). Egypt is leader (land 365 vs 190). Economy lessons: an army costs 30 a season, equal to the income of a 30-yield province, so idle armies are a big drag; a bought city returns 10 percent of its price per season and walled cities with only walled neighbours cannot be attacked (Qadesh is bought and safe; all its neighbours are walled or mine). Buy order: Byblos 300 (safest), Ugarit 400, Carchemish 350 (exposed to Hatti and Mitanni). Taken: Ekallatum T1, Susa T2, Mari T3, bought Qadesh T4. Sealed tablets: k8 (T2, Mitanni, no troops into each other's homeland), k28 (T3, Egypt brotherhood), k32 (T4, Mitanni: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash, no separate peace with Assyria). Assyria (Arbela, Ashur, Nineveh, 3 armies, broke) holds a mutual-support triangle: hold strength up to 3. I border it only through ekallatum and susa, so I need Mitanni: terqa support for ekallatum->ashur, taidu->nineveh to cut nineveh's support, susa->arbela to cut arbela's support. A support is cut by any attack, even a failed one, from a province other than the one supported into. A dislodged unit dies. Assyria keeps attacking ekallatum (ashur+arbela support, strength 2) against my hold of 3. Candidates unhired: Mazipalali c15 (26), Ehli-Teshub c17 (21). c5 Piyamaradu (Arzawa-born, may defect, term through T7) and c6 Kidin-Adad (term T12). Wake every turn while the war lasts.

ledger.entry: T3 k28 sealed (brotherhood, free envoys, gifts flow). T5 c5 came home: Napkhururiya promises gifts in measure with what I send, none delivered. I have sent no gold. Egypt is the growth leader; stay friendly, watch.

k8 (T2) and k32 (T4) sealed. T5 c6 back: Tushratta sealed k32, claims Isuwa and the northern roads, speaks of Mari only after Assyria is done. T5 I sent c6 again with a spoken joint strike for turn 7 (terqa supports ekallatum->ashur; taidu->nineveh; susa->arbela). Conceded Isuwa and northern roads, not Mari. No gold sent in T3-T5 (40 in T1).

T4 Pirissi offered status quo and a non-aggression tablet; I gave soft words only, no tablet, no gold. They hold Arbela, Ashur, Nineveh and attack Ekallatum each season. Aim: conquer them with Mitanni, strike turn 7.

orders.letter: Brother Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni: may it go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. I have heard through Artessupa what you said, and I am glad of the seal on our peace. Of Isuwa: it is yours by the city's own choice, and no army of Hatti will go against it. Of Carchemish and Ugarit: your own tablet gave them to Hatti, and I ask that they stay so; let no gold of Mitanni buy them and no company of Harran enter them. In return I will not trouble Isuwa, Mari, Qadesh, Damascus or Amurru. I send a short tablet so that this stands plain between us. If Assyria or Babylon move against either of us, let us speak at once.
orders.mandate: Seal the tablet as written. Promise no gold and no troops. Do not concede Carchemish or Ugarit. Listen to what Tushratta says of Babylon, Assyria and Egypt and bring it home.

proposal.text: Tablet between Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, sealed before Shamash and Teshub. Isuwa is the reach of Mitanni and Hatti sends nothing against it. Carchemish and Ugarit are the reach of Hatti; Mitanni neither buys them, nor enters them, nor sends troops against them. Neither king sends an army into the homeland of the other. If Assyria or Babylon trouble either king, the two speak together.

orders.letter: Brother Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt: may it go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. Suppiluliuma of Hatti keeps the tablet of brotherhood we sealed. Ugarit and Carchemish are the reach of Hatti, as the tablet says. I ask that your ships stay out of the Cilician Sea and away from the harbour of Kizzuwatna, and that neither your gold nor your fleet touch Ugarit or Carchemish. In return Hatti sends nothing against Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Byblos or Damascus. I send a short tablet to seal this. Tell me also what Egypt intends toward Alashiya and the Cilician Sea.
orders.mandate: Seal the tablet as written. Promise no gold and no troops. Do not concede Ugarit or Carchemish. Learn what Egypt intends toward Alashiya, Byblos, Amurru and the Western Sea, and bring home what you see of Egypt's army and fleet.

proposal.text: Between Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, and Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, brothers: the tablet of brotherhood stands. Egypt neither buys, takes, nor sends ships or troops against Ugarit or Carchemish, nor against the fleet and coast of Hatti in the Cilician Sea. Hatti neither buys, takes, nor sends troops against Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Byblos or Damascus. Amurru and Qadesh are taken by neither without the other's word.

value.notes: T5 orders: DEFENSIVE this turn. Arzawa (armies lukka, mira, seha; fleet westsea; apasa unseen) broke k22 the same day it sealed it, killed my seha army and took Seha. Max Arzawa strength on tuwanuwa is 3 (one mover + two supporters from seha/mira/lukka), so tuwanuwa holds with kanesh + kizzuwatna support (hold 3 = bounce). Fleet supports kizzuwatna hold; it is exposed to Egypt's two fleets (enkomi, tamassos) at cilicia, accept the risk. Raised an army at hattusa (empty after movement), ready T6; treasury after raise and two tablets about 75, income 180 vs upkeep 155 so about +3 a season. Letters: c4 -> Mitanni with tablet (Isuwa Mitanni's; Carchemish and Ugarit Hatti's; no buying or troops against them). c3 -> Egypt with tablet addendum (Egypt keeps gold and ships off Ugarit/Carchemish; Hatti off Gaza/Megiddo/Tyre/Byblos/Damascus). T6 PLAN: tuwanuwa hold, hattusa army + kanesh support it; take Ugarit with fleet cilicia -> ugarit supported by kizzuwatna army (2 v wall 1), or kizzuwatna army -> ugarit supported by fleet. Then Carchemish: kanesh army -> carchemish with support from kizzuwatna. Bought walled cities cannot hold troops; free cities left (Carchemish 350, Ugarit 400, Byblos) can be bought by Mitanni or Egypt any turn, so seize them with 2 strength soon. Watch hattusa and sapinuwa: empty. Do not trust Arzawa; do not break with Mitanni. I wake T6 to give orders by hand.
value.summary: Suppiluliuma of Hatti. Aim: highest growth vs start 2100 (strength = 10 x yields + gold - back pay). T5: strength 2015, treasury 215, yield 180 (lost Seha T4: army destroyed by Arzawa, which broke k22 the day it sealed it). Armies tuwanuwa, kanesh, kizzuwatna, fleet cilicia; army raised at hattusa T5 (ready T6). Income 180, upkeep 30 per army, 35 fleet. Sealed: k6 Alashiya brotherhood (T2); k12 Egypt brothers (T3; Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa; Egypt Gaza/Megiddo/Tyre/Byblos/Damascus; Amurru+Qadesh neither without other's word); k21 Mitanni (T4; Hatti may take Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; Mitanni Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru); k22 Arzawa (T4, broken by Arzawa); k30 Hatti-Mitanni peace (T4); k31 Alashiya brotherhood (T4; Ugarit Hatti's, no Hatti ships vs Enkomi/Tamassos). Assyria offered alliance vs Mitanni at T3, nothing sealed, keep warm. Bought walled cities (Isuwa Mitanni, Qadesh Babylon, Damascus/Tyre Egypt, Amurru Alashiya) cannot hold troops; a walled city needs move+1 support. Free cities left: Carchemish, Ugarit, Byblos; others can buy them any turn, so seize them fast. Arzawa armies lukka, mira, seha (max 3 on tuwanuwa): keep tuwanuwa hold 3 until I have more armies. Egypt leads (1.92) with Tamassos, Enkomi, Gaza, Tyre, Megiddo, Damascus; Alashiya nearly dead (holds Amurru). Envoys: c4 Artessupa -> Mitanni (back T7), c3 Keliya -> Egypt (back T9). Plan: Ugarit T6, Carchemish T7, more armies as income allows, then retake Seha/Lukka from Arzawa.

ledger.entry: T4: k22 sealed (peace in every province, Lukka and Seha included) but Arzawa took Seha and struck Tuwanuwa from Lukka the same turn. Treacherous: never trust its tablets. Holds Apasa, Lukka, Mira, Seha. No gold sent. Nothing owed either way.

T4: k21 and k30 sealed (Hatti may take Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; Mitanni Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru; no army into the other's homeland). Tushratta says Isuwa opened to him and spoke only vaguely of Carchemish. T5: sent c4 Artessupa with a tablet to seal: Isuwa Mitanni's, Carchemish and Ugarit Hatti's, no buying or troops against them. No gold.

T3: k12 sealed (brothers; no troops against each other's lands). Egypt has since taken Tamassos, Enkomi, Gaza, Tyre, Megiddo, Damascus. T5: sent c3 Keliya with a tablet addendum: Egypt keeps gold and ships off Ugarit and Carchemish and the Cilician Sea; Hatti keeps off Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Byblos, Damascus. No gold.

orders.letter: Say to Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, my brother: all goes well with me; may it go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. I keep the tablet we sealed. As it says, Byblos is Egypt's, and my ships will settle it. Amurru and Qadesh we agreed to touch only with each other's word. Qadesh has been bought by the king of Babylon, who now sits beside Damascus and Byblos; Amurru is the last land of the king of Alashiya, whose fleet is gone. I ask your word that Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh. In return Egypt will send no troops or ships against Ugarit, Carchemish or Hatti's own lands, and leaves those cities to you. Let a tablet say so.
orders.mandate: Agree to seal the tablet: Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh, Hatti may take Ugarit and Carchemish, neither sends troops or ships against the lands the other holds, each warns the other of any king who plans harm. No gold, no Egyptian land, no military aid. Listen to any counter-proposal and bring it home.

proposal.text: Egypt and Hatti are brothers. Hatti gives Egypt its word that Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh, and Egypt gives Hatti its word that Hatti may take Ugarit and Carchemish. Neither sends troops or ships against the lands the other holds, and each will warn the other of any king who plans harm to him.

orders.letter: Say to the Great King of Assyria, my brother: thus says Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt. All goes well with me; may it go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. Egypt and Assyria have never quarrelled and need not. I hear the king of Babylon has grown great on your border. I ask brotherhood between us: no troops against each other's land, envoys to pass freely, and a word of warning from each if a third king moves against the other. Let a tablet say so.
orders.mandate: Agree to seal the tablet of brotherhood: no troops against each other's lands, envoys pass freely, each warns the other if a third king moves against him. No gold, no troops, no land. Listen to what Assyria asks and report what you see of its court and army.

proposal.text: Egypt and Assyria are brothers. Neither sends troops against the lands of the other. Their envoys pass freely, and each will warn the other if a third king moves against him.

value.notes: T5 plan. Enkomi taken T4; Alashiya has only Amurru (walls), no units, cannot raise (homeland mine). Naval push north: F_delta -> levantsea now, raise F4 in delta (120). T6 (WAKE): F_delta levantsea -> syriansea, F4 delta -> levantsea, raise F5 in delta to garrison it (check treasury ~350). T7: F4 levantsea -> byblos with F_delta at syriansea supporting (2 v walls 1). Byblos is 'Egypt's' in k26. Then Amurru: k26 says Amurru and Qadesh need Hatti's word; c2 sent to Hatti to ask word on Amurru+Qadesh, offering Hatti free hand on Ugarit+Carchemish. If Hatti refuses, weigh it anyway (tablet binds nobody). Qadesh (Babylonia, bought, walls) later with the two armies (gaza, megiddo) convoyed to byblos/amurru: need mover + supporter adjacent. Keep enkomi and tamassos garrisoned: Hatti fleet sits at cilicia beside them. Arzawa fleet at westsea: keep delta covered. Megiddo army kept for the Qadesh plan. c1 -> Assyria (brotherhood, warn of third king), c2 -> Hatti. c16 returns from Arzawa about T7. Do not trust anyone; gold sent: none.
value.summary: Egypt (Napkhururiya, capital akhetaten). Goal: highest growth ratio (strength = 10 x yield + gold - back pay). T5 strength 3911 (1.56). History: T1 bought Tyre; T2 took Gaza; T3 took Megiddo and Tamassos, bought Damascus; T4 took Enkomi (Alashiya's fleet destroyed). Alashiya now holds only Amurru (walls), no units, cannot raise. Tablets: k14 Babylonia peace (T3, no gold); k26 Hatti (T3: no troops against each other; Egypt holds Gaza Megiddo Tyre Byblos Damascus; Hatti holds Ugarit Carchemish Isuwa; Amurru and Qadesh taken by neither without the other's word); k27 Mitanni (T3); k23/24/25 are Alashiya's tablets with Arzawa/Hatti (copies). Rules learned: bought walled cities (Tyre, Damascus) cannot hold my troops so armies cannot path through them; conquered cities lose walls and can be garrisoned. Babylonia (no coast, cannot raise fleets) is my main rival (about 1.64): holds Qadesh (bought, walls), Mari (army), Ekallatum, Susa; it can strike Damascus only from Mari (strength 1) so my Levant is safe. Only fleets reach the north: Byblos via levantsea mover + syriansea supporter. Units cost upkeep and are not strength: do not hoard idle ones; buying a city is strength-neutral plus 10% a season; conquest is better. Keep delta, enkomi, tamassos garrisoned by fleets (Hatti fleet at cilicia, Arzawa fleet at westsea). Envoys: c2 to Hatti (word on Amurru/Qadesh), c1 to Assyria; c16 at Arzawa, home about T7. Plan after Byblos: Amurru, then Qadesh by two armies, maybe Ugarit if Hatti does not take it.

ledger.entry: T3 sealed k26 (no troops against each other; Egypt holds Byblos etc; Hatti holds Ugarit, Carchemish, Isuwa; Amurru and Qadesh need the other's word). T5: sent c2 asking word for Egypt on Amurru and Qadesh, offering Hatti free hand on Ugarit and Carchemish. No gold. Hatti fleet at cilicia next to my Enkomi/Tamassos: watch.
T5: sent c1 (born in Nineveh, may be partial to them) with brotherhood tablet offer: no troops against each other, warn of a third king. No gold. Assyria lost Ekallatum to Babylonia.
T4 I took Enkomi. Owe them nothing. They hold only Amurru (walls) and no units. I never sealed anything with them.

value.text: My lord Ashur-uballit, Great King, I have come home from the court of Tushratta of Mitanni. He is glad that all goes well with you, your household, sons, chariots, horses and country. He keeps your sealed tablet before Shamash and honours it: in turn 6 his army in Terqa will support your march from Ashur into Ekallatum, and in turn 7 your army in Ekallatum will support his march from Terqa into Mari, as written and not sooner. He asks that you do not strike before turn 6 without a sure road, for a bounce warns Babylon, and he keeps his army in Taidu out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur. His watchers see one Babylonian army holding in Mari and one in Ekallatum, and Babylon has written him only brotherhood. He says his envoy Mane brings a confirming tablet with the turns named; I told him I had no charge to receive a new tablet, so I could not seal it, and I do not answer for any strike before turn 6. He named no garrison for Mari. The court lives comfortably.

To my lord Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, from your servant Mane: I came before Ashur-uballit of Assyria and gave your words as you spoke them. He keeps the seasons before Shamash: in turn six his army at Ashur enters Ekallatum with your Terqa army supporting it, and in turn seven his army in Ekallatum supports your march from Terqa into Mari, his Arbela army adding its support to the same move. He says Ekallatum held against him last season with strength three, so Sippar and Durkurigalzu lend it support, and his watchers see Babylonian armies at Ekallatum, Susa and Mari. He bids your Terqa army stand ready and move exactly in turn six, neither sooner nor later, and that no army of either house enter the other's land. I have committed Mitanni to confirm turn six and turn seven as he has stated them, and I bring his sealed tablet home to you. He asks that your next envoy bring word of anything seen at Mari. Near his capital I saw three bodies of army and no fleet.

value.speech: Great King Tushratta, my brother, thus says Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, your brother: all goes well with him, and may all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. He says he has heard through Artessupa what you said, and he is glad of the seal on our peace. Of Isuwa: it is yours by the city's own choice, and no army of Hatti will go against it. Of Carchemish and Ugarit: your own tablet gave them to Hatti, and he asks that they stay so, with no gold of Mitanni to buy them and no company of Harran to enter them. In return he will not trouble Isuwa, Mari, Qadesh, Damascus or Amurru. He sends a short tablet so that this stands plain between us, and he says that if Assyria or Babylon move against either of us, let us speak at once. Great King, I await what you will tell me of Babylon, Assyria and Egypt, that I may carry it home to my lord.

Great King Tarhundaradu, king of Arzawa, I bring you the words of my lord the Great King of Alashiya, as the tablet between your houses requires. Egypt has taken Tamassos and then Enkomi, his capital, by two fleets that hold each other up, though he asked it to keep out; he holds only Amurru, has no ships left but his word, and Egypt's ships now lie a few days from Lukka and Apasa. Your fleet in the Great Green is one move from Tamassos, and to break two linked fleets you need three ships: one to strike Enkomi and cut its support, one to strike Tamassos, and one to support it. He asks Hatti, whose fleet is in the Cilician Sea, to join you, and for every province of his that you free and return to him he will pay 150 shekels on receipt. I bring a tablet for you to seal, by which Arzawa and Alashiya each warn the other of Egypt's fleets, and Arzawa strikes Egypt's ships at Tamassos and Enkomi when Hatti or another king joins. My lord asks you to tell him by your envoy what you will do, and what you see of Egypt's ships.

Great King of Hatti, my brother, thus my lord the Great King of Alashiya bids me say: may all go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. He holds you to your word that no ship of yours will go against Enkomi or Tamassos, and he keeps his own word on Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa, which are yours; he bids for none of them. Egypt took Tamassos first and then his capital, and holds both with two fleets that support each other, a day from Kizzuwatna; Cyprus is Egypt's door into your coast, and your fleet in the Cilician Sea is one move from both. Arzawa's fleet in the Great Green is one move from Tamassos, and he has asked Arzawa to join you, for to break two linked fleets you need three ships. Any province you free he asks you to return to him, and he will pay 150 shekels for each on receipt. He claims nothing of Egypt's coast cities beyond Cyprus; they are yours to take. Here is the tablet, which my lord asks you to seal.

Brother of Alashiya, may all go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. I hold to k6 and k31: no ship of mine goes against Enkomi or Tamassos, and I thank you for leaving Ugarit, Carchemish and Isuwa to me. I will send you word of every Egyptian fleet I see near the Cilician Sea, and I ask the same of you. I do not seal this new tablet now: it ties my hand to a war with Egypt on the word of Arzawa, whose tablets to me were broken the day they were sealed. Let k31 stand. If Egypt turns its ships against my coast, I will remember my brother of Alashiya, and then we speak again of Cyprus. I promise nothing in gold and ask nothing in gold.

Artessupa, say to Suppiluliuma my brother: all goes well with me, and may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I have heard his words and I seal his tablet. Isuwa is the reach of Mitanni, and he sends nothing against it. Carchemish and Ugarit are the reach of Hatti as we agreed before, and my Harran army will not enter them. Neither of us sends an army into the other's homeland. Of Babylon, tell him this: it holds Ekallatum, Mari, Susa and Qadesh, and it grows beyond all but Egypt. Both our houses should watch it. If Babylon moves against either of us, let us speak at once, as the tablet says. Of Egypt: I am at peace with Pharaoh as a brother, and I know of nothing he plans against Hatti. Let our envoys pass freely, each to the other's court.

Zitanza, tell the Great King of Alashiya, my brother: our tablet of brotherhood stands, and I grieve at what Egypt has done to Tamassos and Enkomi. I will warn him of every Egyptian fleet that comes my way, and I ask the same of him. I will not seal the new tablet now. I hold one fleet, and as your lord says, two linked fleets need three ships to break; a strike with one ship would only feed Egypt's ships. Hatti is no friend of mine: its king broke his own peace with me and sent an army into my homeland. Your tablet shows Hatti sworn to your lord as brother, so let him ask whether Hatti would really join. If Egypt's ships come against my coast, or if Hatti and another king truly join, I will strike at Tamassos and Enkomi, and then the 150 shekels for each province freed can be agreed by a tablet at that time. Tell him also that his word to me about Egypt's ships is welcome every season. Go in peace.

Great King of Hatti, my brother, I hear your words and will carry them faithfully to my lord of Alashiya. I will not press you to seal the new tablet while Egypt's ships stand off your coast, and I understand that your hand is not yet bound. Let k6 and k31 stand as the ground between our houses, and let every Egyptian fleet seen near the Cilician Sea be reported to you as you ask, with your word returned to my lord in the same way. My lord's offer stands: one hundred and fifty shekels for each of Tamassos and Enkomi returned to him, paid on receipt. I would be glad to be the one who carries your answer back to him.
value.commitments: On my lord's behalf: Alashiya and Hatti will trade word of Egyptian fleet movements, each to the other. The 150 shekels for each of Tamassos and Enkomi returned stands, paid only on receipt. No gold given now, no ships or troops promised, Amurru not ceded.

value.speech: Great King Tarhundaradu, I hear your words and will carry them to my lord the Great King of Alashiya exactly as you have given them. Your tablet of brotherhood stands, and you will warn him of every Egyptian fleet that comes your way, asking the same of him; his word about Egypt's ships is welcome to you every season. You will not seal the new tablet now, for you hold one fleet, and two linked fleets need three ships to break. If Egypt's ships come against your coast, or if Hatti and another king truly join, you will strike at Tamassos and Enkomi, and the 150 shekels for each province freed may then be agreed by tablet; my lord should ask Hatti whether it would indeed join. I take my leave in peace, Great King.

Great King Tushratta, my brother, I hear your words and will carry them to my lord Suppiluliuma as you have spoken them. Of Babylon: it holds Ekallatum, Mari, Susa and Qadesh and grows beyond all but Egypt, and both our houses shall watch it, speaking at once should it move against either of us, as the tablet says. Of Egypt: you are at peace with Pharaoh as a brother and know of nothing he plans against Hatti, and I shall report that plainly. Of Assyria you have said nothing, and I will report that silence as it stands. The tablet is sealed, and I carry it home with your word that our envoys pass freely between our courts. May all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country.
value.commitments: Nothing beyond the terms of the sealed tablet, which my lord has already set down.

value.speech: Great King Tushratta, I, your humble servant Kidin-Adad, stand before you. Thus says Burna-Buriash, Great King, king of Karduniash, your brother: all goes well with me, and may all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. My lord bids me say that your sealed tablet lies safe in his archive, that he does not contest Isuwa or the northern roads, and that of Mari he will speak when Assyria is finished, his garrison holding it while your road through Terqa stays open as his road through Ekallatum stays open to you. Assyria's three provinces prop one another up, so he proposes that we strike all at once in the season of turn 7, before they can be warned: your army at Terqa supports his army at Ekallatum moving into Ashur, your army at Taidu moves into Nineveh to cut its support, and his army at Susa moves into Arbela to cut Arbela's support; once Ashur is his, his men will support your army into Nineveh. Tell no one. He asks that you send word back by me that you agree and that your orders stand for turn 7, and I pray you grant me your answer to carry home.

Kidin-Adad, say to Burna-Buriash my brother: all goes well with me, and may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. Your words are welcome. Our tablet lies in my archive as in yours; I keep the peace of our homelands and I thank you for leaving Isuwa and the northern roads in my hand. Your plan against Assyria is bold and I do not refuse it. But the seasons of turn 6 are still to be played and I will not fix orders for turn 7 before I see what stands at Ekallatum, Mari and Ashur when they are done. Once I see it, I will send my own envoy with my answer and my orders; do not set your march on my word alone, and do not read my silence as refusal. Meanwhile keep the road through Terqa and Harran free of your armies as I keep my road free of yours, and let Mari be spoken of between us as you have said, when Assyria is finished. May Shamash and Teshub keep our brotherhood.

Great King Tushratta, I hear your words and will carry them faithfully to my lord Burna-Buriash: our tablet lies safe in your archive, you do not refuse his plan, and you will fix no orders for turn 7 until you have seen how matters stand at the places you named, after which you will send your own envoy with your answer. I will tell him not to set his march on your silence or on my word alone. I will also carry your request that the road through Terqa and Harran be kept free of armies, as he keeps his road free. May Shamash and Teshub keep our brotherhood, and may all go well with you, your household and your country.
value.commitments: Only what was already spoken: Karduniash does not contest Isuwa or the northern roads. No march fixed for turn 7, and nothing promised on the roads or on Mari, Ekallatum or Susa.

orders.letter: Brother Tushratta, I confirm what my envoy Kidin-Adad carried. In the coming season, turn 7, and in the same season, not before: your army at Terqa supports my army at Ekallatum going into Ashur; your army at Taidu goes into Nineveh; my army at Susa goes into Arbela. Your attack on Nineveh cuts its support, my attack on Arbela cuts that support, and Ashur falls. As sealed in k32, Nineveh is yours, Ashur and Arbela are mine, and neither of us makes peace with Assyria without the other. I do not move against your homeland and I keep Ekallatum, Mari and Susa. Send word by this envoy whether the day stands.
orders.mandate: May confirm the joint strike on turn 7 and the division sealed in k32. May not cede Mari, Ekallatum, Susa, Ashur or Arbela, may not promise gold, may not seal any new tablet.

value.notes: T6 orders: keep the ring (ekallatum holds, sippar and durkurigalzu support it = hold 3; susa, mari hold). Treasury 167, no purchase possible. Sent c5 to Mitanni (arrives T7 before Mitanni gives T7 orders) to confirm the joint strike for T7, spoken only, no gold, no tablet. Sending c5 away also defers his 13 wage, so T7 gold should be about 315. T7 PLAN: wake (c6 back with Tushratta's answer). If Mitanni agrees: ekallatum->ashur, susa->arbela, durkurigalzu->ekallatum (refill), sippar and mari hold; Mitanni terqa supports ekallatum->ashur and taidu->nineveh. If he refuses, is silent, or changes the day: do NOT attack, hold the ring. Either way buy Byblos (300) at T7 if gold is 300 or more (Egypt can also buy Byblos from tyre/damascus; a double bid sells to none, so bid every season I can afford it, then Ugarit 400, Carchemish 350). After Assyria falls, disband spare armies to save 30 each. Watch Egypt (leader, 365 yield, its walled cities cannot hold troops so it expands by gold and fleets) and c5 (Arzawa-born, term ends T7, may defect).
value.summary: Burna-Buriash of Babylonia, start strength 2600; T6 strength 3356 (1.29), treasury 167, income 320, upkeep 150 (5 armies: ekallatum, sippar, durkurigalzu, susa, mari), wages 24. Egypt leads (land 365 vs my 320; it holds Alashiya's homeland and walled bought cities damascus, tyre, megiddo, gaza). Held: babylon, durkurigalzu, sippar, nippur, ur, ekallatum, susa, mari, qadesh (bought, walled, safe). Disbanded interior armies babylon, nippur, ur in T5. Sealed tablets: k8 (T2 Mitanni, no troops into each other's homeland), k28 (T3 Egypt brotherhood), k32 (T4 Mitanni: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to me, no separate peace with Assyria). Assyria (arbela, ashur, nineveh) holds a mutual-support triangle, hold up to 3; a support is cut by any attack from a province other than the one supported into; a dislodged unit dies. Joint strike told to Mitanni for T7: terqa supports ekallatum->ashur, taidu->nineveh, susa->arbela; I conceded Isuwa and the northern roads, not Mari. Buy order: Byblos 300, Ugarit 400, Carchemish 350 (bought city returns 10 percent a season; double bids sell to none). Unhired: c15 Mazipalali (26), c17 Ehli-Teshub (21). People: c5 Piyamaradu (13, term T7, Arzawa-born), c6 Kidin-Adad (11, term T12). Wake every turn while the war lasts.

ledger.entry: k8 (T2) and k32 (T4) sealed. T5 sent c6 with a spoken joint strike for T7 (terqa supports ekallatum->ashur; taidu->nineveh; susa->arbela); conceded Isuwa and northern roads, not Mari. T6 sent c5 to confirm the same strike for T7, no gold, no tablet. Awaiting Tushratta's answer with c6 at T7. No gold sent since T1 (40).

value.notes: T6 plan: T5 strike on Tuwanuwa bounced 3 vs 3 (tuwanuwa + kizzuwatna support + one unseen support from hattusa/kanesh). I cannot reach 4 (treasury 20, army costs 100), so no repeat: a repeat leaves Lukka at 1+fleet=2 against a possible kizzuwatna+tuwanuwa+cilicia strike of 3. Defence now: lukka holds, mira and westsea fleet support lukka hold (3 vs max 3 visible), seha holds. Seha and mira can only be hit with strength 1 (no other Hatti unit borders them). Apasa empty but screened. Alashiya envoy Zitanza: refused new tablet, promised verbal warning of Egyptian fleets and a strike only if Egypt hits my coast or Hatti and others truly join; 150 per freed province to be agreed by tablet then. Money is the wall: income 125 = upkeep 125, wages 22 once c11/c12 are home T9 will drain me (treasury 20, back pay about 22 plus). At T9: read what Mitanni and Egypt sent (gold?), then decide: raise army at apasa (100) when affordable, do not renew envoys unless cheap, consider disbanding the fleet only if Lukka is safe. Long goal: break Hatti with Mitanni (Tuwanuwa 30, Hattusa 50). Wake T8, scheduled defence for T7 and T8.
value.summary: Arzawa (Tarhundaradu), capital apasa, homeland seha/apasa/mira, plus Lukka (25, taken T2). Start strength 1300; T6 strength 1248 (0.96). Treaties: k1 Hatti peace T2 (Hatti broke it T3 by entering Seha, my proof), k10 Alashiya brotherhood T2, k29 Mitanni sworn alliance T3 (both press Hatti, neither makes peace with Hatti without telling the other), k34 Hatti peace T4 incl. Lukka (I broke it T5 attacking Tuwanuwa; Hatti keeps army kizzuwatna and fleet cilicia next to Lukka), k35 Egypt brotherhood T5 (homelands only; Lukka not covered; new tablet covering Lukka carried by c12). Egypt leads (1.92), holds Tamassos/Enkomi (Alashiya nearly dead, holds amurru only). Hatti has at least 3 armies (tuwanuwa, kizzuwatna, one unseen) plus fleet cilicia and income 180 vs my 125; it out-builds me over time. My units: armies seha, mira, lukka, fleet westsea; apasa empty. Economy: income 125 = upkeep 125, treasury 20, wages 22 when c11 and c12 are at court. Envoys c11 (to Mitanni, report on Hatti, ask joint pressure and gold) and c12 (to Egypt, Lukka tablet, ask gold) both due home about T9, terms end T8. Targets: Tuwanuwa 30, Hattusa 50, Kanesh 35, Kizzuwatna 35; Ugarit buyable for 400. Need 4 strength to break Tuwanuwa (defence is 3).

ledger.entry: T2 k1 broken by Hatti (T3 army into Seha). k34 sealed T4 (no troops into any province incl. Lukka) yet Hatti keeps army at kizzuwatna and fleet at cilicia next to Lukka. T5 I attacked Tuwanuwa (bounced 3 v 3), breaking k34. Hostile; defensive stalemate. Show k1 as proof of treachery.

T2 k10 sealed, brothers, no ships or troops against each other, warn of harm. T6 envoy Zitanza (c14) brought a tablet (warn of Egypt's fleets; Arzawa strikes Egypt at Tamassos/Enkomi when Hatti or another king joins; 150 per province freed). I did NOT seal it. Promised verbal warnings of Egypt's fleets and a strike only if Egypt hits my coast or others truly join. Keep k10, keep him friendly, cost nothing.

value.notes: T6 orders: Take Ugarit now. Fleet cilicia -> ugarit, supported by kizzuwatna army (2 v wall 1); army stays home so Arzawa lukka cannot walk into kizzuwatna. If Arzawa hits kizzuwatna the support is cut and the fleet bounces (no loss). tuwanuwa holds with hattusa + kanesh support (hold 3 = bounces Arzawa max 3: seha mover + mira + lukka supports). No raise this turn: treasury 100, upkeep 155 vs income 180 (220 with Ugarit); raising now would leave 0 and a failed Ugarit would give income 180 < upkeep 185 and desertion. No hires (wages), no letters (no envoy at court; c4 returns T7, c3 T9). T7 PLAN (I wake T7): if Ugarit taken, kanesh army -> carchemish supported by kizzuwatna army (2 v wall 1), then raise an army in kanesh (empty after movement; if the move bounced nothing is paid). Tuwanuwa then holds only 2 (hattusa) for one season: weigh the Arzawa 3-strength risk; alternative is wait one turn. Carchemish and Byblos can be bought by others (Mitanni borders Carchemish; Egypt shares the sea with Ugarit); a city taken by troops is not sold. Alashiya: kept warm, nothing sealed, will send word of Egyptian fleets. Do not trust Arzawa tablets.
value.summary: Suppiluliuma of Hatti. Aim: highest growth vs start 2100 (strength = 10 x yields + gold - back pay). T6: strength 1878, treasury 100, yield 180, 4 armies (tuwanuwa, kanesh, kizzuwatna, hattusa) + fleet cilicia; upkeep 155 (30 army, 35 fleet), income 180. Lost Seha T4 to Arzawa, which broke k22 the day it sealed it; Arzawa armies seha, mira, lukka (+apasa unseen) attack tuwanuwa each turn with max 3 (mover + 2 supports): keep tuwanuwa hold 3 (hattusa + kanesh or kizzuwatna support). Sealed: k6/k31 Alashiya (Ugarit Hatti's; I send no ships vs Enkomi/Tamassos; Alashiya offers 150 per province returned and wants me in a war on Egypt, I refused to seal T6); k12 Egypt (Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa; Egypt Gaza/Megiddo/Tyre/Byblos/Damascus); k21 and k30 Mitanni (Hatti may take Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka; Mitanni Isuwa, Qadesh, Mari, Damascus, Amurru); k22 Arzawa broken by Arzawa. Assyria offered alliance vs Mitanni at T3, nothing sealed. Egypt leads 1.92 (holds Tamassos, Enkomi, Gaza, Tyre, Megiddo, Damascus), Babylon 1.64 (holds Qadesh, Mari, Susa, Ekallatum). Walled bought cities (Isuwa, Qadesh, Damascus, Tyre, Amurru) cannot hold troops; take with move + 1 support. Free cities left: Carchemish 350, Ugarit 400, Byblos. Plan: Ugarit T6 (fleet + kizzuwatna support), Carchemish T7 (kanesh army + kizzuwatna support, then raise at kanesh), then more armies as income allows; later Lukka/Seha if Arzawa weakens. Envoys: c4 Artessupa back T7 (serves through T9), c3 Keliya to Egypt back T9. Free candidates at court: c10 (25), c15 (30), c17 (20); not hired.

orders.letter: Brother Tushratta, may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. I keep my tablet before Shamash. In turn 6 my army moves from Ashur into Ekallatum with your Terqa army supporting; in turn 7, once Ekallatum is mine, my army there supports your march from Terqa into Mari. Neither of us sends an army into the other's land: your Taidu and Terqa armies stay out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur, as I keep out of Harran, Washukanni, Taidu and Terqa. My envoy Ubaru told you I had no charge for a new tablet, but I stand by the turns already sealed. Ekallatum will need a stronger hold against Babylon, whose armies press us both. A gift of gold from my brother would let me raise another army there, and that strengthens your flank at Mari. If Babylon bounces us, name the next turn and I will keep faith.
orders.mandate: May confirm the turns already sealed (turn 6 Ashur to Ekallatum with Terqa support; turn 7 Ekallatum supports Terqa to Mari), receive gold, and agree that neither army enters the other's land. Nothing more: no gold from me, no cession, no new tablet, no move of my armies out of Ashur, Arbela or Nineveh.

value.notes: T6: Treasury 0. Ubaru back from Mitanni: Tushratta says Terqa supports T6 ashur->ekallatum and my ekallatum army supports Terqa->Mari T7. Mitanni sees one Babylonian army in Mari, one in Ekallatum. Ekallatum hold was 3 at T4 (mari + sippar/durk supports), my max is 3 (ashur+arbela+Terqa): a tie bounces harmlessly, my unit stays in Ashur. Orders T6: ashur->ekallatum, arbela supports, nineveh supports arbela hold. T7 default (if I hold Ekallatum): ekallatum army supports terqa->mari, arbela supports ekallatum hold, nineveh supports arbela hold. ASHUR IS EMPTY for T7 if the strike succeeds: Terqa could walk in; I accept the risk because Mitanni wants Mari. If T6 bounces: the scheduled move retries T7 without Terqa support (weak), so override at T7: re-plan, maybe hold and send peace to Babylon. Sent Ubaru (c18) to Mitanni asking for a gold gift (about 100) to raise a 4th army (must be raised in an empty homeland province, e.g. ashur if empty after movement). No tablet (no gold for scribe 20). Net income about +20 after upkeep; wages must stay minimal. c9 Pirissi back from Egypt about T9 (gifts?). Wake T7. Watch Mitanni after Mari falls.
value.summary: Ashur-uballit of Assyria. Start 1700, homeland nineveh/arbela/ashur/ekallatum. T1: attacked Terqa (failed); Babylonia took Ekallatum. Bought Susa T1, Babylonia took it T2. Sealed k4 with Mitanni T2 (no armies into each other's land, no aid to each other's enemy; Mitanni may take Mari/Isuwa/Carchemish/Qadesh, I may take Susa). k17 T3 and k36 T5 with Mitanni: T6 my Ashur army to Ekallatum with Terqa army supporting; T7 my Ekallatum army supports Terqa->Mari. Babylonia (rating about 1.64) holds ekallatum, susa, mari armies plus sippar, durkurigalzu, nippur, ur, babylon, qadesh; it probed arbela from susa until T4, quiet at T5; it said it would send an envoy for a pause (I committed only to non-aggression on present borders). Egypt (1.92) is running away (holds Damascus, Tyre, Gaza, Megiddo, Enkomi, Tamassos). Hatti (T5): accepts peace, counts Carchemish as within its reach, will weigh a tablet in its own form. I have 3 armies (arbela, ashur, nineveh), 3 provinces (yield 110), treasury 0, strength about 1030 vs 1700. Income 110, upkeep 90. Back pay owed 70 (c9 30, c18 22, c10 18). Geometry: max strength into Ekallatum is 3 (ashur, arbela, Terqa). Mitanni armies at Terqa and Taidu border my capital and Nineveh; Susa borders Arbela: never leave a province empty without cover. Pirissi (c9) sent to Egypt T5 asking friendship, shared pressure on Babylonia, gold gift; back about T9. Plan: win Ekallatum with Mitanni, raise a 4th army when gold allows, later Susa, coalition against Babylonia, gifts from Egypt.

ledger.entry: T5: sealed k36 via Mane: T6 my Ashur army to Ekallatum with Terqa supporting; T7 my Ekallatum army supports Terqa to Mari. T6: Ubaru returned, Tushratta confirms both turns and keeps Taidu out of my land. T6: sent Ubaru back (arrives T7) confirming the turns and asking for a gift of gold, no tablet, no gold sent. Private: Terqa and Taidu border Ashur/Nineveh, a treaty is cheap talk; watch Mitanni after Mari falls.

value.notes: T6: Orders: terqa supports ashur->ekallatum (Assyria plan k16/k37), harran supports isuwa (Hatti max 2 vs walls1+1, safe), washukanni supports terqa, taidu holds. Cancelled raise_army in terqa. Mane (c7) kept at court on purpose: at T7 I will know the T6 result and can send him to Babylon/Assyria with a true answer. Woken T7 by wake_in_turn. T7 DECISION RULES: (a) If Ekallatum fell to Assyria: terqa->mari only if Mari holds one lone army and Sippar looks silent (Mari defence max 1+sippar support = 2; my attack terqa + Assyrian Ekallatum support = 2 ties and bounces). Then washukanni->terqa. (b) If the T6 attack bounced: do NOT move terqa, hold. (c) Babylon's T7 plan (my Terqa supports their Ekallatum->Ashur, my Taidu->Nineveh, their Susa->Arbela) makes Babylon far bigger for only Nineveh to me: reject unless terms improve; Taidu may instead support Nineveh holding to keep Assyria alive as a buffer. Real score includes gold: I am 1.00 real, Egypt and Babylon far ahead. Conquest of a 35-yield province is +350 strength at once; purchase is neutral then +yield/turn. Carchemish 350 (borders harran/isuwa) around T10 but k38 told Hatti I would not buy: decide then, Hatti is armed. Tattamaru (c8) returns about T9 with Egypt's answer. Owe Arzawa an explanation of the Hatti peace (Mane to Arzawa later, 2 seasons each way).
value.summary: Tushratta of Mitanni. Home harran, washukanni (capital), taidu, terqa; isuwa (bought T3, walls, cannot hold troops, I support its walls). 4 armies; income 175, upkeep 120, wages ~19, net ~+36. Score = 10 x yield + gold - back pay; start 1950; T6 1946 (real growth 1.00). NOTE the STANDINGS list counts yield only, not gold, so rivals look a little better or worse than they are. T6 yields: Egypt 365 (akhetaten, damascus, delta, enkomi, gaza, megiddo, memphis, sinai, tamassos, thebes, tyre), Babylonia 320 (babylon, durkurigalzu, ekallatum, mari, nippur, qadesh, sippar, susa, ur; armies seen at ekallatum, mari, susa), Arzawa 125, me 175, Hatti 180, Assyria 110 (arbela, ashur, nineveh), Alashiya 20 (amurru). Free cities left: byblos, carchemish (350), ugarit (400). Tablets: k3/k20 Babylon (homeland peace; Nineveh to me, Arbela+Ashur to Babylon; no separate peace with Assyria); k9/k16/k37 Assyria (T6 ashur->ekallatum with my terqa support; T7 their Ekallatum army supports my terqa->mari; no armies into each other's land); k13 Egypt (brothers, warn); k15 Arzawa sworn alliance (I owe an explanation of the Hatti peace); k18/k33/k38 Hatti (homelands at peace; Isuwa mine, Carchemish+Ugarit Hatti's reach, I do not buy/enter them; speak if Assyria or Babylon move). Babylon proposed (T6, Kidin-Adad) a T7 joint strike on Assyria (my Terqa supports Ekallatum->Ashur, my Taidu->Nineveh, their Susa->Arbela); I gave no commitment and promised my own envoy after T6. Washukanni and harran are shielded by walled Isuwa/Carchemish; the real front is terqa (Mari, Ekallatum, Ashur) and taidu (Nineveh). People: Mane c7 (11 to T12), Tattamaru c8 (8 to T10, in Egypt, back ~T9), Nakhtmin c12 my secret man in Egypt. Candidates c15 (30), c17 (22) too dear. Do not trust Babylon or Hatti fully; Babylon is the danger and must not swallow Assyria.

ledger.entry: T6: Mane returned with k37 (confirms T6 Ashur->Ekallatum with my Terqa support; T7 their Ekallatum army supports my Terqa->Mari; neither enters the other's land). Ashur-uballit wants word of Mari. He says Ekallatum held with strength 3 earlier, so it may bounce. I check the T6 result before any T7 move. No gold either way. Told him nothing of k20 or Babylon's plan.

value.notes: T6 plan. Treasury 302 at orders. Conquest beats buying (buying is strength-neutral, conquest is free strength; bought walled cities bar my troops so do not buy cities I need as bases). T6: F1 levantsea->syriansea, F2 delta->levantsea, raise army D in delta (guard plus reserve, convoy-ready from delta). Gaza army G holds, megiddo army M keeps supporting damascus walls. WAKE T7. T7 PLAN: F2 (levantsea) convoys G gaza->byblos, F1 (syriansea) supports G into byblos (2 v walls 1); M megiddo->gaza to replace G. T8: G byblos->amurru with F1 (syriansea) supporting (2 v walls 1); F2 convoys M gaza->byblos. T9: Qadesh (Babylonia, walls): G amurru->qadesh with M at byblos supporting; Babylonia mari army may support the walls (then 2 v 2 bounces; ship D from delta by convoy as a third, or hit via ugarit). Then Ugarit (armies amurru + fleet syriansea), then Carchemish (buy 350 or two armies). Babylonia borders Byblos, Ugarit, Carchemish via Qadesh and may buy them (two bids on one city = none sold). Delta/home empty except D: wake if any foreign unit enters greatgreen. Enkomi and tamassos fleets stay (Hatti fleet at cilicia). Envoys: c16 home T7 (resend), c1 and c2 home T9. Do not trust anyone.
value.summary: Egypt (Napkhururiya, capital akhetaten). Goal: highest growth ratio (strength = 10 x yield + gold - back pay). T6 strength 3873 (1.55 vs start 2500). History: T1 bought Tyre; T2 took Gaza; T3 took Megiddo and Tamassos, bought Damascus; T4 took Enkomi (Alashiya fleet destroyed); T5 fleet to levantsea plus new fleet in delta. Holdings T6: akhetaten, damascus(w), delta, enkomi, gaza, megiddo, memphis, sinai, tamassos, thebes, tyre(w). Alashiya holds only Amurru (walls), no units. Tablets: k14 Babylonia peace (T3, no gold); k26 Hatti (T3: no troops against each other; Egypt holds Gaza Megiddo Tyre Byblos Damascus; Hatti holds Ugarit Carchemish Isuwa; Amurru and Qadesh need the other's word); k27 Mitanni (T3); k23/24/25 are Alashiya's tablets (copies). Rules learned: bought walled cities cannot hold my troops, conquered ones lose walls and can; walls hold 1 so mover plus one supporter takes them; a fleet may convoy an army coast to coast and an army may support a fleet's move if it could move there; ties bounce. Babylonia (no coast, about 1.5-1.6) is my main rival: holds Qadesh (bought, walls), Mari (army), Ekallatum, Susa. Strategy: conquer free/weak Levant cities (Byblos, Amurru, Qadesh, Ugarit, Carchemish) with fleets F1/F2 plus armies G/M and reserve D; use spare gold for cities units cannot reach; do not hoard idle units.
