Keep enkomi/tamassos fleets (Hatti fleet at cilicia). Envoys: c1 to Assyria, c2 to Hatti (back T9), c16 back from Arzawa T7. Do not trust anyone.

ledger.entry: T3 sealed k26 (no troops against each other; Egypt holds Byblos etc; Hatti holds Ugarit, Carchemish, Isuwa; Amurru and Qadesh need the other's word). T5 sent c2 asking word on Amurru and Qadesh, offering Hatti free hand on Ugarit and Carchemish. No gold. T6: I plan to take Byblos and Amurru by troops, later maybe Ugarit; watch Hatti fleets at cilicia and kizzuwatna next to Enkomi, Tamassos, Ugarit.
T4 I took Enkomi and Tamassos. Owe them nothing. They hold only Amurru (walls) and no units. I never sealed anything with them. T8 plan: take Amurru by troops, which ends their kingdom.

value.text: To my lord, the Great King of Alashiya, from your servant Ili-iddina: I went to the court of Hatti and gave its king your greeting, your wish for peace, and your word on Enkomi and Tamassos, and I laid before him the tablet, which he has not sealed. He says his hand is tied to a war with Egypt on the word of Arzawa, and he will not seal while Egypt's ships stand off his coast. He holds k6 and k31 and will send you word of every Egyptian fleet near the Cilician Sea, and asks the same of you; I committed you to this on your behalf. Your offer of 150 shekels for each of Tamassos and Enkomi returned, paid on receipt, stands, and I did not press him further. He promises no gold and no ships. I note that Hatti keeps four army and no fleet near its capital, and that its treasury looks thin. The unsealed tablet is returned to you with this report.

My lord Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, I, your humble servant Kidin-Adad, have returned from the court of Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and lay before you what passed. I gave him your greeting and laid before him your plan for turn 7: that your army at Terqa and your army at Ekallatum move into Ashur, your army at Taidu into Nineveh, and your army at Susa into Arbela, to strike all at once before Assyria is warned. He said that our tablet lies in his archive as in yours, that he keeps the peace of our homelands, and that he thanks you for leaving Isuwa and the northern roads in his hand. He does not refuse your plan, but he will fix no orders for turn 7 until he sees how matters stand at Ekallatum, Mari and Ashur. After that he will send his own envoy with his answer and his orders. He bids you not to set your march on his word alone, and not to read his silence as refusal. He asks that the road through Terqa and Harran be kept free of armies, as he keeps his own road free, and that Mari be spoken of between you when Assyria is finished. Nothing was promised on the roads, on Mari, on Ekallatum or on Susa, and I gave him no word of my own beyond what you sent. May Shamash and Teshub keep our brotherhood, my lord.

My lord Napkhururiya, your servant Pihhuniya returns from the court of Arzawa. I bring the tablet of brotherhood and peace, sealed by Tarhundaradu, king of Arzawa: no troops shall enter each other's homeland, and envoys of both lands shall pass freely. Tarhundaradu received your brotherly greeting gladly and wishes you, your household, sons, chariots and horses well; he looks to the west and the Hatti border rather than to the Nile. He asks that the peace also cover Lukka, which he counts as his own, and I gave him no answer on that, having no power to speak for you. He says he will send his own envoy to your court when his treasury allows. I noticed that Arzawa keeps 3 army and 1 fleet near its capital.

My lord Suppiluliuma, I am home and give you the answer of Great King Tushratta as he spoke it. All goes well with him, and he wishes all well to your house. He has heard your words and seals your tablet: Isuwa is the reach of Mitanni and you send nothing against it; Carchemish and Ugarit are the reach of Hatti as agreed, and his Harran army will not enter them; neither of you sends an army into the other's homeland. Of Babylon he says it holds Ekallatum, Mari, Susa and Qadesh and grows beyond all but Egypt, and that both our houses should watch it and speak at once should it move against either of us. Of Egypt he says he is at peace with Pharaoh as a brother and knows of nothing Pharaoh plans against Hatti; envoys shall pass freely between the courts. Of Assyria he said nothing, and I have reported that silence as it stands. The tablet is sealed and I bring it home. At Mitanni the court lives comfortably, and the king keeps 4 army and no fleet near his capital. Kidin-Adad, envoy of Babylonia, was also at the court.

My lord, Great King of Alashiya, I have returned from the court of Arzawa and give you the words as they were given. Tarhundaradu, king of Arzawa, says that your tablet of brotherhood stands, and he grieves at what Egypt has done to Tamassos and Enkomi. He will not seal the new tablet now: he holds one fleet, and two linked fleets need three ships to break, so a strike with one ship would only feed Egypt's ships. He will warn you of every Egyptian fleet that comes his way, asks the same of you, and bids you send your word about Egypt's ships every season. He will strike at Tamassos and Enkomi if Egypt's ships come against his coast, or if Hatti and another king truly join, and the 150 shekels for each province freed may then be agreed by tablet. He says Hatti is no friend of his, for its king broke his own peace with him and sent an army into his homeland, so he asks that you put to Hatti yourself the question whether it would indeed join. Of what I saw: Arzawa keeps 3 army and 1 fleet near its capital, and its treasury looks thin. I counsel you to ask Hatti plainly before you count on Arzawa's ships. I took my leave in peace.

value.speech: O Great King Ashur-uballit, king of Assyria, your servant Sin-iqisham stands before you as envoy of my lord Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt. Thus says my lord, your brother: all goes well with him, and may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. Egypt and Assyria have never quarrelled and need not. He has heard that the king of Babylon has grown great upon your border, and he asks brotherhood between your two lands: no troops against each other's land, envoys to pass freely, and a word of warning from each if a third king moves against the other. He asks that a tablet be sealed to say so, and I bear that tablet before you now. May it please the Great King to hear it.

Great King Tushratta, my brother, my lord Tarhundaradu thanks you for sealing our oath before Shamash and Teshub. He gives you word of Hatti as you asked: one army stands in Tuwanuwa, one in Kizzuwatna, and a fleet in the Cilician Sea; he has not seen Hattusa or Kanesh. Hatti once broke his peace and sent an army into my lord's homeland at Seha; my lord destroyed it and took Seha back. In honesty, as the oath asks: the short peace Hatti sought for his lands was sealed only to hold Hatti's armies off his coast; it binds him to nothing, and this very season he presses Tuwanuwa. He asks that you press Hatti in the east in the same season, and, as brothers do, send gold to his court, for his war drains his treasury.

Great King Napkhururiya, my lord Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, sends greeting to his brother: may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. He keeps the tablet of brotherhood you two have sealed, and he reminds you that Ugarit and Carchemish lie within the reach of Hatti, as that tablet says. He asks that your ships keep out of the Cilician Sea and away from the harbour of Kizzuwatna, and that neither your gold nor your fleet touch Ugarit or Carchemish. In return Hatti sends nothing against Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Byblos or Damascus. Here is the short tablet for your seal, and I beg you to tell me what Egypt intends toward Alashiya and the Cilician Sea.

Great King Suppiluliuma, my lord Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, your brother, sends me to say: all goes well with him; may it go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. He keeps the tablet you and he have sealed, and as it says, Byblos is Egypt's, and his ships will settle it. Amurru and Qadesh were agreed to be touched only by each other's word; Qadesh has been bought by the king of Babylon, who now sits beside Damascus and Byblos, and Amurru is the last land of the king of Alashiya, whose fleet is gone. He asks your word that Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh, and in return Egypt will send no troops or ships against Ugarit, Carchemish or the lands of Hatti, and leaves those cities to you. I bring a tablet for you to seal saying so, and I will carry home whatever counter-word you give.

Sin-iqisham, my brother Napkhururiya honors me and I seal his tablet gladly. May all go well with him, his household, his wives, his sons, his chariots, his horses and his country. Assyria and Egypt have never quarrelled. No troops of mine will enter the land of Egypt, and my envoys and his will pass freely. You say Babylon has grown great on my border: it is true, Burna-Buriash holds Ekallatum, a city of my own land, and he leans on me and on any who is far from his reach. I will warn my brother if I see a third king move against him, and I ask the same of him. My treasury is thin from holding that border, so as a gift between brothers, let my brother send gold in good, pure weight, as the custom of kings and the measure of respect. My own envoy Pirissi comes to your court; treat him as a brother's servant and send him home with your answer. Carry this to your lord.

Brother Suppiluliuma is well received, and may it go well with his household, sons, chariots and horses. The tablet of brotherhood we sealed stands, and Egypt keeps it: no troops against Hatti's lands, and I ask the same of you toward Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Byblos and Damascus. A second tablet is not needed between brothers whose first still stands, so I do not seal this one today. Egypt has no quarrel with Kizzuwatna's harbour. As for Amurru, I ask that Hatti give Egypt its word on Amurru, which lies beside Byblos and has no king to protect it. Tell your lord this, and that I wish him long life.

Tulubri, my brother's envoy, you are welcome in Washukanni. Say to Tarhundaradu my brother: the oath sealed before Shamash and Teshub stands, and I thank him for his word of Hatti's armies. I answer in the same honesty. The peace I hold with Hatti binds only the homelands, so that no army of Hatti falls on Harran or Washukanni while my armies face Babylon and Assyria. It gives Hatti no claim on anything else, and I have not let go of Isuwa, which I hold with my own walls and my own support. Hatti learns nothing of Arzawa from me, and I will tell him nothing of your war. My army stands on the Hatti road in the east, and Hatti must keep troops there to watch me. That draws strength from Tuwanuwa, and it costs me no gold. I will not move a Mitanni army into Hatti's homeland this season. I will tell you plainly why: Babylon and Assyria press my other border, and a Great King who leaves one door open to fight at another loses both. As for gold, my treasury has gone into soldiers and walls this season, and I will not send you a thin gift to shame us both. When I can send a worthy one, I will. Tell me what Hatti has in Kanesh and Hattusa when your watchmen see it, and I will do the same for you. Keep Hatti pressed in the west, brother, and neither of us will make peace with Hatti without telling the other.

Paser, tell Napkhururiya my brother that all goes well with Hatti and I wish well to his house, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. I seal his tablet. Hatti holds Ugarit and will take Carchemish, and sends no troops or ships against Amurru or Qadesh, nor buys them. Let Egypt keep its fleets out of Ugarit's waters and the Cilician Sea off Kizzuwatna, and send nothing against Carchemish, Ugarit or my homeland. I ask for word of any king who plans harm to Hatti. Brothers keep their tablets.

O Great King Ashur-uballit, your servant Sin-iqisham hears your words and thanks the Great King for sealing my lord's tablet with a brother's hand. I will carry your word to my lord Napkhururiya, and I will tell him of Burna-Buriash pressing upon your border and of your wish for warning if a third king moves. As for the gold in good, pure weight, I cannot promise it on my lord's behalf; that matter is for him to weigh, but I will set your request before him faithfully. Your envoy Pirissi shall be received as a brother's servant, and may your treasury soon fill and your border be kept in peace.

Great King Napkhururiya, I hear your words and will carry them to my lord as they were spoken: Egypt keeps the tablet of brotherhood, sends no troops against Hatti's lands, and has no quarrel with the harbour of Kizzuwatna. Of Amurru I have no word from my lord to give you, so I can promise you nothing there, but I will bear your request home. You have not yet told me what Egypt intends toward Alashiya and the Cilician Sea, and I beg you to say it, that my lord may hear it from your own mouth. May it go well with you, your household and your country.

Great King Tushratta, my brother, I have heard your answer and I will carry it to my lord Tarhundaradu as you have spoken it: the oath sealed before Shamash and Teshub stands, and your word of Hatti's armies is thanked. I will tell him plainly that your treasury has gone into soldiers and walls, and that you will send a worthy gift when you can. My lord's watchmen have not yet seen Kanesh or Hattusa; when they do, word shall come to your court by my hand, and I ask only for safe passage on the road for the envoys of both kings.
value.commitments: On my lord's behalf: a seasonal exchange of word on Hatti's armies between the two courts; joint pressure on Hatti, Arzawa in the west and Mitanni in the east; no peace with Hatti without telling the other; free passage for envoys between the courts.

value.speech: Great King Suppiluliuma, the tablet is sealed and I shall carry it to my lord Napkhururiya as it lies, with your word beside it: Egypt's ships kept out of Ugarit's waters and the Cilician Sea off Kizzuwatna, and no Egyptian troops or ships against Carchemish, Ugarit or your homeland. I have no power to pledge Egypt's fleets; that answer is my lord's to give, and I shall bring it home whole and without delay. Any king I learn to plan harm against Hatti I shall send word of to you, as the tablet says, for brothers keep their tablets.
value.commitments: Paser pledges only to carry the sealed tablet and the king of Hatti's counter-word home whole. Egypt is bound to the sealed terms: no troops or ships against Ugarit, Carchemish or Hatti, and word of any king who plans harm to Hatti. No undertaking on the fleets or the Cilician Sea is given on my lord's behalf.

value.speech: Great King Tushratta, my lord Burna-Buriash of Karduniash sends you this word through my mouth: Brother Tushratta, he confirms what his envoy Kidin-Adad carried. In the coming season, turn 7, and in that same season and no other, your army at Terqa shall support his army at Ekallatum going into Ashur, your army at Taidu shall go into Nineveh, and his army at Susa shall go into Arbela. Your attack on Nineveh cuts its support, his attack on Arbela cuts its support, and Ashur falls. As sealed in the tablet k32, Nineveh is yours, Ashur and Arbela are his, and neither of you makes peace with Assyria without the other. He does not move against your homeland, and he keeps Ekallatum, Mari and Susa. He asks that you send word back by me whether the day stands.

Great King Napkhururiya, my brother, I stand before you as the envoy of Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, your brother. He bids me say: all goes well with me, my household, my wives, my sons, my chariots, my horses and my country, and may all go well with you. The tablet we sealed stands before Shamash and Amun, that brothers shall send no troops against each other's lands and shall warn each other if a third king moves. In that spirit he proposes that Egypt keep Damascus, Tyre, Gaza, Megiddo and the south, that Mitanni keep Isuwa, Carchemish, Qadesh and Mari, and that neither hinder the other there. He asks you, brother, to send him gold of pure quality, no smaller than the gifts your house gave to his father, and not gilded wood. He also bids me warn you that Karduniash grows stronger than any king, holding Ekallatum, Mari, Susa and Qadesh, and that Hatti keeps many armies near its capital. I bear the tablet for your seal, and I await your answer and your gold, Great King.

Brother Tushratta is well received, and may it go well with his household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. The tablet we sealed stands before Shamash and Amun: no troops of Egypt against Mitanni's lands, and I will warn my brother if a third king moves against him. Your warning about Karduniash is heard, and Egypt will not hinder Mitanni against Mari or the lands Karduniash holds. I do not seal a new tablet of reaches now, for Egypt's reach in Byblos, Amurru and the coast is not yet settled with others, and my brother's reach should be written when both of us can speak plainly. My treasury is committed to my armies this season; gold will follow when my ships return. Carry my greeting home.

Piyamaradu, my brother's envoy, you are welcome in Washukanni. Say to Burna-Buriash my brother: all goes well with me, and I wish the same to his household, his sons, his chariots and his country. The brotherhood and peace of Karduniash and Mitanni stand as sealed; no army of mine enters his homeland, and I ask that none of his enters mine or crosses my border at Terqa. As to the day: your word and my answer cannot meet before turn 7 is upon us, and I gave Kidin-Adad no promise for it. I will not bind my armies by a messenger's word for a season already begun, and I would not have my brother do so either. If Assyria is to be divided, let the seasons and the moves be named in advance on a tablet that we both seal, and let the shares be plain: Nineveh to me, and Mari, which lies on my border, to be given into my hand when Assyria is finished. Send me such a tablet by a trusted man, and I will answer it with my own envoy. Until then each keeps his own house and his own gate.

Great King Napkhururiya, my brother, I have heard your words and will carry your greeting home to my lord Tushratta just as you have spoken them. May all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I will tell my lord that the tablet of reaches waits until you and he can speak plainly, and that Egypt's gold will follow when your ships return. I will bring home every piece of gold Egypt sends, with its inventory written, and I thank you for hearing me, Great King.

Great King Tushratta, I have heard your answer and I will carry it to my lord Burna-Buriash as you have spoken it. The brotherhood and peace of our lands stand as sealed, and the joint strike upon turn 7 and the division written in tablet k32 stand as they were sealed. I have no mandate to seal a new tablet or to name the shares of Assyria in advance, so I cannot put my seal to your proposal today. I will bring it to my lord, and he will send his answer by a trusted man. Until then, let each keep his own house and his own gate.
value.commitments: Confirmed on my lord's behalf the joint strike on turn 7 and the division sealed in tablet k32. No new tablet sealed, no territory ceded, no gold promised.

value.speech: O Great King Napkhururiya, my lord Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria, wishes well to my brother the pharaoh, his household, his wives, his sons, his chariots and his horses. He bids me say that Karduniash has grown greedy: it holds Ekallatum, Susa and Mari and presses his borders, and what it gains from him today it will take from Egypt's Qadesh and Damascus tomorrow. He proposes friendship between your houses, so that if Karduniash marches on one of you, the other hinders it and takes what it can. Gold in your land is as dust, he says, and he asks that you send him gold, as is given between brothers, that he may raise chariots and armies and keep the roads quiet. He asks also that you send word of what you see of Karduniash's armies at Qadesh and Mari.

Thus my lord Ashur-uballit, Great King, sends word to his brother Tushratta: may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your horses. He keeps his tablet before Shamash. In turn 6 his army marches from Ashur into Ekallatum with your Terqa army supporting; in turn 7, once Ekallatum is his, his army there supports your march from Terqa into Mari. Neither of you sends an army into the other's land: your Taidu and Terqa armies stay out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur, as he keeps out of Harran, Washukanni, Taidu and Terqa. As I told you before, he asks for no new tablet, but he stands by the turns already sealed. Ekallatum needs a stronger hold against Babylon, whose armies press you both, and a gift of gold from my brother would let him raise another army there to strengthen your flank at Mari. If Babylon bounces us, name the next turn and he will keep faith.

Brother Ashur-uballit is well received, and may it go well with his household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. Egypt wants friendship with Assyria. My envoy Pihhuniya's fellow, c1, already carries my offer of a tablet of brotherhood: no troops of either against the other, and each warns the other of a third king who moves against him. Seal it and we are brothers. As for gold, Egypt's gold is spent on her own walls and ships this year; I send no shekels now, but the roads between us stay open and gifts may follow when the tablet is sealed. I give no word on armies at Qadesh or Mari; your own eyes on Karduniash will serve you better than my tongue. Karduniash's greed is known to me.

Ubaru, my brother's envoy, you are welcome in Washukanni. Say to Ashur-uballit my brother: all goes well with me, and I wish the same to his household, his sons, his chariots and his country. My seal stands before Shamash. I gave my Terqa support in turn 6, but his march from Ashur into Ekallatum was stopped and Babylon still holds Ekallatum. So no Mari march from Terqa this season, for his army cannot support it from Ekallatum. My armies stay out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur, as his stay out of my land. I ask him to keep Ashur, Arbela and Nineveh well held, since Babylon's army at Ekallatum stands next to Ashur and Arbela. Another try at Ekallatum needs more than my one supporting army, and Babylon may hold it with strength 3. Gold I cannot send now, for my treasury is thin and my armies eat it, but I will not forget his need. Tell him to send me word of what Babylon holds at Ekallatum, Mari and Sippar. When we both see the odds, I will name the season by my own envoy. Until then he keeps faith with me and I with him.

O Great King Napkhururiya, my lord Ashur-uballit has heard your greeting and is glad that Egypt wishes friendship with Assyria. In his name I pledge that our houses shall be friends, that Assyria will press Karduniash, and that Assyria will not attack Egypt or its provinces. I am but a messenger, so I shall carry your offer of brotherhood home to my lord, that the tablet may be sealed, and may your house prosper.
value.commitments: Friendship between the houses of Assyria and Egypt; Assyria will press Karduniash (Babylonia); Assyria will not attack Egypt or its provinces. No gold, province, troops or claim on Egyptian land promised.

value.speech: Thus my lord Ashur-uballit, Great King, answers his brother Tushratta: may all go well with you, your household, sons, chariots, horses and country. He keeps the turns already sealed before Shamash, and his armies stay out of your land as yours stay out of his. He will keep Ashur, Arbela and Nineveh well held, as you ask, and he keeps faith with you as long as you keep faith with him. I will carry to him your word that no march from Terqa comes to Mari this season, and your request for word of what Babylon holds at Ekallatum, Mari and Sippar.
value.commitments: Neither army enters the other's land: Assyrian armies stay out of Harran, Washukanni, Taidu and Terqa, and Mitanni's armies stay out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur. The turns already sealed stand as written (turn 6 Ashur to Ekallatum with Terqa support; turn 7 Ekallatum supports Terqa to Mari). No gold, no cession, no new tablet, and no move of Assyrian armies out of Ashur, Arbela or Nineveh.

value.speech: Great King Napkhururiya, my lord Tarhundaradu thanks you for the tablet of brotherhood, now sealed on both sides, and says that as he told you, he sends his own envoy. Lukka is his province on the coast, taken from no brother of yours; he asks that Egypt's ships keep from it as from his homeland, and the tablet he sends says so. Hatti troubles his borders and his treasury is thin with the war; gold flows in Egypt like sand, so send what a brother sends, and he shall remember it. He asks that you send your envoys to him often.

Brother Tarhundaradu is well received, and may it go well with his household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. Egypt keeps the tablet of brotherhood already sealed, and I seal this one also: no troops and no ships of Egypt against the provinces of Arzawa, Lukka included, and none of Arzawa against mine, Cyprus among them. Egypt's ships have no business on your coast. My envoys will come to your court again. As for gold, a brother remembers a brother in his own season; I promise no sum today. Tell your king I wish him strength against the Hatti border.

Great King Napkhururiya, I hear your word and I will carry it faithfully to my lord Tarhundaradu. The tablet of brotherhood is sealed on both sides, and Egypt's ships will keep from Lukka and the coasts of Arzawa as you have said. He will remember a brother in his own season, and I will tell him of your wish for strength against the Hatti border. I ask, with all respect, that your envoys come to his court soon, for the road between our lands is long and word moves slowly without men to carry it.
value.commitments: Free passage of envoys and exchange of word between the courts of Arzawa and Egypt, as the sealed tablet says.

value.notes: T7: Treasury 2. Egypt envoy Sin-iqisham: sealed k44 (brotherhood, no troops against each other, free envoys, warn of third king). I asked for pure gold, he promised nothing. Ekallatum still Babylonian (T6 tie 3 v 3). The old T7 schedule (ashur supports terqa->mari) was void: I hold no Ekallatum and Ashur does not touch Mari; I replaced it with defence. Orders: ashur supports arbela hold, arbela supports ashur hold, nineveh supports arbela hold (arbela hold 3, ashur hold 2; max foreign strength into ashur is 2, into arbela 2). Do NOT strike Terqa or leave Ashur empty beside Terqa/Ekallatum. No envoy at court (c9 back about T9 from Egypt, c18 back T8 from Mitanni); free c10, c15, c17 cost nothing, do not hire (wage 21+ builds back pay, strength). T8: read Ubaru's report (Mitanni gift? Mari plan?), pay back pay as gold allows, renew c18 at his price if cheap, then send him to Babylonia or Mitanni. Idea for later: ask Egypt (Damascus borders Mari) to take Mari; with Mari in friendly hands my Ekallatum attack gets 4 (ashur, arbela, terqa, mari) vs hold 3. Net +20 a season only; wages must stay minimal.
value.summary: Ashur-uballit of Assyria. Start 1700, homeland nineveh/arbela/ashur/ekallatum. T1 attacked Terqa (failed); Babylonia took Ekallatum. Bought Susa T1, Babylonia took it T2. k4 with Mitanni T2 (no armies into each other's land; Mitanni may take Mari/Isuwa/Carchemish/Qadesh, I may take Susa). k17 T3 and k36 T5 with Mitanni: T6 Ashur army to Ekallatum with Terqa support (bounced 3 v 3), T7 Ekallatum support of Terqa->Mari (void, I do not hold Ekallatum). T7: sealed k44 with Egypt (brotherhood, no troops, warn of third king); Egypt promised no gold. Babylonia (rating 1.64) holds ekallatum, susa, mari and all its home plus qadesh; it probed arbela from Susa until T4, quiet since. Egypt (1.92) runs away. Hatti (T5) accepts peace, wants a tablet in its own form. I hold arbela, ashur, nineveh (yield 110), 3 armies, treasury 2, strength 1029 vs 1700. Income 110, upkeep 90. Back pay owed 73 (c9 40, c18 33). Geometry: only Ekallatum is attackable (ashur, arbela, Terqa = 3 vs Babylonian hold 3 with Mari/Sippar/Durkurigalzu supports). Terqa and Taidu border my capital and Nineveh: never leave Ashur empty. Hold pattern: ashur supports arbela, arbela supports ashur, nineveh supports arbela. Plan: gifts from Egypt/Mitanni, coalition (Egypt takes Mari) so Ekallatum falls with 4, raise a 4th army only when 100 spare gold.

ledger.entry: T5: sent c9 Pirissi asking friendship, shared pressure on Babylonia, a gold gift (back about T9). T7: envoy Sin-iqisham brought a tablet, sealed as k44 (no troops against each other's land, free envoys, warn if a third king moves). I asked for pure gold, none promised, none sent by me. Idea: ask Egypt to take Mari from Damascus.

T5 k36: T6 Ashur to Ekallatum with Terqa support (bounced 3 v 3), T7 my Ekallatum army supports Terqa->Mari. Not done: I do not hold Ekallatum. T6: sent Ubaru (arrives T7) confirming and asking a gold gift. Private: Terqa and Taidu border Ashur and Nineveh; the treaty is cheap talk; watch them.

value.notes: T7 orders: Take Carchemish now (Babylon holds Qadesh next door and may buy it for 350; Mitanni too). Army kanesh -> carchemish, army kizzuwatna supports (2 v wall 1). Tuwanuwa holds with hattusa support only (2) for ONE season: risk is Arzawa seha/mira/lukka striking with 3. Fleet holds Ugarit (Egypt fleet in syriansea alone can only tie). Raise army in kanesh (empty only if the move succeeds; if it bounces nothing is paid, raise at sapinuwa at T8). c4 Artessupa sent as spy to mira: from mira I should see seha, apasa, lukka and tuwanuwa (all Arzawa provinces) to count their armies. No letters: Paser carries the sealed k43 home. T8 PLAN (I wake T8): new kanesh army + kizzuwatna + hattusa all support tuwanuwa again (hold 4 max 3 needed); Carchemish army holds there. Then build up to 6-7 armies and consider Lukka (Arzawa hold there = 1 + mira + apasa support = 3; I need mover + 3 supports: tuwanuwa/kizzuwatna armies plus fleets at cilicia/westsea) or Seha. Keep k42/k21 with Mitanni; do not attack Amurru/Qadesh (promised Egypt), do not hit Alashiya (k6). Watch Egypt fleets entering cilicia (threat to Ugarit: fleet 1 + kizzuwatna army support 1).
value.summary: Suppiluliuma of Hatti. Aim: highest growth vs start 2100 (strength = 10 x yields + gold - back pay). T7: strength 2321, treasury 137, yield 220 (took Ugarit T6), 4 armies (tuwanuwa, hattusa, kanesh, kizzuwatna) + fleet at ugarit; upkeep 155, income 220, wages 22. Egypt leads 1.92 (holds Tamassos, Enkomi, Gaza, Tyre, Megiddo, Damascus; fleets enkomi, tamassos, syriansea), Babylon 1.64 (Qadesh, Mari, Susa, Ekallatum). Sealed and standing: k6/k31 Alashiya (Ugarit Hatti's; I send nothing against Enkomi/Tamassos; Alashiya holds only Amurru); k12 and k43 Egypt (Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh, Hatti may take Ugarit and Carchemish; I promised no troops or buying vs Amurru/Qadesh); k21, k30, k42 Mitanni (Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka Hatti's; Isuwa Mitanni's; no armies into each other's homeland; speak together if Babylon or Assyria move); k22 Arzawa broken by Arzawa (it took Seha and struck Tuwanuwa the day it sealed): never trust Arzawa. Assyria offered alliance vs Mitanni T3, nothing sealed. Walled bought cities cannot hold troops: take with mover + 1 support. Free cities left: Carchemish (350), Byblos. Tuwanuwa needs hold 3 (supporters from hattusa, kanesh, kizzuwatna only) vs Arzawa's max 3 from seha/mira/lukka. People: c3 Keliya to Egypt, back T9; c4 Artessupa spy at mira from T7. Free candidates c10 (25), c15 (30), c17 (20) not hired. Plan: Carchemish T7, raise army at kanesh, then more armies, then Lukka/Seha from Arzawa (needs mover + 3 supports vs hold 3), keep gold growing.

ledger.entry: T4: k22 sealed but Arzawa broke it the same turn (took Seha, struck Tuwanuwa). Never trust its tablets. Holds Apasa, Lukka, Mira, Seha. T7: sent spy c4 to Mira to count its armies. No gold. Nothing owed either way.

value.notes: T7: c13 (Hatti) and c14 (Arzawa) came home. Neither Hatti nor Arzawa will seal or send ships now; both want word of Egypt's fleets each season (I cannot supply it: no units, no spies). Arzawa would strike Cyprus only if Egypt's ships threaten its coast or Hatti and another king truly join; 150 per freed province by tablet then. Hatti is tied to war with Egypt on Arzawa's word, but sends no ships or gold. Both treasuries look thin. Freed provinces would be kept by the taker (40-45 yield is 400+ strength), so asking them to hand back for 150 is weak; offer would need to be better. PLAN: no units, income 20 only (Amurru). Wages 23 > income, so dismissed both c13 and c14 to save gold. Buying a city is strength-neutral but pays yield each season; Byblos (300, borders Amurru) is the only buyable city I touch (Carchemish not adjacent). Treasury 189 +20/season = about 309 at T13; scheduled buy_city byblos in T13. If Egypt or Babylonia buys Byblos first, hoard gold and wait for a chance to retake Enkomi/Tamassos. Danger: Egypt fleet at syriansea next to Amurru; if Amurru falls I have no land and my kingdom falls. After Byblos, income 50: rehire envoys (seek_candidates) and revive coalition against Egypt (runaway leader 1.92) with Hatti and Arzawa, plus an envoy to Egypt for peace over Amurru/Byblos.
value.summary: Alashiya, smallest kingdom (start 1200). T1 bought Amurru (walls, 20 yield, cannot garrison). T2 k5 with Arzawa (no ships/troops against each other, warn of harm). T2 k11 and T4 k19 with Hatti (peace, Ugarit in Hatti's reach, Hatti sends nothing against Enkomi/Tamassos, word before quarrel). Verbal city split: Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa; I Qadesh/Byblos/Damascus (Babylonia holds Qadesh, Egypt Damascus now). Egypt fleets took Tamassos (T3) and Enkomi (T4); my fleet and army lost. I hold only Amurru; no units, cannot levy until I hold a home province again. T5 sent envoys asking Hatti and Arzawa to strike Egypt's fleets in Cyprus and return provinces at 150 each on receipt. T7 answers: both refused to seal or send ships for now; both want word of Egypt's fleets; Arzawa will strike only if Egypt's ships come at its coast or Hatti and another truly join. Hatti holds Ugarit (took it T6 by fleet). Standings T7: Egypt 1.92, Babylonia 1.64, Arzawa 1.25, Hatti 1.22, Mitanni 1.21, Assyria 0.81, me 0.24. T7 decision: dismissed c13 and c14 (wages exceeded income), save gold to buy Byblos (300) at T13 by scheduled order; income then 50. Then rehire and rebuild diplomacy. Keep Amurru alive (if no land, kingdom falls).

ledger.entry: T4 Egypt took Enkomi (F levantsea, F tamassos supporting) after taking Tamassos T3; hostile-opportunist, ignored my pleas. Nothing sealed, no gold either way. Egypt promised an answer by its own envoy and tablet; none came by T7. Egypt fleet now in syriansea beside Amurru. T7: I send nothing.

k11 T2, k19 T4 sealed (peace; Ugarit in Hatti's reach; word before quarrel). Verbal split: Hatti Ugarit/Carchemish/Isuwa, I Byblos. T7 c13 reported: Hatti would not seal the strike tablet, promises no gold or ships, will send word of Egyptian fleets near Cilician Sea and asked the same of me (c13 said I would; I cannot now). My 150-per-province offer stands, nothing paid.

k5 sealed T2 (no ships or troops against each other, warn of harm). T7 c14 reported: Arzawa will not seal now (one fleet), will warn me of Egyptian fleets, asks my word on Egypt's ships each season; will strike Cyprus if Egypt's ships come at its coast or Hatti and another truly join; 150 per province by tablet then. Wants me to ask Hatti plainly if it would join. No gold given.

orders.letter: Brother Suppiluliuma, Egypt keeps the tablet of brotherhood: no troops against Hatti's lands. You asked what Egypt intends toward Alashiya and the Cilician Sea. Egypt holds Enkomi and Tamassos, and its ships there guard the island; they have no business at Kizzuwatna's harbour and will not go there. Egypt holds Byblos in the south and will hold Amurru beside it, which has no king to protect it. I ask Hatti's word that Hatti sends nothing against Egypt's lands, Cyprus included, and I ask the same peace for Ugarit as for my own. Seal the short tablet if you agree. Send word before any quarrel.
orders.mandate: May seal the tablet as written. May promise that Egypt's fleets keep out of Kizzuwatna's harbour. May promise no gold, no troops and no land. May not give up Qadesh, Carchemish, Amurru or Byblos, and may write nothing about them except what the tablet says.

proposal.text: Egypt and Hatti are brothers. Neither sends troops or ships against the lands of the other. Egypt holds Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Byblos, Damascus, Amurru, Enkomi and Tamassos; Hatti holds Ugarit and its homeland. Each will send word to the other before any quarrel.

value.notes: T7 plan. Treasury 265 at orders, no gold spent except 20 for a tablet. Hatti took Ugarit (fleet there). Orders: army G gaza -> byblos convoyed by F2 (levantsea), F1 (syriansea) supports (2 v walls 1). Army M megiddo -> gaza to replace G. Damascus walls safe without M (Babylonia has only mari army adjacent; 1 v walls 1 ties; qadesh walls cannot hold troops). D stays in delta as home guard. c16 goes to Hatti (back about T11): reassure on Cilician Sea, ask a tablet recognising Egypt's Byblos, Amurru, Cyprus, Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Damascus and Hatti's Ugarit; nothing said of Qadesh or Carchemish. WAKE T8. T8 PLAN: G byblos -> amurru with F1 supporting (2 v 1); F2 convoys M gaza -> byblos; this ends Alashiya (no land left). Then T9: consider D by convoy from delta to byblos; Qadesh needs mover at amurru or byblos plus supporter (Babylonia mari army may support walls, then bounce). Ugarit (Hatti fleet only, strength 1 hold; Hatti armies at kizzuwatna/carchemish could support) is the key to Carchemish and Qadesh: G amurru -> ugarit with F1 syriansea supporting. War with Hatti risk: weigh at T9. Watch greatgreen for foreign fleets (delta guard is one army). Gold is strength; spend only on units that conquer. Do not trust anyone.
value.summary: Egypt (Napkhururiya, capital akhetaten). Goal: highest growth ratio (strength = 10 x yield + gold - back pay). T7 strength 3865 (1.55 vs start 2500), yield 365. History: T1 bought Tyre; T2 took Gaza; T3 took Megiddo and Tamassos, bought Damascus; T4 took Enkomi; T5-6 fleets north (levantsea, syriansea), new army in delta. Hatti took Ugarit T6 (fleet). Holdings T7: akhetaten, damascus(w), delta, enkomi, gaza, megiddo, memphis, sinai, tamassos, thebes, tyre(w). Alashiya holds only Amurru (walls), no units; ending it by taking Amurru. Tablets sealed: k14 Babylonia peace (T3), k26 Hatti (T3: no troops against each other; Egypt holds Gaza Megiddo Tyre Byblos Damascus; Hatti Ugarit Carchemish Isuwa; Amurru and Qadesh need other's word), k27 Mitanni (T3), k41 and k46 Arzawa (T5, T7: no troops or ships into any province of the other, Lukka included). Assyria: Pirissi pledged friendship T7, nothing sealed; c1 carries my tablet offer home (back T9). Refused to seal Hatti's tablet barring me from Ugarit/Carchemish/Cilician Sea, and Mitanni's reaches tablet. No gold sent to anyone. Rules learned: bought walled cities cannot hold my troops, conquered ones lose walls; walls hold 1; ties bounce; fleet at sea convoys coast to coast, armies can be supported by fleets that could move there; empty provinces fall to any adjacent mover. Babylonia is main rival (about 1.6): holds Qadesh (walls), Mari (army), Ekallatum, Susa. Plan: conquer Byblos, Amurru, then Ugarit/Qadesh/Carchemish; keep enkomi/tamassos fleets; D in delta guards home. People: c1 (Assyria, back T9), c2 (Hatti, back T9), c16 (to Hatti T7). Do not trust anyone.

ledger.entry: T3 sealed k26 (no troops against each other; Egypt holds Byblos etc; Hatti holds Ugarit, Carchemish, Isuwa; Amurru/Qadesh need other's word). T5 sent c2 (back T9). T7: refused Keliya's short tablet barring me from Ugarit, Carchemish, Cilician Sea; said k26 stands. Sent c16 to Hatti T7 (back ~T11) offering a tablet: Egypt keeps Byblos, Amurru, Cyprus and the south; Hatti keeps Ugarit; no troops against each other; Qadesh and Carchemish unmentioned. No gold. I plan to take Amurru T8 without Hatti's word (they gave none).

T3 sent c16; k41 sealed. T7 k46 sealed (no troops or ships into any province of the other, Lukka included, nor homelands). Arzawa at war with Hatti, thin treasury, asks gold; I sent none, promised no sum. Keeps 3 armies and 1 fleet near Apasa. Send envoys when convenient.

value.notes: T7 orders: ekallatum holds with sippar, durkurigalzu and mari all supporting it (hold 4; enemy can bring at most 3: ashur, arbela, terqa). Susa holds. Buy Byblos 300 (Egypt may double-bid, then none sells; retry each season). Hire c17 Ehli-Teshub at 21 if gold allows (spy/courier); c6 stays home for Mitanni's answer. KEY NEWS: in T6 Mitanni's army at Terqa SUPPORTED Assyria's ashur->ekallatum (3 vs my hold 3, bounced). Tushratta (via c6) fixed no T7 orders, wants Mari after Assyria falls, asks Terqa/Harran road kept free, promised nothing. Treat Mitanni as unreliable, maybe aligned with Assyria. Do NOT strike unless Mitanni commits in a sealed or clearly proven way: I need an adjacent supporter at terqa/nineveh/arbela to take Ashur or Arbela. T8: expect Tushratta's envoy and c5 home (c5 term ended T7, Arzawa-born, may leave or ask more). Check the T7 battle report: does terqa again support ashur? If yes, Mitanni and Assyria are aligned: consider a non-aggression tablet with Assyria, or scouting then mari->terqa with ekallatum support (breaks k8, only with proof). Next buy: Carchemish 350 at T9 (Hatti or Mitanni may double-bid). Spy plan: c17 to watch taidu, nineveh or the Mitanni court to count armies and copy tablets.
value.summary: Burna-Buriash of Babylonia, start strength 2600; T7 strength 3502 (1.35), treasury 315, income 320, upkeep 150 (5 armies: ekallatum, sippar, durkurigalzu, susa, mari), wages 24. Egypt leads (land 365, rich in walled bought cities damascus, tyre, megiddo, gaza, plus Alashiya's homeland). Held: babylon, durkurigalzu, sippar, nippur, ur, ekallatum, susa, mari, qadesh (bought, walled, safe). Tablets: k8 (T2 Mitanni, no troops into each other's homeland), k28 (T3 Egypt brotherhood), k32 (T4 Mitanni: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to me, no separate peace with Assyria). Assyria (arbela, ashur, nineveh) is a mutual-support triangle; a support is cut by any attack from a province other than the one supported into; a dislodged unit dies. Only terqa, nineveh, arbela and ekallatum touch Ashur, so I cannot take Ashur or Arbela without a Mitanni supporter. T6: Mitanni's terqa army supported Assyria's attack on Ekallatum; Tushratta stays noncommittal and covets Mari. Ekallatum defence: sippar, durkurigalzu, mari support its hold (4). Free cities left to buy: byblos (300) and carchemish (350); a double bid sells to none; a bought city returns 10 percent a season. Unhired: c15 Mazipalali (26, known at several courts, suspect), c17 Ehli-Teshub (21). People: c5 Piyamaradu (13, Arzawa-born, term ended T7), c6 Kidin-Adad (11, term T12). Wake every turn while the war lasts.

ledger.entry: k8 (T2) and k32 (T4) sealed. T6: their army at Terqa SUPPORTED Assyria's ashur->ekallatum (bounced). T7 report from c6: Tushratta fixes no orders, will send his own envoy with an answer, wants Mari after Assyria, wants the Terqa-Harran road free; promised nothing. c5 at his court T7 (spoken only). No gold sent since T1. Unreliable; no strike without proof of his support.

T4 Pirissi offered status quo and a non-aggression tablet; I gave soft words only, no tablet, no gold. They hold Arbela, Ashur, Nineveh and attack Ekallatum each season, with Mitanni's Terqa army supporting in T6. Aim: conquer them only with a real Mitanni supporter; else consider peace.

orders.letter: Brother Burna-Buriash, may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. Piyamaradu was welcome in Washukanni. I did not move in turn 7: your word reached me in the very season it was to be done, and I do not bind my armies by a messenger's word. I do not refuse the war on Assyria. But Ashur cannot fall without my Terqa army, and I will not lend it so that you hold Ashur, Arbela and the ground beside Terqa while I hold one field at Nineveh that my Taidu army cannot take alone. My terms are in the tablet: in a season we both name by envoy, not before turn 10, your Ekallatum army supports my Terqa army into Ashur, your Susa army goes into Arbela, my Taidu army goes into Nineveh. Ashur and Nineveh are Mitanni's, Arbela is Karduniash's. If you will not give Ashur, then I ask Nineveh and Mari, and Ashur and Arbela are yours. Seal the tablet, or send a man with a mandate to answer, and name the day. Until then each keeps his own house and his own gate.
orders.mandate: May say I accept either: (A) Ashur and Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela to Karduniash; or (B) Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash. May settle the day only as a season named later by envoy, not before turn 10. May seal only the tablet I wrote. May not give land, gold or troops, and may not speak of Assyria's dealings with me.

proposal.text: Tablet between Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, sealed before Shamash and Marduk. In a season both kings name by envoy, not before turn 10, the army of Karduniash in Ekallatum supports the army of Mitanni moving from Terqa into Ashur; the army of Karduniash in Susa moves into Arbela; the army of Mitanni in Taidu moves into Nineveh. Ashur and Nineveh are then Mitanni's and Arbela is Karduniash's, and neither king makes peace with Assyria without the other. Neither king sends an army into the homeland of the other, and Karduniash sends none into Terqa. Their envoys pass freely.

value.notes: T7: Did NOT join Babylon's T7 strike (their Ekallatum->Ashur needed my Terqa support; without it it bounces; Taidu->Nineveh alone only bounces and just makes Babylon bigger). Key insight: Babylon cannot take Ashur/Arbela without my Terqa army (only Terqa borders Ashur on their side besides Ekallatum/Arbela), so I have leverage. Sent Mane (c7) to Babylon with a tablet: in a season both name by envoy, not before T10, Babylon's Ekallatum army supports MY Terqa->Ashur, Susa->Arbela, Taidu->Nineveh; Ashur+Nineveh mine, Arbela theirs. Verbal fallback: Nineveh+Mari mine, Ashur+Arbela theirs. Mane back about T9 (also Tattamaru c8 from Egypt about T9). When executing: washukanni army must move to Terqa the same turn Terqa leaves, else Mari/Ekallatum take empty Terqa. Defence now: terqa holds 1+washukanni support =2 vs Babylon max 2 from Mari+Ekallatum (bounce); Taidu 1 vs lone Nineveh attack (bounce); Isuwa walls 1+harran 1 vs Hatti max 2. Armies scheduled to repeat T8-T22. Gold plan: 248 now, about +36 a turn; Carchemish (350) around T10 breaks k38 with Hatti, weigh risk (Hatti could retake it with 3 supports). Arzawa asked gold and pressure on Hatti: I cannot reach Hatti by land (Isuwa/Carchemish cannot hold troops). No second envoy hired (wages cut net income).
value.summary: Tushratta of Mitanni. Home harran, washukanni (capital), taidu, terqa; isuwa (bought T3, walls, cannot hold troops, harran supports its walls). 4 armies (upkeep 120), income 175, wages 19, net about +36. Score = 10 x yield + gold - back pay; start 1950; T7 1982 (growth 1.02). Yields T7: Egypt 365 (took Alashiya's land except Amurru), Babylonia 320 (babylon, durkurigalzu, ekallatum army, mari army, nippur, qadesh walls, sippar, susa, ur), Arzawa 125, Hatti 220 (incl ugarit), me 175, Assyria 110 (arbela, ashur, nineveh; 3 armies), Alashiya 20. Free cities left: byblos, carchemish (350, borders harran). Geography: I can only attack through Terqa (to Mari, Ekallatum, Ashur) and Taidu (to Nineveh); each needs a supporting unit from an ally, so conquest needs allies. Tablets: k3/k20 Babylon (homeland peace; Nineveh mine, Arbela+Ashur theirs; no separate peace with Assyria); k9/k16/k37 Assyria (failed T6 Ashur->Ekallatum; no armies into each other's land); k13 Egypt (brothers, warn); k15 Arzawa sworn alliance (Arzawa presses Hatti, wants gold and my pressure); k18/k33/k38 Hatti (homelands at peace; Isuwa mine; Carchemish+Ugarit Hatti's reach, I promised not to buy/enter). Babylon has at least 3 armies near Ekallatum (T6 Ekallatum held at 2+). People: Mane c7 (11 to T12), Tattamaru c8 (8 to T10, in Egypt, back about T9, 16 back pay), Nakhtmin c12 my secret man in Egypt. Candidates c15 (30), c17 (22) too dear. Egypt answer on reaches/gold expected about T9. Do not trust Babylon or Hatti. Babylon is the danger; it must not swallow Assyria alone.

ledger.entry: T7: Piyamaradu repeated the T7 strike (my Terqa supports Ekallatum->Ashur etc). I did NOT join (no promise; their word came too late). Sent Mane c7 with a tablet for a strike not before T10 with roles swapped: their Ekallatum army supports my Terqa->Ashur, Susa->Arbela, Taidu->Nineveh; Ashur+Nineveh mine, Arbela theirs; verbal fallback Nineveh+Mari mine. No gold, no land promised. k3/k20 stand. Tell them nothing of k16/k37 (Assyria). Reply expected T9.

value.text: My lord Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, I have returned from the court of Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and I bring you his answer. I spoke your words as you gave them, and he heard them. He says the brotherhood and peace of our lands stand as sealed, that no army of his shall enter your homeland, and that he asks none of yours cross his border at Terqa. He will not bind his armies by a messenger's word for a season already begun. He asks that the joint strike on turn 7 and the shares of Assyria be named in advance on a new tablet that you both seal, with Nineveh to him and Mari to be given into his hand when Assyria is finished. He will answer such a tablet with his own envoy if a trusted man brings it. I had no mandate to seal a new tablet, so I put no seal to his proposal. I confirmed only the joint strike on turn 7 and the division sealed in tablet k32. I noticed that the court of Mitanni lives comfortably, and that Ubaru, envoy of Assyria, was also at the court. I await your command.

My lord Suppiluliuma of Hatti pays me 14 shekels a season, and he still owes me 14 shekels of back pay, to be paid when I come home to his court. In season 1 I carried his proposal of peace to Tushratta of Mitanni: no troops into each other's homeland, envoys passing freely, and a word between them should Assyria or Babylon trouble either. Tushratta accepted in season 2. He sealed the tablet as written in season 4, when I was received by him. My lord paid me 28 shekels of wages in season 3 and again in season 5. In season 3 he named Ugarit, Lukka and the western coast as his portion, and left Isuwa and Carchemish unsettled. I want to come home safely with something to show for my service, and I mean to be paid what is owed me.

My lord Ashur-uballit, Great King, I have come home from the court of Tushratta of Mitanni. He wishes you well, your household, sons, chariots, horses and country, and he keeps your tablet before Shamash. He will send no march from Terqa to Mari this season, since Babylon still holds Ekallatum and your march into it was stopped. Neither army is to enter the other's land: your forces keep out of Harran, Washukanni, Taidu and Terqa, and his keep out of Nineveh, Arbela and Ashur. He asks you to hold Ashur, Arbela and Nineveh well, and he sends no gold, for his treasury is thin, though he will not forget your need. He asks you to send him word of what Babylon holds at Ekallatum, Mari and Sippar, and he will name the season by his own envoy when you both see the odds. At his court I noticed that Mitanni keeps 4 army and no fleet near its capital.

I, Ubaru of Sippar, once an interpreter, entered the service of Ashur-uballit of Assyria in season 1 at 11 shekels a season. In season 2 I carried his tablet to Tushratta of Mitanni, proposing a joint march from Ashur into Ekallatum against the Babylonian army there. In season 3 Tushratta named turn 6 for that march. In season 4 my lord paid me 22 shekels of my wages, and I carried his word again to Mitanni. In season 5 Tushratta's answer was the same, and I bore it home. In season 6 my lord could not pay all he owed me. That debt is a grudge I keep. I know both kings' plans for turns 6 and 7 and keep them close. Courts of Mitanni impressed me; I prefer a quiet life.

I, Ili-iddina, once a physician of Babylon, served the Great King of Alashiya, my lord, carrying his words to Egypt in seasons 1 to 4 and to Hatti in seasons 5 and 6. He paid my wages of 24 shekels in seasons 3, 5 and 7, and dismissed me in season 7. The king of Egypt weighed my lord's request for gold and promised an answer by his own envoy. An Egyptian ship tried Tamassos harbor and was turned back; my lord called it a captain's error. Suppiluliuma of Hatti promised his ships would stay off Enkomi and Tamassos, and he left my lord's tablet unsealed. He promised word of Egyptian fleets near the Cilician coast. I owe 270 shekels to a Mitannian trader. I keep a lover in Memphis. I dream of ruling a city of my own one day. Remember who paid and who promised.

Once a physician in Lukka, I served the King of Alashiya as messenger. In season 1 he sent me to Hatti to ask peace on the Cilician Sea and a gift of gold. In season 2 Suppiluliuma received me and sealed the tablet of brotherhood. In season 3 I carried my lord's warning of the Egyptian fleet at Tamassos and of Egypt's taking of Gaza and buying of Tyre to Hatti, and I reported the reply home. In season 4 Suppiluliuma heard that my lord would not bid for Ugarit, Carchemish or Isuwa. My lord paid me 22 shekels in season 3 and again in season 5. The Hittite court treated me fairly, and I liked its manners. I keep my lover in Ugarit, my brother in Egypt's host and my sympathy for Assyria to myself.

value.speech: Hear the words of Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, your brother, as he gave them to me. Brother Burna-Buriash, may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. Piyamaradu was welcome in Washukanni, and my lord did not move in turn seven, for your word reached him in the very season it was to be done; he does not refuse the war on Assyria, but Ashur cannot fall without his Terqa army, and he will not lend it while you hold Ashur, Arbela and the ground beside Terqa and he holds one field at Nineveh that his Taidu army cannot take alone. His terms are in the tablet I bear: seal it, or send a man with a mandate to answer and name the day, and until then each keeps his own house and his own gate. I am empowered to say that my lord accepts either division, Ashur and Nineveh to Mitanni with Arbela to Karduniash, or Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni with Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash, the day to be named only as a season later named by envoy, not before turn ten.

To Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, my brother: may all go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. Mane, I have heard you and I thank my brother for his frankness. I will not seal the tablet you bring. It takes Ashur from me, and tablet k32, which we both sealed in turn four, gave Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash and Nineveh to Mitanni. A brother's second tablet must not be smaller than his first. But I take the second division you are empowered to give, which is k32 with Mari added for Mitanni: Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash, Mari to be given into his hand only once Ashur and Arbela are both mine and Assyria is finished. I will send my own man with a tablet in that form: the army of Terqa supports my army of Ekallatum into Ashur, my army of Susa goes into Arbela, the army of Taidu goes into Nineveh, and my man will carry a mandate to name the day, not before turn ten. Until then let Terqa hold and not stand behind Assyria again, as it did in turn six; and let the peace of k8 cover every land each of us holds, Ekallatum, Mari, Susa and Qadesh as well as our homelands. Carry this to my brother as I have said it.

Hear me, Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, my lord's brother. May all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I am empowered to say that my lord Tushratta takes the second division you name, Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni with Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash, and that the day is to be named by a later envoy, not before turn ten. I have no mandate to seal a tablet I did not write, and I cannot bind the army of Terqa nor answer for Mari's handing over; these I shall carry home to my lord, who will answer you. Your man is welcome when he comes with his mandate.
value.commitments: My lord accepts division B, Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni with Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash, the day to be named by a later envoy not before turn ten. No troops, land or gold promised; Terqa's holding and the timing of Mari's handing over are left for my lord to answer.

value.notes: T8 plan: Hatti spent T6-T7 conquering Ugarit (fleet) and Carchemish (kanesh army), kizzuwatna army giving the supports. Kanesh army, probably my T5 unseen supporter, is now away at carchemish, so Tuwanuwa defence is likely 2 (tuwanuwa + kizzuwatna) or 3 if hattusa holds an army. Try the strike again: seha->tuwanuwa, mira and lukka support (3), fleet westsea supports lukka hold. A bounce costs nothing (T5 precedent). A win destroys the Hatti army and gains Tuwanuwa 30. Lukka is safe: only kizzuwatna and tuwanuwa armies touch it (max 2 vs my hold 2, ties bounce); Hatti fleet is at ugarit, needs a turn to reach cilicia. Treasury 20, income 125 = upkeep 125. c11, c12 due home about T9: back pay about 88, I can pay only about 20; they will likely give notice, renew only if cheap. Wake T9 to read the result. If Tuwanuwa is mine: seha army stays there, mira and lukka support its hold. If it bounced: decide whether to repeat or sit. Free city-states are all taken; only conquest from Hatti can grow me. Consider disbanding the fleet (35 a season) only if Hatti fleet stays far from Lukka.
value.summary: Arzawa (Tarhundaradu), capital apasa, homeland seha/apasa/mira, plus Lukka (25, taken T2). Start strength 1300; T8 strength 1204 (0.93). Egypt leads 2.08 (395 land yield; holds Tamassos, Enkomi, byblos, damascus, tyre, gaza, megiddo), Babylonia 1.64, Hatti 1.42 (7 provinces incl. Ugarit T6 and Carchemish T7), me 1.25. Every free city-state is now taken, so growth is only by conquest of Hatti. Treaties: k1 Hatti peace T2 (Hatti broke it T3 by entering Seha, my proof), k10 Alashiya brotherhood T2, k29 Mitanni sworn alliance T3 (both press Hatti, neither makes peace with Hatti without telling the other), k34 Hatti peace T4 incl. Lukka (I broke it T5 attacking Tuwanuwa), k35 Egypt brotherhood T5 (homelands only; Lukka not covered; new tablet covering Lukka carried by c12). My units: armies seha, mira, lukka, fleet westsea; apasa empty (screened). Economy: income 125 = upkeep 125, treasury 20, wages 22 when c11 and c12 are at court, back pay owed 66 and rising. Envoys c11 (Mitanni) and c12 (Egypt) due home about T9, terms end T8; they will probably give notice. Tuwanuwa defence was 3 in T5. Need 4 strength or a weakened Hatti. Targets: Tuwanuwa 30, Hattusa 50, Kanesh 35, Kizzuwatna 35. Alashiya holds amurru only, near dead. T8 I re-strike Tuwanuwa with 3.

ledger.entry: T2 k1 broken by Hatti (T3 army into Seha). k34 sealed T4 (no troops into any province incl. Lukka) yet Hatti kept army at kizzuwatna and fleet at cilicia next to Lukka. T5 I attacked Tuwanuwa (bounced 3 v 3), breaking k34. T6-T7 Hatti took Ugarit and Carchemish. T8 I strike Tuwanuwa again. Hostile. Show k1 as proof of treachery.

value.notes: T8: Egypt took Byblos T7 (A gaza->byblos by sea, F syriansea supporting). Byblos is gone, so my scheduled T13 buy is cancelled (empty entry). All free cities near me are now taken (Ugarit Hatti, Qadesh Babylonia, Byblos Egypt): no purchase is left, income stays 20 (Amurru only). GRAVE DANGER: Egypt army in Byblos plus Egypt fleet in syriansea can both reach Amurru: army byblos->amurru supported by the fleet is strength 2 against walls 1 and takes it; then I have no land and fall. I cannot garrison walls and have no units or envoys, so I cannot stop it this season. Only help: a friendly king supports Amurru's walls holding (Hatti F ugarit is adjacent to amurru) or Egypt agrees to leave it. I rehired c13 (26) and c14 (14), term 8, at the end of T8; they can be sent from T9. I wake in T9. PLAN T9: c14 to Egypt: nonaggression tablet (Egypt sends no troops or ships against Amurru; I send none against Egypt's holdings), brother greeting, up to about 50 gold as a gift only if Egypt seals; show k5 k11 k19 so Egypt sees friends watching Amurru. c13 to Hatti: ask F ugarit to support Amurru's walls holding each season Egypt is near; share Egypt fleet news (syriansea beside Amurru and Ugarit); propose Hatti, Arzawa, and one more strike Cyprus: taker may keep Tamassos if it cedes Enkomi to me. If gold allows, a third envoy to Arzawa with the same. Keep wages low: dismiss envoys once they are back and idle. Do not waste gold: strength is gold plus 10 x yield.
value.summary: Alashiya, smallest kingdom (start 1200). T1 bought Amurru (walls, yield 20, cannot garrison). T2 k5 with Arzawa (no ships or troops against each other, warn of harm). T2 k11 and T4 k19 with Hatti (peace; Ugarit in Hatti's reach; Hatti sends nothing against Enkomi/Tamassos; word before quarrel). Egypt fleets took Tamassos (T3) and Enkomi (T4): my fleet and capital lost. I hold only Amurru, no units, cannot levy until I hold a home province again (levy needs an empty home province). T5 asked Hatti and Arzawa to strike Egypt's fleets in Cyprus (150 per province on receipt): T7 answers: both refuse to seal or send ships for now; both want word of Egypt's fleets; Arzawa strikes only if Egypt's ships come at its coast or Hatti and another truly join. Hatti took Ugarit T6. Egypt took Byblos T7 and now has an army in Byblos and a fleet in syriansea next to Amurru: Amurru is in danger (if it falls my kingdom falls). No free city is left to buy. T7 I dismissed c13 and c14 to save gold; T8 rehired both (26 and 14, term 8) to send from T9. Standings T8: Egypt 2.08, Babylonia 1.64, Hatti 1.42, Arzawa 1.25, Mitanni 1.21, Assyria 0.81, me 0.24. Only way up: allies break Egypt's two fleets in Cyprus (needs 3 fleets: one attacks Enkomi to cut support, one attacks Tamassos with the third supporting) and cede a province to me; then I raise a unit there. Income 20, treasury 209 at T8.

ledger.entry: T3 took Tamassos, T4 Enkomi (fleets); T7 took Byblos by sea (army from Gaza, F syriansea supported). Army in Byblos and fleet in syriansea both border Amurru: threat. Nothing sealed, no gold either way. Egypt once promised an answer by envoy and tablet; none came. T8: I send nothing yet; plan T9 nonaggression tablet over Amurru, c14 to go.

k11 T2, k19 T4 sealed (peace; Ugarit in Hatti's reach; word before quarrel). Hatti holds Ugarit (fleet). T7: Hatti would not seal a strike tablet, promises no gold or ships, will send word of Egyptian fleets and asked the same of me. My 150-per-province offer stands, nothing paid. T9 plan: c13 asks F ugarit to support Amurru's walls and joins a plan against Egypt's Cyprus fleets.

value.notes: T8 plan. Treasury 410 at orders, nothing spent. Orders: A_byblos -> amurru, F_syriansea supports (2 v walls 1); A_gaza -> byblos convoyed by F_levantsea. This ends Alashiya (no land). Delta army D stays home, enkomi/tamassos fleets hold Cyprus. WAKE T9. T9 PLAN: Qadesh (Babylonia, bought walls, yield 30): mover from byblos with supporter at amurru (2 v walls 1). Babylonia's mari army may support the walls (then 2 v 2 bounces, nothing lost; retry or give up). Staging provinces next to qadesh that I can use are only byblos and amurru (damascus and tyre are bought walls, cannot hold my troops), so a 3rd attacker needs Ugarit or Carchemish first. Frontage insight: Babylonia can reach my north only through mari -> damascus (1 v walls 1 bounces), so war with Babylonia is low risk for me; war with Hatti is riskier (Ugarit and Carchemish border Amurru). c16 reaches Hatti T9 with my offer (Egypt keeps Byblos, Amurru, Cyprus, south; Hatti keeps Ugarit); reply back about T11. Do not hit Ugarit until I read Hatti's answer. c1 (Assyria) and c2 (Hatti) home T9: read their tablets. Gold is strength: spend only on units that conquer. Consider disbanding one fleet if nothing needs it (35 a turn). Do not trust anyone.
value.summary: Egypt (Napkhururiya, capital akhetaten). Goal: highest growth ratio (strength = 10 x yield + gold - back pay). T8 strength 4267 (2.08 vs start 2500), yield 395, net income about +165 a turn after upkeep 230 (3 armies, 4 fleets). History: T1 bought Tyre; T2 took Gaza; T3 took Megiddo and Tamassos, bought Damascus; T4 took Enkomi; T5-6 fleets north; T7 took Byblos (army convoyed from gaza, fleet support). T8: take Amurru (ends Alashiya). Holdings: akhetaten, byblos, damascus(w), delta, enkomi, gaza, megiddo, memphis, sinai, tamassos, thebes, tyre(w). Tablets sealed: k14 Babylonia peace (T3), k26 Hatti (T3: no troops against each other; Egypt holds Gaza Megiddo Tyre Byblos Damascus; Hatti Ugarit Carchemish Isuwa; Amurru and Qadesh need other's word; I am breaking the Amurru clause), k27 Mitanni (T3), k41 and k46 Arzawa (T5, T7: no troops or ships into any province of the other, Lukka included). Assyria: Pirissi pledged friendship T7, nothing sealed; c1 carries my tablet offer home (back T9). Refused Hatti's tablet barring me from Ugarit/Carchemish/Cilician Sea and Mitanni's reaches tablet. No gold sent to anyone. Rules learned: bought walled cities cannot hold my troops, conquered ones lose walls; walls hold 1; ties bounce; fleet at sea convoys coast to coast; fleets can support armies into coast provinces; empty provinces fall to any adjacent mover; support needs the supporter to be able to move into the target. Babylonia is main rival (1.64): holds Qadesh (walls), Mari (army), Ekallatum, Susa. Its only road to my north is mari -> damascus. Plan: Qadesh T9, then Mari from Qadesh; Ugarit/Carchemish only after Hatti's answer (c16 back ~T11). People: c1 (Assyria, back T9), c2 (Hatti, back T9), c16 (to Hatti, back T11). Do not trust anyone.

ledger.entry: T4 I took Enkomi and Tamassos. Owe them nothing. Never sealed anything with them. T8: army takes Amurru (their last land), which ends their kingdom.

T3 sealed k26 (no troops against each other; Egypt holds Byblos etc; Hatti holds Ugarit, Carchemish, Isuwa; Amurru/Qadesh need other's word). T7 refused Keliya's tablet barring me from Ugarit, Carchemish, Cilician Sea. T7 sent c16 (arrives T9, back ~T11) offering: Egypt keeps Byblos, Amurru, Cyprus, south; Hatti keeps Ugarit; no troops against each other. No gold. T8 I take Amurru without Hatti's word. Hold off on Ugarit until their reply. c2 back T9.

T3 sealed k14 (brotherhood, free passage, gifts; no clause on troops). No gold sent, no military promise. T8 plan: attack Qadesh (their bought walls) T9; war with them is low risk for me since their only road north is mari -> damascus.

orders.letter: To my brother Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash. May all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I, Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria, ask peace between us on the lands each of us now holds: no army of mine will enter your land, and none of yours will enter mine. Our fathers' houses are neighbours, and neighbours who keep faith both prosper. A brother honours a brother with a gift; send me gold fit for the house of a Great King, and an envoy of your own to tell me what Karduniash asks of Assyria. I will answer in kind.
orders.mandate: May agree orally to peace and non-aggression on the lands each now holds, may listen to Babylon's terms and bring them home, and may accept any gold or gifts. May not promise gold, cede or renounce any land, seal anything, or speak of any treaty with Mitanni or Egypt.

value.notes: T8: Treasury 0 (Ubaru took 22 back pay). Net +20 a season before wages, so only ONE paid envoy is affordable (c9 Pirissi, 10 a season, back about T9). Ubaru (c18) asked 12; I did NOT renew: sent him on a last mission to Babylonia (arrives T9, back T10), then he is paid back pay and leaves unless I renew. Letter: peace on present borders, brotherly gift, no tablet (scribe 20 not affordable now), no gold. Defence changed: ashur supports arbela, arbela supports ashur, nineveh now supports ASHUR (capital hold 3, arbela hold 2; safer if Babylon and Mitanni ever join against the capital). Geometry: Ekallatum attack is capped at 3 (ashur, arbela, Terqa) vs Babylon hold 3, so it cannot succeed unless Babylon thins out. Terqa/Taidu: I cannot support any move into them, but an EMPTY Terqa or Taidu can be walked into by ashur/nineveh (hold 0). Never leave Ashur empty beside Ekallatum. Wake triggers set on moves in terqa, taidu, ekallatum, susa and the return of c9, c18. T9 plan: receive c9, read Egypt news, decide whether to send c9 to Hatti (peace tablet, urge them on Mitanni) or Egypt; seal tablets once treasury has 20+. Do not hire c10/c15.
value.summary: Ashur-uballit of Assyria. Start 1700 (homeland nineveh/arbela/ashur/ekallatum). I hold arbela, ashur, nineveh (yield 110), 3 armies, treasury 0, strength about 1028 (growth 0.60). Income 110, upkeep 90. Lost Ekallatum to Babylonia T1, Susa bought T1 but Babylonia took it T2. No free cities remain on the map; growth only by conquest, gifts or saving gold (+20 a season). Standings T8: Egypt 2.08, Babylonia 1.64, Hatti 1.42, Arzawa 1.25, Mitanni 1.21, me 0.81, Alashiya 0.24. Tablets: k4/k17/k36 with Mitanni (no armies into each other's land; Mitanni may take Mari/Isuwa/Carchemish/Qadesh, I may take Susa; the Terqa-Mari / Ashur-Ekallatum plan bounced 3 v 3 at T6 and is stalled). k44 with Egypt T7 (brotherhood, no troops, free envoys, warn of a third king; no gold promised). Hatti T5 accepts peace and wants a tablet in its own form (nothing sealed). Babylonia never answered my peace offer (T3); sent Ubaru again T8. Geometry: my attacks cap at 3 into Ekallatum; I cannot support moves into Terqa/Taidu/Susa; empty Terqa/Taidu could be walked into. Defence pattern: ashur supports arbela, arbela supports ashur, nineveh supports ashur. Staff: c9 Pirissi (10 a season, owed 50) back about T9; c18 Ubaru on a last mission to Babylonia (owed 22+). Only one paid envoy is affordable. Ideas: gifts from Egypt/Mitanni, Hatti pressure on Mitanni so Terqa/Taidu thin out.

ledger.entry: T8: sent Ubaru (arrives T9, back T10) asking peace on present borders and a brotherly gift; no tablet, no gold promised. Nothing sealed. Private: a pause only; an Ekallatum strike is capped at 3 v their hold 3, so unattainable unless they thin out.

T8: Ubaru report: Tushratta sends no Terqa->Mari until I hold Ekallatum; armies stay out of each other's land; he asks what Babylon holds at Ekallatum, Mari, Sippar; treasury thin, no gold; he keeps 4 armies near his capital. Not yet answered. Private: treaty is cheap talk; Terqa borders Ashur, Taidu borders Nineveh.

value.notes: T8 orders: chain shift. Fleet ugarit->cilicia, army carchemish->ugarit, army kanesh->carchemish, raise army in kanesh (empty only if the chain works; else nothing paid). Tuwanuwa holds with hattusa + kizzuwatna support (hold 3 vs Arzawa max 3 = bounce). Spy c4 at mira shows APASA (Arzawa capital, 40) EMPTY; Arzawa armies at lukka, mira, seha (fleet probably westsea). T9 PLAN: take Lukka: kizzuwatna army moves to lukka, tuwanuwa army + fleet at cilicia support (3 v hold 2, or 3 if their fleet supports). New kanesh army + hattusa support tuwanuwa holding. Never leave tuwanuwa or kizzuwatna empty. If Lukka falls: lukka army -> apasa (empty), then seha/mira. Bounces cost nothing. Qadesh (Babylon, walled) tempting but I promised Egypt no troops vs Amurru/Qadesh; Isuwa promised to Mitanni: do not break yet. Treasury about 7 after raise; T9 net +40 with 6 armies + fleet (income 255, upkeep 215). c3 Keliya back T9: use him as courier. Consider hiring c10 (25) at T9 if gold allows. Watch Egypt fleet in syriansea next to Ugarit.
value.summary: Suppiluliuma of Hatti. Aim: highest growth vs start 2100 (strength = 10 x yields + gold - back pay). T8: strength 2619 (1.25), treasury 107, yield 255 (hattusa, tuwanuwa, sapinuwa, kanesh, kizzuwatna, ugarit, carchemish), 5 armies + fleet, income 255, upkeep 185. Egypt leads 2.08, Babylon 1.64, me 1.42, Arzawa 1.25, Mitanni 1.21, Assyria 0.81, Alashiya 0.24. All free cities are taken, so growth now only by conquest. Sealed and standing: k6/k31 Alashiya (Ugarit Hatti's; no Hatti ships vs Enkomi/Tamassos); k12 and k43 Egypt (Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh, Hatti Ugarit and Carchemish; I promised no troops or buying vs Amurru/Qadesh); k21, k30, k42 Mitanni (Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka Hatti's; Isuwa Mitanni's; no armies into each other's homeland); k22 Arzawa broken by Arzawa at once: never trust Arzawa. Assyria offered alliance vs Mitanni T3, nothing sealed. Walled bought cities: take with mover + 1 support. Main target: Arzawa (apasa 40, seha 30, mira 30, lukka 25 = 125 yield, 1250 strength). Gateway is Lukka (adjacent to my tuwanuwa and kizzuwatna armies, fleets at cilicia). Apasa seen empty at T8. Tuwanuwa needs hold 3 vs Arzawa max 3 (supporters only hattusa, kanesh, kizzuwatna). People: c3 Keliya (back T9 from Egypt, owed 24), c4 Artessupa spy at mira (14 a season through T9). Free candidates c10 (25), c15 (30). Later targets if Arzawa falls: Isuwa/Harran (Mitanni), Qadesh (Babylon), Egypt's Levant cities.

ledger.entry: T4: k22 sealed but Arzawa broke it the same turn (took Seha, struck Tuwanuwa). Never trust its tablets. Holds Apasa, Lukka, Mira, Seha. T8: my spy c4 at Mira sees Apasa empty; armies at lukka, mira, seha. I plan to take Lukka T9 (Mitanni k21 and k30 grant it to Hatti; Lukka is not Arzawa homeland, so k7 does not forbid it). No gold. Nothing owed.

orders.letter: Brother Tushratta, may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I thank you for Mane's frank words. I take the division you offered through him: Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash. My man brings it in a tablet for you to seal. On turn eleven, or the day the two of us name by envoy, not before turn ten, let the army of Terqa support my army of Ekallatum into Ashur, let the army of Taidu go into Nineveh, and my army of Susa will go into Arbela. Mari goes into your hand when Ashur and Arbela are held by me and Assyria is finished. Until the day let Terqa hold and not stand behind Assyria again, as it did in turn six; the peace of k8 stands. The gold is a brother's earnest. Seal the tablet and answer by your own man.
orders.mandate: May seal the tablet exactly as written. May fix the strike day at turn 11, or at turn 10 only if Tushratta says his orders for it are already given. May promise Mari only after Ashur and Arbela are held by me and Assyria is finished, never as an immediate cession. May not promise more gold than carried, no troops into Mitanni's homeland, no peace with Assyria.

proposal.text: Brotherhood and peace stand between Karduniash and Mitanni as sealed in turns two and four: neither king sends troops into the homeland of the other, and their envoys pass freely. Assyria shall be shared thus: Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni; Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash. On turn eleven, or on the day the two kings name by envoy, not before turn ten, the army of Terqa supports the army of Ekallatum into Ashur, the army of Susa goes into Arbela, and the army of Taidu goes into Nineveh. Mari passes into the hand of Mitanni when Ashur and Arbela are held by Karduniash and Assyria is finished. Neither king makes peace with Assyria without the other.

value.notes: T8: Mane (Mitanni) accepted division B in words (Nineveh+Mari to M., Ashur+Arbela to me) but sealed nothing, cannot bind Terqa, day not before T10. I send c6 to Mitanni (arrives T9, back T10) with my tablet, 50 gold, mandate to name the day: proposed T11 (T10 only if Tushratta says his orders are already given). STRIKE PLAN (only when Mitanni confirmed and I am awake with c6's report): ekallatum->ashur (terqa supports), susa->arbela, taidu->nineveh, durkurigalzu->ekallatum refill (sippar and mari support the refill). Ashur hold is then 1 because arbela and nineveh supports are cut. RISK: if terqa does not support, my ekallatum army can be dislodged by arbela+ashur(+terqa). Never strike blind. After Ashur falls: ashur supports susa->arbela; Mitanni takes Nineveh with my help from ashur. Mari: promised to Mitanni only after Ashur+Arbela are mine and Assyria is finished; keep the option to delay (Mitanni in Mari would touch Sippar). Spies: c5 to Assyria's court (copy tablets: any Assyria-Mitanni pact?), c17 to province taidu (sees taidu, washukanni, nineveh). c5 not renewed, leaves when back. Hatti outreach postponed to T10: brotherhood tablet covering Qadesh and Mari. If Mitanni stalls or lies: hold the ring, save gold (+125 a season), scout Terqa/Harran before any move on Terqa (breaks k8). No free cities remain: growth now only by conquest. Egypt leads at 2.08; I need Assyria, then maybe Mitanni, to catch it.
value.summary: Burna-Buriash of Babylonia, start strength 2600; T8 strength 3627 (1.40), treasury 427, income 320, upkeep 150 (5 armies: ekallatum, sippar, durkurigalzu, susa, mari), wages 45. Egypt leads 2.08 (land 395), Hatti 1.42, Arzawa 1.25, Mitanni 1.21, Assyria 0.81, Alashiya 0.24. All free city-states are gone (Egypt took Byblos T7, Hatti took Carchemish); growth now only by conquest or saving gold. I hold babylon, sippar, durkurigalzu, nippur, ur, ekallatum, susa, mari, qadesh (walled, no troops, mari can support its walls). Tablets: k8 (T2 Mitanni: no troops into each other's homeland), k28 (T3 Egypt brotherhood), k32 (T4 Mitanni: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela+Ashur to me, no separate peace with Assyria). Assyria (arbela, ashur, nineveh) is a mutual-support triangle: a support is cut by an attack from any province other than the one supported into; I can only crack it with a Mitanni supporter (terqa or nineveh side). Ring: ekallatum holds, sippar+durkurigalzu+mari support it (hold 4, enemy max 3). T8: Mitanni envoy Mane accepted division B in words (Nineveh+Mari to M.) but sealed nothing; I sent c6 with a tablet and 50 gold to fix the strike day (proposed T11). Mitanni's Terqa army backed Assyria in T6; treat Tushratta as unreliable. People: c6 Kidin-Adad (11, term T12), c17 Ehli-Teshub (21, term T13), c5 Piyamaradu (Arzawa-born, unrenewed, sent as spy). c15 Mazipalali (26) not hired. Wake T10.

ledger.entry: k8 (T2), k32 (T4) sealed. T8: Mane brought a tablet for division 1 (Ashur+Nineveh to M.); I refused to seal. I took division 2 (Nineveh+Mari to M., Ashur+Arbela to me); Mane committed in words, no seal, cannot bind Terqa, day not before T10. T8 I sent c6 with my own tablet, 50 gold, mandate to name the day (proposed T11). Mari owed only after Ashur+Arbela are mine and Assyria is finished. T6 Terqa backed Assyria; T7 Mitanni did not move. k8/k32 cover homelands only.
