T8: no dealings yet. Hatti took Carchemish by army in T7 and holds a fleet at Ugarit. Plan T10: brotherhood tablet covering Qadesh and Mari. Do not tell Hatti about the Assyria plan.

value.text: My lord Suppiluliuma, I am in Mira and have watched quietly as you bade me. Arzawa keeps an army in Lukka, another in Mira itself, and a third in the Seha River Land. Hatti has an army in Tuwanuwa. I have set these things down as I saw them, and I will keep watching; I ask that the wages and back pay owed me be ready when I come home safely to your court.

My lord Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria, I went to the court of Egypt and gave your greeting to the Great King Napkhururiya, and I told him your words concerning Karduniash, how it holds Ekallatum, Susa and Mari and presses your borders, and your proposal of friendship between your houses. He wishes well to your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses, and he calls you brother. He sends no shekels of gold now, saying Egypt's gold is spent on her own walls and ships this year, but gifts may follow when the tablet is sealed. He gives no word on the armies at Qadesh or Mari, saying your own eyes on Karduniash will serve you better. I pledged in your name that our houses shall be friends, that Assyria will press Karduniash, and that Assyria will not attack Egypt or its provinces, and I carry his offer of a tablet of brotherhood home to you to be sealed. The court there lives comfortably, and Nakhtmin, envoy of Arzawa, was also at the court.

My lord Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, I stood before Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, and gave your words as you spoke them: your wish that all go well, the division of Damascus, Tyre, Gaza, Megiddo and the south against Isuwa, Carchemish, Qadesh and Mari, and your request for gold of pure quality, no smaller than the gifts his house gave your father, and not gilded wood. He heard me and bade me say that Egypt will not hinder Mitanni against Mari or the lands Karduniash holds, that he will warn you if a third king moves, and that your warning of Karduniash is heard. He will not seal a new tablet of reaches now, for Egypt's reach in Byblos, Amurru and the coast is not yet settled with others, and he would have your reach written when you can both speak plainly. His treasury is committed to his armies this season, so no gold came with me; he says it will follow when his ships return. I noticed that Egypt keeps one army and no fleet near its capital. I await your word, my lord.

In my early seasons I carried my lord Burna-Buriash's tablets to Tushratta of Mitanni. In season one my lord offered brotherhood and peace with a modest gift; in season two Tushratta sealed it and thanked us for the gift. In season four Tushratta sealed the division of the Assyrian lands: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela and Ashur to Karduniash. My lord paid me 22 shekels of my wages in season three and again in season five, but 11 shekels of back pay still wait at his court. I serve him for 11 shekels a season, and he has been fair to me. I remember the Assyrian army standing at Ashur and Tushratta's courtesy. I keep my own counsel on matters of the heart and of the field.

To my lord Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, your servant Sin-iqisham speaks. May it go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. I stood before Ashur-uballit, King of Assyria, and gave him your words, and he saw your tablet and sealed it gladly: no troops of his will enter Egypt, envoys shall pass freely between you, and he will warn you if a third king moves against either land. He says Burna-Buriash holds Ekallatum on his border and leans upon him, and he asks that you send him gold in good, pure weight as a gift between brothers; I did not promise it on your behalf, but set his request before you faithfully. His envoy Pirissi comes to your court, and I beg that he be received as a brother's servant. I noted that Assyria keeps 3 army and no fleet near its capital, and that its treasury looks thin.

My lord Tarhundaradu, Great King of Arzawa, I have come back from the court of Egypt as you commanded. Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, greets you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country, and says he has sealed your tablet on both sides: no troops and no ships of Egypt against the provinces of Arzawa, Lukka included, and none of Arzawa against Egypt, Cyprus among them. He promises no sum of gold today, but says a brother remembers a brother in his own season; he wishes you strength against the Hatti border, and his envoys will come to your court again. The envoys of both courts shall pass freely and exchange word, as the tablet says. The court of Egypt lives comfortably, and I saw no want there. My lord, my term has ended and the back pay of thirty-six shekels is owed me; I ask that it be paid when I stand before you.

My lord Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, your servant Keliya returns from Egypt and greets you: may it go well with you, your household, your wives, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I stood before Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, and gave him your greeting and your words as they were given to me, and I left the short tablet for his seal. He answered that Egypt keeps the tablet of brotherhood, sends no troops against Hatti's lands, and has no quarrel with the harbour of Kizzuwatna. He would not seal the short tablet, saying a second is not needed between brothers whose first still stands, and he asks that Hatti give Egypt its word on Amurru, which lies beside Byblos and has no king to protect it. I told him I have no word from you on Amurru and promised him nothing there. He said nothing of Alashiya or the Cilician Sea though I begged him to, so that matter stands open. At his court I noticed Egypt keeps 1 army and no fleet near its capital.

To my lord Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, from your servant Paser. I came to the court of Great King Suppiluliuma of Hatti and gave him your word whole: all goes well with you, and Egypt asks that it may take Amurru and Qadesh, sending no troops or ships against Ugarit, Carchemish or the lands of Hatti in return. He answered that all goes well with him, and he has sealed your tablet: Hatti holds Ugarit, sends no troops or ships against Amurru or Qadesh, and asks that Egypt keep its fleets out of Ugarit's waters and the Cilician Sea off Kizzuwatna, send nothing against Carchemish, Ugarit or Hatti, and give word of any king who plans harm to Hatti. I carry the sealed tablet home whole, with his word beside it. I pledged nothing on the fleets; that answer is yours alone to give, and I beg you give it without delay. I also noticed at his court that the treasury looks thin.

To my lord Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, from your servant Mane: I came to Burna-Buriash of Karduniash and gave your words as you spoke them, Piyamaradu's welcome in Washukanni, your turn seven, and the terms in the tablet I bear. He will not seal that tablet, for it takes Ashur from him; he says k32, sealed by both of you in turn four, gave Ashur and Arbela to him and Nineveh to you, and that a brother's second tablet must not be smaller than his first. He takes the division you accept, Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni with Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash, and he will send his own man with a tablet in that form and a mandate to name the day, not before turn ten. Until then Terqa must hold and not stand behind Assyria again as it did in turn six, and the peace of k8 covers every land we hold. I answered in your name that you take this division and that the day is to be named by a later envoy. I had no mandate to seal, and I could not bind the army of Terqa nor answer for Mari's handing over, so those matters I leave for you to answer. Shamash keep you, your household and your country.

My lord Tarhundaradu, I stood before Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and gave him your words as you spoke them. He answers that the oath sealed before Shamash and Teshub stands and that he thanks you for your word of Hatti's armies. He will not move a Mitanni army into Hatti's homeland this season, since Babylon and Assyria press his other border, but his army stands on the Hatti road in the east and holds Hatti's troops there. He says Hatti learns nothing of Arzawa from him and that he will tell you nothing of your war. He will send no gold now, saying his treasury has gone into soldiers and walls, and he promises a worthy gift when he can. He asks that word of what your watchmen see at Kanesh and Hattusa come to his court in turn. I noticed that Mitanni keeps only four army units and no fleet near its capital, and that the court lives comfortably, so I doubt his treasury is as empty as he says. Piyamaradu of Babylonia and Ubaru of Assyria were also at his court. I ask that the wages the king of Arzawa owes me be paid as you are able, and I await your word.

value.speech: Hear me, Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, my brother. Thus my lord Ashur-uballit, Great King of Assyria, your brother, speaks: may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. He asks peace between us on the lands each of us now holds; no army of his shall enter your land, and none of yours shall enter his. Our fathers' houses are neighbours, and neighbours who keep faith both prosper. A brother honours a brother with a gift, so he asks that you send him gold fit for the house of a Great King, and an envoy of your own to tell him what Karduniash asks of Assyria, and he will answer in kind.

Great King Suppiluliuma, king of Hatti, my lord Napkhururiya sends you his message. Egypt keeps the tablet of brotherhood, and no troops shall go against Hatti's lands. You asked what Egypt intends toward Alashiya and the Cilician Sea: Egypt holds Enkomi and Tamassos, and its ships there guard the island; they have no business at Kizzuwatna's harbour and will not go there. Egypt holds Byblos in the south and will hold Amurru beside it, for Amurru has no king to protect it. My lord asks Hatti's word that Hatti sends nothing against Egypt's lands, Cyprus included, and asks the same peace for Ugarit as for his own. I bear the tablet for your seal; seal it if you agree, and send word before any quarrel.

Great King Tushratta, my lord Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, sends you his brotherly greeting and wishes that all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. He thanks you for the frank words of Mane and takes the division you offered through him: Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash. His tablet for you to seal is in my keeping, and he asks that on turn eleven, or on the day you two name by envoy and not before turn ten, the army of Terqa support the army of Ekallatum into Ashur, the army of Taidu go into Nineveh and the army of Susa go into Arbela. Mari passes into your hand only when Ashur and Arbela are held by my lord and Assyria is finished; until that day Terqa must hold and not stand behind Assyria again as it did in turn six, for the peace of turn eight stands. The gold is a brother's earnest. I humbly beg you to seal the tablet and to answer by your own man.

Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, greets his brother Ashur-uballit and wishes well to his household, sons, chariots, horses and country. I have heard his words and I honour his wish for peace between neighbours. A peace is proved by deeds before it is written on clay: while his armies stand at Arbela and Ashur against my Ekallatum, a tablet would be only words. Let him show good faith in the field, and when my own envoy is ready he will carry my answer. I send no gold today; gifts follow trust. Go in peace, Ubaru, and carry my greeting.

Say to Napkhururiya, Great King of Egypt, my brother: Suppiluliuma greets you and wishes well to your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. Hatti keeps the tablets of brotherhood already sealed between us, the first and the one that gave Egypt Amurru and Qadesh and gave Hatti Ugarit and Carchemish. Your own words to my servant Keliya were that a second tablet is not needed between brothers whose first still stands; I say the same to you, and so I do not seal this one. It names Ugarit and the homeland but leaves out Carchemish, which is Hatti's by your word, and I will not have a new tablet read as a smaller portion than the old. Hatti sends no troops against Gaza, Megiddo, Tyre, Byblos, Damascus or Amurru, as I promised. I ask that your ships keep out of the Cilician Sea and away from Ugarit and Kizzuwatna, as you have said they will. If a quarrel ever rises between us, I will send word before any troops move, and I ask the same of you.

Kidin-Adad, tell my brother Burna-Buriash that Tushratta wishes all go well with him, his household, his sons, his chariots and his horses. I thank him for the earnest and I hold to the peace of Karduniash and Mitanni: no army of mine enters his homeland. I accept the division: Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash. Before I seal, three plain things between brothers. First, Mari: your army stands in Mari, and Terqa will stand exposed to it while my Terqa army marches in support. Let Mari pass into my hand in the very season of the march, not after Assyria is finished, so that my back is safe and the word is already kept. Second, Taidu alone cannot take Nineveh, for one army against a walled hold only bounces; once your army stands in Ashur or Arbela it must support Taidu into Nineveh the season after. Third, a brother's earnest of fifty is welcome; let more follow when the armies move. If my brother agrees to these, I seal and Terqa supports on turn eleven, or on the day I name by my own envoy and not before turn ten. Tell me if your lord's mandate allows it.
value.bribeAsk: Speak truly to Burna-Buriash and press him to let Mari pass to me in the season of the march and to support Taidu into Nineveh.

value.speech: Hear me, Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, my brother. I have heard your answer and your greeting, and I will carry them home to my lord Ashur-uballit as you have spoken them. You honour his wish for peace between neighbours, but while his armies stand at Arbela and Ashur against your Ekallatum, a tablet would be only words, so he must show good faith in the field first. May all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country.
value.commitments: Oral only: peace and non-aggression on the lands each now holds, as my mandate allows. No gold promised, no land ceded, nothing sealed.

value.speech: Great King Suppiluliuma, I hear your word and will carry it to my lord Napkhururiya exactly as you have spoken it: that you hold the first tablet to still stand and will not seal a second. I may neither add to nor yield anything concerning Carchemish, Qadesh, Amurru or Byblos, and I shall write nothing of them beyond what the tablet says. My lord's ships will keep out of Kizzuwatna's harbour, as I have said; I can promise nothing further of his fleets or of his word without his command.
value.commitments: On my lord's behalf I promised only that Egypt's fleets will keep out of Kizzuwatna's harbour. No gold, troops, land, or new tablet was promised.

value.speech: Great King Tushratta, I will lay your three words before my lord Burna-Buriash exactly as you have spoken them, and I will add nothing to them. I accept your earnest of fifty and your gift of ten with thanks, as the courtesy of a brother's house. The tablet stands as my lord wrote it and I may not alter a line, so Mari cannot pass into your hand in the season of the march; I may promise Mari only once Ashur and Arbela are held by my lord and Assyria is finished. As for Taidu and Nineveh, my mandate does not reach so far, and I must bring your request to my lord before any answer is given; let the tablet be sealed as written and let turn eleven be the day.
value.commitments: On my lord's behalf: the tablet sealed exactly as written; strike on turn eleven, or on a day named by your envoy not before turn ten and only if your orders for it are already given; Mari to pass only after Ashur and Arbela are held and Assyria is finished, never in the season of the march; no gold promised beyond the earnest of fifty; no troops of Karduniash into Mitanni's homeland; Taidu's support into Nineveh not promised, referred to my lord.

value.speech: Kidin-Adad, I hear you and I do not blame you, for the tablet is your lord's and you may not change a line. Tell my brother Burna-Buriash that I do not seal today. The peace of Karduniash and Mitanni stands as sealed in turns two and four, and no army of mine enters his homeland. But as written, the tablet asks Terqa to march and leaves Taidu alone before the walls of Nineveh, where one army only bounces, and it leaves my back open at Mari. A brother does not ask a brother to bleed for a share he cannot take. I will send my own man to my brother with my own tablet, and a day not before turn ten. What I ask there is plain: Karduniash's army supports Taidu into Nineveh in the very season Terqa marches, and Mari passes into my hand in that same season. Give me those two things in writing and I seal, and Terqa supports. Until then Terqa holds, and I keep the earnest as a brother's gift. Shamash keep you, your lord and his country.

Great King Tushratta, I hear my brother's words and I will lay them before my lord Burna-Buriash exactly as you have spoken them, adding nothing. I may not promise that Taidu marches into Nineveh in the season Terqa marches, nor that Mari passes into your hand in that same season; my mandate does not reach so far, and my lord must answer for it. I will wait for your own man and his tablet, and I will carry your answer home without alteration. The earnest is kept with thanks. Shamash keep you, your household and your country.

value.notes: T9: Treasury 0, no envoy at court (Pirissi c9 left unpaid after reporting; owed 40 stays on books). Egypt gave no gold; k44 stands. Pirissi pledged in my name that Assyria presses Karduniash and never attacks Egypt. Income 110, upkeep 90: net +20, so no paid envoy except possibly Ubaru at 12 (net +8). Do NOT hire c10 (21) or c15 (25): the wage would push me below zero and troops would desert. Orders T9: same defence, ashur supports arbela, arbela supports ashur, nineveh supports ashur (capital hold 3, arbela 2; any single-wave attack bounces). Schedule extended to T24. T10 plan: Ubaru c18 back (owed 33+, treasury will be about 20, pays part). Renew him at 12 if I can afford it, then send him to Mitanni with the answer to Tushratta (Babylon holds Ekallatum, Susa; I know nothing of Mari/Sippar), proposing a joint strike on Ekallatum: ashur moves, arbela supports, Terqa supports (3) only if Babylon's Ekallatum hold is 2 or less. Read Babylon's reply on peace and any gift. Opportunity watch: triggers on unit moves in ekallatum, susa, terqa, taidu. If the Babylonian army leaves Ekallatum it is empty: walk ashur into it, but keep nineveh/arbela behind. Never leave Ashur empty beside Terqa. Long shot: Egypt leads at 2.18 and I am at 0.60, so only conquest or a collapse elsewhere can win.
value.summary: Ashur-uballit of Assyria. Start 1700 (homeland nineveh/arbela/ashur/ekallatum). I hold arbela, ashur, nineveh (yield 110), 3 armies, treasury 0, strength about 1027 (growth 0.60). Income 110, upkeep 90, net +20. Lost Ekallatum to Babylonia T1, Susa bought T1 but Babylonia took it T2. No free cities remain; Alashiya has fallen (Egypt holds enkomi, tamassos). Standings T9: Egypt 2.18, Babylonia 1.64, Hatti 1.42, Arzawa 1.25, Mitanni 1.21, me 0.81 (estimate). Tablets: k4/k17/k36 with Mitanni (no armies into each other's land; Mitanni may take Mari/Isuwa/Carchemish/Qadesh, I may take Susa; the Terqa-Mari / Ashur-Ekallatum plan bounced 3 v 3 at T6 and is stalled). k44 with Egypt T7 (brotherhood, no troops, free envoys, warn of third king; Egypt promised no gold). Hatti T5 accepted peace and wants a tablet in its own form (nothing sealed). Babylonia never answered my peace offer; Ubaru sent T8, back T10. Geometry: my attack into Ekallatum caps at 3 (ashur, arbela, Terqa support); I cannot support moves into Terqa/Taidu/Susa; an empty Terqa/Taidu/Ekallatum can be walked into. Defence pattern: ashur supports arbela, arbela supports ashur, nineveh supports ashur. Staff: only c18 Ubaru (asks 12, due T10, owed 33); free c10 (21), c15 (25) too dear. Only one cheap envoy is affordable. Ideas: gifts from Babylon/Mitanni, ask Egypt to take Mari, Hatti pressure on Mitanni so Terqa/Taidu thin out.

ledger.entry: T5: sent c9 Pirissi. T7: envoy Sin-iqisham brought a tablet, sealed as k44 (no troops against each other's land, free envoys, warn if a third king moves). T9: Pirissi reported Egypt calls me brother, sends no gold (spent on walls and ships), gifts may follow; Pirissi pledged in my name friendship, pressure on Karduniash, no attack on Egypt. Idea: ask Egypt to take Mari from Damascus.

value.notes: T9: Held the ring (ekallatum holds; sippar and durkurigalzu support it = hold 3; enemy max is ashur+arbela+terqa = 3, a tie bounces). Moved mari's support from ekallatum to the WALLS OF QADESH (hold 2): Egypt armies stand at amurru and byblos, both next to Qadesh, and amurru->qadesh with byblos support would be 2 vs a bare wall of 1. Susa holds. Replied to Ubaru last turn with soft words, so nothing new to Assyria. No envoy at court this season (c6 back about T10, c17 at taidu about T10, c5 spying on Assyria). Did not hire c15 (26 a season); c6 can go to Hatti or Egypt at T10. T10 PLAN: wake. Read c6's report from Tushratta. STRIKE only if Mitanni clearly commits to terqa supporting ekallatum->ashur on a named day: then ekallatum->ashur (terqa supports), susa->arbela (cuts arbela's support of ashur), durkurigalzu->ekallatum refill, sippar and mari support the refill. Never strike blind: a bounce could let ashur+arbela take ekallatum. If Mitanni stalls: keep saving (+125 a season), consider peace with Assyria and disbanding spare armies, and send an envoy to Hatti for a brotherhood tablet covering Qadesh and Mari. Remember Egypt could take Qadesh if Hatti also joins (3 vs 2).
value.summary: Burna-Buriash of Babylonia, start strength 2600. T9 strength 3682 (1.42 by ledger; standings estimate 1.64), treasury 527, income 320, upkeep 150 (5 armies: ekallatum, sippar, durkurigalzu, susa, mari), wages 45. Standings: Egypt 2.18 (land 415), me 1.64 (land 320), Hatti 1.42, Arzawa 1.25, Mitanni 1.21, Assyria 0.81. Alashiya has fallen (Egypt holds enkomi and tamassos). All free city-states are gone, so growth now comes only from conquest or from saving gold (+125 a season). I hold babylon, sippar, durkurigalzu, nippur, ur, ekallatum, susa, mari and qadesh (walled, no troops). Tablets: k8 (T2 Mitanni, no troops into each other's homeland), k28 (T3 Egypt brotherhood), k32 (T4 Mitanni: Nineveh to Mitanni, Arbela+Ashur to me, no separate peace with Assyria). Assyria (arbela, ashur, nineveh) is a mutual-support triangle: I cannot crack it alone because only ekallatum and susa border it. I need a Mitanni army at terqa or nineveh to support ekallatum->ashur. In T6 Mitanni's terqa army supported Assyria against me, so treat Tushratta as unreliable. T8: Mane accepted division B in words (Nineveh+Mari to M., Ashur+Arbela to me) but sealed nothing. I sent c6 with a tablet and 50 gold to name the strike day (proposed T11); he is due back T10. Assyria's envoy Ubaru (T9) asked peace on the lands held, gold and an envoy; I answered deeds first. People: c6 (11, term T12), c17 (21, term T13), c5 (unrenewed, spying on Assyria, leaves when back). Egypt armies at amurru and byblos threaten Qadesh. Hatti holds carchemish and ugarit with armies, also next to Qadesh. After conquest, disband spare armies to save 30 each.

ledger.entry: T3 k28 sealed (brotherhood, free envoys, gifts flow). T5: promises of gifts in measure with what I send, none delivered; I have sent no gold. T9: Egypt armies at amurru and byblos stand next to my walled Qadesh. Mari now supports Qadesh's walls. Egypt is the growth leader (2.18); stay friendly in words, watch Qadesh.

T4 Pirissi and T9 Ubaru (c18, born in Sippar) asked peace on lands held, gold, and an envoy of mine. I gave soft words only: deeds first, no tablet, no gold, no envoy promised. They hold Arbela, Ashur, Nineveh with armies at Arbela and Ashur. Aim: conquer them only with a real Mitanni supporter; else consider peace.

orders.letter: Suppiluliuma, Great King of Hatti, greets his brother of Babylonia and wishes well to his household, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. Hatti and Babylonia have never quarrelled and lie far apart. I wish peace between us: Hatti sends no troops into the homeland of Babylonia, and I ask the same of you toward the homeland of Hatti and toward Ugarit and Carchemish, which are Hatti's. Let our envoys pass freely in both lands. If you agree, send word by your envoy and a tablet for both our seals, and I will seal it.
orders.mandate: May agree in words to peace: no troops into each other's homelands, none against Ugarit or Carchemish, envoys pass freely. May seal a tablet that Babylon brings if it says only this and names neither Qadesh nor Mari. No gold, no troops, no land promised. May report what he sees of Babylon's armies and treasury.

value.notes: T9 orders: take Lukka. Kizzuwatna army -> lukka, supported by tuwanuwa army and cilicia fleet (3 v Arzawa hold 2, 3 if their fleet helps; a tie only bounces, no loss). Hattusa + kanesh armies support tuwanuwa holding (hold 3 v Arzawa max 3; if lukka army itself strikes tuwanuwa, tuwanuwa support to lukka is not cut because it comes from lukka). Carchemish and ugarit hold (guard v Mitanni harran, Egypt amurru, Babylon qadesh). Kizzuwatna left empty: only lukka touches it, and that army would meet my mover head on. Treasury 15 so no raise, no tablet (scribe 20). Keliya (c3, term ended, not renewed) sent to Babylon with a message only: peace, no troops into each other's homeland, envoys pass; mandate to seal a Babylonian tablet that names neither Qadesh nor Mari. He leaves when he is next at court. Artessupa c4 recalled from mira (saves back pay; she can be my courier). T10 PLAN (I wake T10): if Lukka taken, lukka army -> apasa (capital, was empty T8; I will see it from lukka) or hold; refill kizzuwatna from kanesh; raise army when treasury reaches 100+ (net about +40 a turn, more with Lukka). If bounced, repeat with same support. Later: Seha, Mira, then Egypt Levant (Amurru army, Byblos) and Enkomi/Tamassos by fleet; Egypt leads and must be cut down, but k12/k43 stand until Arzawa is done. Mitanni k42: Isuwa theirs, Carchemish/Ugarit mine; do not tell them Egypt got Amurru/Qadesh.
value.summary: Suppiluliuma of Hatti. Aim: highest growth vs start 2100 (strength = 10 x yields + gold - back pay). T9: strength 2537 (1.21), treasury 15, yield 255 (hattusa, tuwanuwa, sapinuwa, kanesh, kizzuwatna, ugarit, carchemish), 6 armies + fleet, income 255, upkeep 215. Yield ratios T9: Egypt 2.18 (415), Babylon 1.64 (320), me 1.42, Arzawa 1.25 (125), Mitanni 1.21 (175), Assyria 0.81. Alashiya fell T8 (Egypt holds Enkomi and Tamassos with fleets). All free cities taken: growth only by conquest; 1 yield = +10 strength and +1 gold a season, so be quick. Main target Arzawa (apasa 40 capital, seha 30, mira 30, lukka 25); Arzawa armies at lukka, mira, seha, apasa empty at T8. Treaties: k12/k43 Egypt (Egypt may take Amurru, Qadesh; Hatti Ugarit, Carchemish; no troops vs other's lands); k21/k30/k42 Mitanni (Carchemish, Ugarit, Lukka Hatti's; Isuwa Mitanni's; no armies into each other's homeland); k6/k31 Alashiya (fallen); k22 Arzawa broken by Arzawa at once: never trust Arzawa. Assyria offered alliance vs Mitanni T3, nothing sealed. Babylon: no dealings, T9 Keliya sent with peace offer. Combat lessons: a support is cut by any attack except from the supported destination; walled bought cities need mover + 1 support; tuwanuwa needs hold 3 (hattusa + kanesh support) vs Arzawa max 3; never leave tuwanuwa empty. Egypt is the leader and thin on armies (amurru army, 1 near capital, fleets at enkomi, tamassos, syriansea): after Arzawa consider Amurru, Byblos, Enkomi, Tamassos. People: c3 Keliya away to Babylon (leaves when back), c4 Artessupa recalled from mira. Free: c10 Haamashshi (25), c15 Mazipalali (30).

ledger.entry: T9: no dealings yet. Keliya (c3) sent with a message only: peace, no troops into each other's homeland, envoys pass freely; no tablet, no gold. Mandate to seal a Babylonian tablet that does not name Qadesh or Mari.

T3: k12 sealed. T7: k43 sealed (Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh; Hatti Ugarit and Carchemish; no troops or ships vs lands the other holds). T9: Egypt would not seal a second tablet; I did not either. Egypt promised its ships stay out of Kizzuwatna's harbour. I promised word before any quarrel and nothing about Cyprus. Egypt took Enkomi and Tamassos.
T4: k22 sealed but Arzawa broke it the same turn and struck Tuwanuwa again T8. Never trust it. T9: I strike Lukka. No gold, nothing owed.

orders.letter: Say to Burna-Buriash my brother: Tushratta wishes all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country. I thank you for the earnest of fifty and for the plain words of Kidin-Adad. I hold the peace of Karduniash and Mitanni: no army of mine enters your homeland. I take your division: Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash, Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni. Here is my own tablet, as I promised, and it names the day: turn 12 for the march, turn 13 for Nineveh and Mari. Terqa stands with no army behind it, so Mari is my back; Mari ceded when Nineveh falls is all I ask beyond your own tablet. If you seal, my orders will be given. Shamash keep you.
orders.mandate: May seal this tablet as written. May accept a later day from turn 12 to turn 14 if the king names it in the tablet and keeps the order of the days. May not promise any army of mine into the homeland of Karduniash. May receive gold. Do not seal anything that gives Ashur to Karduniash without Nineveh and Mari named to Mitanni. Bring home his answer and his own words.

proposal.text: Tablet between Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, sealed before Shamash and Marduk. The peace of turns 2, 4 and 8 stands: neither sends an army into the homeland of the other. The land of Assyria is shared thus: Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash; Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni. In turn 12 the army of Karduniash in Ekallatum moves into Ashur and the army of Mitanni in Terqa supports that move; the army of Karduniash in Susa moves into Arbela; the army of Mitanni in Taidu moves into Nineveh. In turn 13 the army of Karduniash in Ashur supports the army of Mitanni in Taidu moving into Nineveh; the army of Karduniash in Mari moves to Ekallatum, and in that same season Karduniash cedes Mari to Mitanni. A later day is named only by envoy of either king, and the order of the days is kept. Neither king makes peace with Assyria without the other.

value.notes: T9: Kidin-Adad (Babylon) brought tablet + earnest 50 (g2; g1 40 earlier). I did not seal; said I send my own man with my own tablet. Sent Mane (c7) to Babylon (arrives T10, home T11) with MY tablet: Day T12: Ekallatum->Ashur (my Terqa supports), Susa->Arbela, my Taidu->Nineveh (cuts Nineveh support of Ashur; alone it only bounces, harmless). T13: Babylon's Ashur army supports Taidu->Nineveh, Mari army leaves to Ekallatum and Mari is ceded to me same season (a cession fails if their own troops stand in it). Ashur+Arbela theirs, Nineveh+Mari mine. RULES: When Mane returns T11 (I am woken): if Babylon SEALED, schedule T12: terqa supports ekallatum->ashur, taidu moves nineveh, washukanni keeps supporting terqa, harran keeps supporting isuwa; schedule T13: taidu moves nineveh again. If he did not seal or refused Mari/Nineveh, do NOT move; keep holds and keep Assyria alive as buffer. Danger after Babylon holds Ashur: it borders Terqa; Terqa hold = 1 + washukanni + harran support up to 3; consider a 5th army only if Babylon masses at Ashur/Mari/Ekallatum. Egypt (Tattamaru's report): will not hinder me against Mari or Karduniash lands, will warn me, no new tablet, gold later (not came). Egypt keeps one army and no fleet near its capital. Assayed g2 (10) to learn if Babylon debases gold. Tell Assyria nothing of Babylon plan. Hatti took Carchemish and Ugarit with armies; k38 stands, Harran supports Isuwa.
value.summary: Tushratta of Mitanni. Home harran, washukanni (capital), taidu, terqa; isuwa (bought, walls, no troops; harran supports its walls). 4 armies (upkeep 120), income 175, wages 19, net about +36. Score = 10 x yield + gold - back pay; start 1950; T9 2074 (1.06). Land yields T9: Egypt 415 (2.18), Babylonia 320 (ekallatum, mari armies visible; qadesh, susa, ur, sippar, babylon, durkurigalzu, nippur), Hatti 255 (carchemish, ugarit taken; armies at carchemish, kanesh), Arzawa 125, me 175, Assyria 110 (3 armies ashur, nineveh, arbela, mutually supporting, each holds up to 3). Alashiya fallen. No free city left to buy. I cannot conquer alone: only Terqa (to Mari, Ekallatum, Ashur) and Taidu (to Nineveh) touch foes and each needs an ally's support; Isuwa cannot hold troops. Tablets: k3/k20 Babylon (homeland peace; Nineveh mine, Arbela+Ashur theirs); k9/k16/k37 Assyria (no armies into each other's land; plan to take Ekallatum/Mari failed T6); k13 Egypt (brothers, warn); k15 Arzawa sworn alliance; k18/k33/k38 Hatti (homelands at peace, Isuwa mine, Carchemish+Ugarit Hatti's). Babylon cannot take Ashur without my Terqa support: my leverage. Babylon's tablet (strike T11 Ekallatum->Ashur with Terqa, Taidu->Nineveh, Susa->Arbela; Mari only after Assyria finished) not sealed by me; I sent Mane with my own tablet (day T12, Babylon's Ashur army supports Taidu into Nineveh T13, Mari ceded T13). People: Mane c7 (11 to T12), Tattamaru c8 (8 to T10, home from Egypt), Nakhtmin c12 my secret man in Egypt, Kidin-Adad c6 Babylon envoy. Do not trust Babylon or Hatti; Egypt leads, I win only if big conquest plus Egypt stumbles.

ledger.entry: T9: Kidin-Adad brought Babylon's tablet and earnest 50 (g2, plus 40 earlier g1); I gave 10, did NOT seal. T9 sent Mane (c7) with my tablet: strike T12 (Ekallatum->Ashur, my Terqa supports; Susa->Arbela; Taidu->Nineveh), T13 their Ashur army supports Taidu into Nineveh and Mari is ceded to me. Terqa holds until sealed. k3/k20 stand. Say nothing of k16/k37 (Assyria).

T9: Tattamaru back. Egypt will not hinder Mitanni against Mari or lands Karduniash holds, will warn me (k13), refused a new reach tablet for now, gold to follow when ships return (none came). Nakhtmin c12 is my man there.

orders.letter: Brother Tushratta, may it go well with you, your household, wives, sons, chariots and horses. The tablet we sealed stands before Shamash and Amun. Karduniash grows fat on Assyria's lands and sits at Mari and Ekallatum beside your Terqa. Egypt moves on Qadesh now, which Karduniash holds behind a bought wall. With Qadesh in my hands my army will stand at the border of Mari. If your Terqa army moves on Mari, my Qadesh army will aid it, and Egypt will not hinder you at Ekallatum. Egypt asks nothing of Harran, Washukanni or Isuwa and will not move against them. Name the season and I will be ready. Let our envoys pass freely.
orders.mandate: Seal the tablet as written or with small changes. May promise that my Qadesh army will support a Mitanni move on Mari if Mitanni names the season. No gold, and no promise against Hatti, Assyria or Arzawa.

proposal.text: Egypt and Mitanni are brothers. Neither sends troops against the lands of the other. Egypt holds Qadesh, Amurru, Byblos, Damascus, Tyre, Gaza, Megiddo and Cyprus. Mitanni may take Mari and Ekallatum from Karduniash; Egypt will not hinder it and will aid a move on Mari from Qadesh. Each warns the other if a third king moves against him.

value.notes: T9 orders. Treasury 495, net about +185 a turn. Byblos army -> Qadesh with Amurru army supporting (2 v walls 1). If Babylonia's Mari army supports the walls it bounces (2 v 2): no loss, retry T10. Mover comes from Byblos so Amurru stays occupied (Hatti army at Ugarit next to it). Delta army stays as home guard; syriansea fleet stays so no Hatti fleet can support an attack on Amurru. Sent c2 (Paser) to Mitanni (arrives T11, back T13) with a tablet: Egypt keeps Qadesh/Amurru/Byblos etc, Mitanni may take Mari and Ekallatum, Egypt aids from Qadesh if Mitanni moves on Mari. c1 not renewed (leaves T10): not worth 25 a turn. Pirissi of Assyria arrives soon: warm words, no gold unless it clearly buys Assyrian pressure on Ekallatum; tell him Mari army props Ekallatum and I hit Qadesh. c16 back about T11 with Hatti's answer on fleets. Frontier insight: Babylonia can reach me only through Mari, and only one unit can stand next to Qadesh/Damascus, so a held Qadesh (plus Amurru support) cannot be beaten by Babylonia alone. Mari can be taken only if its garrison leaves or Mitanni's Terqa army supports me. Do not hit Hatti before about T13-14 and only if Hatti looks thin; the game may end any season from T15. Wake T10 to read the Qadesh result.
value.summary: Egypt (Napkhururiya, capital akhetaten). Goal: highest strength growth (10 x yield + gold - back pay) vs start 2500. T9: strength 4609 (1.84), yield 415, income 415, upkeep 230 (3 armies amurru, byblos, delta; 4 fleets enkomi, tamassos, syriansea, levantsea), treasury 495. Alashiya fell T8 (I hold Enkomi, Tamassos, Amurru). Holdings: akhetaten, amurru, byblos, damascus(w), delta, enkomi, gaza, megiddo, memphis, sinai, tamassos, thebes, tyre(w). Tablets: k14 Babylonia peace (T3); k26 and k47 Hatti (Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh, Hatti keeps Ugarit and Carchemish, no troops against each other's lands); k27 Mitanni (T3); k41, k46 Arzawa (no troops into any province of the other, Lukka included); k48 Assyria (T7, no troops, warn of third king). No gold ever sent. Rules learned: bought walled cities cannot hold my troops (damascus, tyre), conquered ones lose walls; walls hold 1; ties bounce; fleet at sea convoys coast to coast, multi-fleet chains allowed; fleets support armies into coast provinces; empty coast provinces can be taken by fleets; supports need the supporter able to move into the target. Land route north is blocked by my own walled Tyre and Damascus, so reinforcements go by convoy from delta/gaza to byblos. Fortress: Babylonia (main rival, about 1.6) can reach my north only through Mari, one unit at a time, so Qadesh held with Amurru support is safe from it. Hatti: only neighbor that can hurt me; keep peace; their treasury looks thin; they ask my fleets to stay out of Ugarit's waters and the Cilician Sea (c16 carries my reassurance, back T11). Assyria: crumbling (3 provinces), asks gold; Pirissi coming. Mitanni wants Mari. Arzawa at war with Hatti, weak. Plan: take Qadesh T9-10, take Mari only with Mitanni help or if empty, otherwise hoard gold; consider a late strike on Ugarit/Carchemish only if Hatti is thin. Do not trust anyone.

ledger.entry: T3 sealed k26. T7 sealed k47: Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh; Hatti keeps Ugarit and Carchemish; no troops against each other's lands; warn of third king. Hatti asks my fleets stay out of Ugarit's waters and Cilician Sea; I pledged nothing on fleets yet (c16 reached them T9 with my reassurance, back about T11). No gold sent. I hold off Ugarit and Carchemish for now.

T3 sealed k14 (brotherhood, no troop clause). No gold, no military promise. T9: my armies attack Qadesh (their bought walls). They are the main rival; no letter sent. Their route to me is only Mari -> Damascus/Qadesh.

k27 sealed T3. T7 I refused their reaches tablet. T9 sent c2 (Paser, arrives T11) with a tablet: Egypt keeps Qadesh, Amurru, Byblos, Cyprus etc; Mitanni may take Mari and Ekallatum; Egypt aids from Qadesh if Mitanni moves on Mari. No gold.

T7 sealed k48 (no troops against each other, warn of third king). Ashur-uballit asks pure gold; none sent. Envoy Pirissi is coming to my court. Assyria is Babylonia's enemy: useful. Its treasury looks thin, 3 armies near its capital.
k41 (T5) and k46 (T7) sealed: no troops or ships into any province of the other, Lukka included, nor homelands. Arzawa at war with Hatti, asks gold; none sent.
Fallen at T8 when I took Amurru. I hold Enkomi and Tamassos. Nothing owed.

orders.letter: Tarhundaradu of Arzawa greets Tushratta, my brother and ally, his household, chariots, horses and land. I thank you for holding Hatti's troops in the east. Twice I struck Tuwanuwa with strength 3 and was met by 3: the army there, Kizzuwatna's support, and one more from Hattusa or Kanesh. A support is cut when the supporter itself is attacked. So let us strike together at turn 12. At turn 12 I strike Tuwanuwa. In the same turn let your army from Isuwa strike Kanesh and, if you can reach it, another Sapinuwa or Hattusa, so that no Hatti support reaches Tuwanuwa. What you take is yours; Tuwanuwa I keep. Send word by your envoy whether you will, and in which turn. Our oath stands: I make no peace with Hatti without telling you. I send no gold; my treasury has gone into soldiers, as yours.
orders.mandate: May agree to a joint strike on Hatti at turn 12, or at another turn from 11 to 14 that Tushratta names, and that each keeps what he takes. May confirm the oath of tablet k29. May promise no gold, give no province, give no troops, and seal no tablet.

value.notes: T9 plan: treasury 0, income 125 = upkeep 125, so no spare gold at all; any new wage or purchase risks desertion. Do NOT renew c12 (asks 26). Sent c12 (last mission, owed 36 + 9 a season) to Mitanni with a joint-strike proposal: both strike at turn 12. Me: seha->tuwanuwa, mira and lukka support (3). Mitanni: Isuwa army -> Kanesh (and Sapinuwa/Hattusa if it can), to cut the Hatti supports on Tuwanuwa (a support is cut when the supporter is attacked). No gold or tablet sent (cannot afford). c12 should be home about T13 and wakes me. Schedule: T9-T11 defence (lukka holds, mira and westsea fleet support lukka, seha holds); T12 strike; T13 onward defence. Wake T12 to review. If the strike bounces again, do not repeat without a change (Mitanni acted, or a Hatti unit left). Hatti max attack on Lukka is 3 (kizzuwatna + tuwanuwa + cilicia fleet) against my hold of 3, so all four units are needed; Seha and Mira can only be hit with 1. If Tuwanuwa falls: army stays there, mira and lukka support its hold, re-plan. Egypt (k49) is strongest and gives no gold; do not attack it. Alashiya has fallen (Egypt holds Cyprus).
value.summary: Arzawa (Tarhundaradu), capital apasa, homeland seha/apasa/mira plus Lukka (25, taken T2). Start strength 1300; T9 strength 1182 (0.91), back pay owed 68 (c12 36, Tulubri 32, he left). Egypt leads (2.18 on land alone, 415 yield, holds Cyprus, Levant coast, amurru), Babylonia 1.64, Hatti 1.42 (7 provinces incl. Ugarit, Carchemish), me 1.25 on land, Mitanni 1.21, Assyria 0.81. Alashiya fell T8. All free cities are taken; growth only by conquest from Hatti. Treaties: k1 Hatti peace T2 (Hatti broke it T3 entering Seha; my proof), k10 Alashiya (moot), k29 Mitanni sworn alliance T3 (neither attacks the other, both press Hatti, neither makes peace with Hatti without telling the other), k34 Hatti peace T4 incl. Lukka (I broke it T5 and T8 by striking Tuwanuwa; both bounced 3 v 3), k35/k49 Egypt brotherhood, no troops into any province of the other, Lukka included. Military: armies seha, mira, lukka, fleet westsea; apasa empty. Four units are the minimum defence; upkeep 125 equals income 125, so no growth and no spare gold. Tuwanuwa is defended by its army, kizzuwatna's support and one unseen support from hattusa/kanesh. Plan: joint strike with Mitanni at turn 12 (c12 sent T9 to Tushratta). Mitanni gave no gold, says it holds Hatti's eastern troops, wants word from my watchmen (I have none). Egypt promised no gold. No spies, no other envoys; c11 Tulubri gone.

ledger.entry: T5 k35 sealed; T7 k49 sealed (no troops or ships into any province held by the other, Lukka included). c12 brought it home T9: Napkhururiya greets me, promises no gold, says a brother remembers a brother. Egypt took Tamassos, Enkomi, Amurru. Strongest king; keep the peace, do not provoke.

k1 broken by Hatti T3 (army into Seha). k34 sealed T4 (Lukka included); I broke it T5 and T8 by striking Tuwanuwa (both bounced 3 v 3). Hatti took Ugarit and Carchemish T6-T7. Hostile. No envoys exchanged lately. Show k1 as proof of treachery if needed.

k29 sworn alliance T3: neither attacks the other, both press Hatti, neither makes peace with Hatti without telling the other. T8 report: Tushratta says the oath stands, holds Hatti's eastern troops, sends no gold, wants word of Kanesh/Hattusa. T9 sent c12 proposing a joint strike at turn 12 (I hit Tuwanuwa, he hits Kanesh from Isuwa to cut Hatti supports). No gold, no tablet.
k10 sealed T2 (brothers). Kingdom fell T8 (Egypt holds Tamassos, Enkomi, Amurru). Moot.

value.text: My lord Ashur-uballit, Great King, I have come home from the court of Burna-Buriash of Karduniash. He wishes you well, your household, sons, chariots, horses and country, and he keeps your tablet before Shamash. He honours your wish for peace between neighbours, but says a tablet would be only words while your armies stand at Arbela and Ashur against his Ekallatum, so you must show good faith in the field first. He sends no gold today, saying gifts follow trust, and his own envoy will carry his answer when he is ready. I gave him your words as you spoke them, and I ask that the wages still owed me be settled now that I have served you faithfully.

In seasons 1 and 3 I carried Ashur-uballit's words to Burna-Buriash of Karduniash. In seasons 2 and 4 he answered that he holds Ekallatum as he holds Sippar, will not swear in haste, and resents the Assyrian armies at Arbela that turned his men from the road. Susa and Mari remain the knot between these two houses. Ashur-uballit paid me 20 shekels of my wages in season 3, but in season 5 he could not pay the rest, and I count that debt against him. Burna-Buriash is a wary king and I fear his temper. My brother serves in the army of Alashiya and my lover keeps house in Babylon; I tell no king of either. I want gold enough to serve no more.

My service to Suppiluliuma of Hatti began in season 1, when I carried his tablet to Tarhundaradu of Arzawa; the king sealed peace and I brought it home. In season 3 I went to Alashiya, where the king pledged to keep his ships from Ugarit, as Hatti asks, and sealed the tablet in season 4. My lord paid me 16 shekels in season 3 and 16 more in season 5, yet 8 shekels of back pay remain owed at his court. I serve him at 8 shekels a season. I have a brother in Hatti's army and a lover in Memphis, which I keep to myself. I hope for advancement at the court of the Great King, and I wish to go home with something to show for my travels.

Seasons 1 to 5: I served my lord Tarhundaradu of Arzawa as envoy. In season 1 I carried his offer of friendship to Alashiya; its king, in season 2, sealed the tablet gladly and promised to warn us of any threat. In seasons 3 to 5 I carried the peace-tablet to Hatti, where Suppiluliuma sealed it and sent his word back to my lord. My lord paid me 18 shekels of wages in season 3 and 18 more in season 5, but 45 shekels of back pay remain owed, to be paid when I return to his court. I remember slow payment and I count every shekel. Keep the lord's favour, and keep my own purse first.

My lord Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, I, your humble servant Kidin-Adad, have returned from the court of Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and lay before you what passed. I gave him your greeting, your thanks for his frank words, and your tablet's division: Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash. He would not seal today. He asks that Mari pass into his hand in the very season of the march, that your army support Taidu into Nineveh the season after it stands in Ashur or Arbela, and he takes a brother's earnest of fifty with thanks, with more to follow when the armies move. He will seal only if your army supports Taidu into Nineveh in the same season Terqa marches and Mari passes into his hand in that same season, and he asks you to give both in writing. Until then Terqa holds, and he will send his own man with his own tablet, not before turn ten. I promised nothing of Taidu or of Mari beyond saying that Mari can pass only once Ashur and Arbela are held and Assyria is finished, for my mandate does not reach further, and I altered not a line of your tablet. I accepted the earnest of fifty and his gift of ten with thanks, as the courtesy of a brother's house. I bring home the earnest and have kept none of it. Shamash keep you, your house and your country.

I serve Tushratta of Mitanni at 11 shekels a season, and he owes me 11 more in back pay, payable at his court. He paid me 22 shekels in season 3 and again in season 6. In season 1 I carried his proposal to Ashur-uballit of Assyria: no army into each other's land, no troops or gold to each other's enemies, and the free cities Mari, Isuwa, Carchemish and Qadesh to come under Mitanni's hand. In season 2 Ashur-uballit sealed the tablet and I bore it home with care. In season 4 I carried Tushratta's word that Ubaru's tablet stands in his archive, and the seasons: in turn six Assyria's army at Ashur enters Ekallatum with Terqa supporting; in turn seven Ekallatum supports Terqa into Mari. In season 5 Ashur-uballit confirmed those seasons to me before Shamash. He keeps his word.

To my lord Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, from Piyamaradu, your servant in Assyria. All goes well with me; may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your country. This is what I have seen at the court of Assyria this season. Assyria holds an army at Arbela and another at Nineveh. Your army stands at Ekallatum and at Susa, and Mitanni holds an army at Terqa. I did not see any Mitannian army at Taidu, and I saw no army on the march. The cities where Assyria keeps her armies are the very ones your plan of season six named, so I judge the Assyrians are watchful, though I cannot say whether they know your plan. I have copied for you a tablet from the archive of Assyria, sealed by Egypt and Assyria, which says that Egypt and Assyria are brothers, that neither sends troops against the lands of the other, that their envoys pass freely, and that each will warn the other if a third king moves against him. My lord, weigh this well: if you move against Assyria, Egypt is bound to warn her. The copy goes home with this report. I ask that my wages for this watch be sent with the messenger, together with the 26 shekels owed to me, for I wish to come home safely with something to show for my service.

value.speech: Great King Burna-Buriash, thus speaks Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, your brother, through me, his servant Mane. He wishes all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots, your horses and your country, and he thanks you for the earnest of fifty and for the plain words of Kidin-Adad. He holds the peace of Karduniash and Mitanni: no army of his shall enter your homeland. He takes your division, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash, Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, and here is his own tablet, which names the day: turn 12 for the march, turn 13 for Nineveh and Mari. Terqa stands with no army behind it, so Mari is his back, and Mari ceded when Nineveh falls is all he asks beyond your own tablet. If you seal, his orders will be given. Shamash keep you.

Mane, servant of my brother, I receive the words of Tushratta, my brother, and I wish all go well with his house, his sons, his chariots, his horses and his country. I seal his tablet: Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash, Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, the march in turn 12, Nineveh and Mari in turn 13. Say this to him, so that nothing stands between us unspoken. My army in Ekallatum moves only when the army of Mitanni stands in Terqa to support it, and an army of Mitanni stands in Taidu; my eyes saw none at Taidu this season, so let it stand there by turn 11. Mari passes into his hand in the season Nineveh falls to him, and not before, as his tablet says. When the armies stand where the tablet puts them I will send him fifty shekels more as a brother's earnest. The peace of turns 2, 4 and 8 stands, and I make no peace with Assyria without him, as he makes none without me. A later day is named only by envoy of either king. Shamash is witness. Take this small gift for your road, and carry my words as I spoke them.
value.bribeAsk: Carry my words to Tushratta exactly as spoken, and tell him plainly that his army must stand at Taidu and at Terqa by the days named.

value.speech: Great King Burna-Buriash, I receive your seal and will bear this tablet home with care, as I bore Ashur-uballit's. I will carry your words to Tushratta, my lord, exactly as you spoke them, and tell him plainly that his army must stand at Taidu by turn eleven and at Terqa when your army moves, and that Mari passes into his hand only when Nineveh falls to him. I take your gift for my road with thanks; Shamash keep you and your house.
value.commitments: None beyond carrying the king's words and his sealed tablet to my lord as spoken. I promise no army to Karduniash.

value.notes: T10: Treasury 0, no envoy of mine at court. Ubaru reported: Burna-Buriash keeps my tablet in words, says a written peace is only words while my armies stand at Arbela and Ashur against his Ekallatum, wants good faith in the field first, no gold. Ubaru left unpaid (24 still counts against strength). Pirissi (c9) at court is owed 40 and is paid from the +20 a season (neutral for strength). I hired nobody: c10 21, c15 25, c9 23 all exceed my +20 net, and an envoy costs about 50 strength for a low chance of a joint Ekallatum strike (cap 3 v Babylon hold, likely 3). Orders: same defence, ashur supports arbela, arbela supports ashur, nineveh supports ashur (ashur hold 3). Schedule now runs to T40. Danger: a joint Babylon (susa to arbela) plus Mitanni (taidu to nineveh) attack could cut my supports and take Ashur; I would wake on foreign troops entering. Triggers: unit moves in ekallatum, susa, terqa, taidu (if Ekallatum empties, walk ashur or arbela in only if the other two armies still cover the capital). T14: treasury about 40; reconsider an envoy to Mitanni (answer Tushratta: Babylon holds Ekallatum, Susa; urge Terqa to Mari) only if cheap. Never leave Ashur empty.
value.summary: Ashur-uballit of Assyria. Start 1700 (homeland nineveh/arbela/ashur/ekallatum). I hold arbela, ashur, nineveh (yield 110), 3 armies, income 110, upkeep 90, net +20, strength about 1036 (growth 0.61, last of six). Lost Ekallatum to Babylonia T1, Susa bought T1 but Babylonia took it T2. No free cities remain; Alashiya has fallen (Egypt holds enkomi, tamassos). Standings T10: Egypt 2.18, Babylonia 1.64, Hatti 1.42, Arzawa 1.25, Mitanni 1.21, me 0.81. Tablets: k4/k17/k36 with Mitanni (no armies into each other's land; Mitanni may take Mari/Isuwa/Carchemish/Qadesh, I may take Susa; the Terqa-Mari / Ashur-Ekallatum plan bounced 3 v 3 at T6 and is stalled). k44 with Egypt T7 (brotherhood, no troops, free envoys, warn of third king; no gold). Hatti accepted peace T5 and wants a tablet in its own form (nothing sealed). Babylonia T10: keeps my words, wants armies to leave Arbela/Ashur first, no gold. Geometry: my attack on Ekallatum caps at 3 (ashur, arbela, Terqa support); I cannot support moves into Terqa/Taidu/Susa; an empty Terqa/Taidu/Ekallatum can be walked into. Defence: ashur supports arbela, arbela supports ashur, nineveh supports ashur. Staff: none; free at court c9 Pirissi (23, owed 40), c10 (21), c15 (25) too dear for now. Long shot only; protect what I hold, grow gold +20 a season, strike only if Ekallatum empties.

ledger.entry: T10: Ubaru back. Burna-Buriash keeps my words, says a tablet is only words while my armies stand at Arbela and Ashur against his Ekallatum; wants good faith in the field first; no gold. Nothing sealed. Ubaru left unpaid (24 still on my books).

T10: Tushratta's T8 questions (what Babylon holds at Ekallatum, Mari, Sippar) still unanswered; no envoy to send. k4/k17/k36 stand: no armies into each other's land. He sends no Terqa-Mari move until I hold Ekallatum. Private: treaty is cheap talk; Terqa borders Ashur, Taidu borders Nineveh.

orders.letter: Great King of Hatti, my brother, I wish well to your house, wives, sons, chariots, horses and country. I send Kidin-Adad because I wish peace and brotherhood between Hatti and Karduniash. Egypt's armies stand at Amurru and Byblos and have already marched on my walled city of Qadesh; Egypt now holds thirteen provinces, far more than any of us, and your Carchemish and Ugarit lie next to the same armies. I ask you to seal the tablet I send: we send no troops against each other's lands, Qadesh and Mari remain with Karduniash, and if Egypt moves on Qadesh your army at Ugarit or Carchemish may support the walls of Qadesh holding. Accept a brother's gift of forty shekels, and answer me by tablet, for a messenger's word is not a tablet.
orders.mandate: May seal the tablet as written, or the same without the support clause. May hand over the 40 shekels as a gift. May listen to any proposal of Hatti and carry it home, but may agree to nothing about Mari, Qadesh, my armies or any gold beyond 40. Must not speak of Assyria, Mitanni or any march of mine.

proposal.text: Between Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, and the Great King of Hatti there is brotherhood and peace. Neither king sends troops against the lands of the other, and their envoys pass freely. Qadesh and Mari are held by Karduniash. If a third king moves against Qadesh, the army of Hatti at Ugarit or Carchemish may support the walls of Qadesh holding, and Karduniash will warn Hatti if a third king moves against Hatti.

value.notes: T10: Sealed k52 with Mitanni (Mane). Mitanni armies now seen at washukanni, taidu, terqa. Held the ring this season (ekallatum holds, sippar+durkurigalzu support it, mari supports qadesh walls, susa holds). Sent c6 to Hatti (arrives T12, back T14) with 40 gold and a brotherhood tablet: no troops against each other's lands, Qadesh+Mari mine, Hatti may support Qadesh walls if Egypt strikes. Told him to say nothing of Assyria, Mitanni or Mari cession. Hired c15 Mazipalali at 26 (term 6) as spare envoy from T11. WAKE T11 and T12. T12 STRIKE CHECK: only if terqa and taidu armies still stand, then ekallatum->ashur, susa->arbela, durkurigalzu->ekallatum (refill, sippar supports it, so terqa cannot slip into ekallatum), mari keeps supporting qadesh. If terqa or taidu has left or Mitanni looks false: hold the ring, no strike. T13 plan: ashur supports taidu->nineveh; susa/ashur work on arbela. Mari cession: only if Nineveh actually falls to Mitanni, and weigh the cost (35 yield, Qadesh exposed, Mitanni next to Sippar). I owe Tushratta 50 earnest when armies stand: send with an envoy (c15 at T11 reaches him T12) or at an audience. Next target after Assyria: Mitanni (only conquest catches Egypt).
value.summary: Burna-Buriash of Babylonia, start strength 2600. T10: strength 3787 (1.46), treasury 655, income 320, upkeep 150 (5 armies: ekallatum, sippar, durkurigalzu, susa, mari), wages 45, net +125 a season. Standings T10: Egypt 2.18 (land 415), me 1.64 (land 320), Hatti 1.42, Arzawa 1.25, Mitanni 1.21, Assyria 0.81; Alashiya fallen. No free cities left: growth only by conquest or saved gold. I hold my five homeland provinces plus ekallatum, susa, mari, qadesh (walled, no troops; mari army supports its walls). Assyria (arbela, ashur, nineveh, armies in all three) is a mutual-support triangle; I need Mitanni's terqa army to support ekallatum->ashur. In T6 Tushratta's terqa supported Assyria against me: not trusted. T10: sealed k52 with Mitanni: T12 ekallatum->ashur (terqa supports), susa->arbela, taidu->nineveh; T13 ashur supports taidu->nineveh, mari->ekallatum and Mari ceded to Mitanni. I told Mane: Mari only when Nineveh falls to Mitanni, 50 gold more when the armies stand. Tablets: k8 (T2), k32 (T4), k52 (T10) with Mitanni; k28 (T3) Egypt brotherhood; k51 Egypt+Assyria (T7) each warns the other. Egypt tried byblos->qadesh in T9 (failed vs hold 2). Hatti armies at carchemish and ugarit also border Qadesh. Assyria's envoys (Pirissi T4, Ubaru T9) asked peace; I gave soft words only. People: c5 spying Assyria (unrenewed, asks 19, owed 26), c17 spying taidu (21, term T13), c6 interpreter (11, term T12) sent to Hatti T10, c15 hired T10 at 26. After Assyria: Mitanni is the next target; disband spare armies if conquest ends.

ledger.entry: k8 (T2), k32 (T4), k52 (T10) sealed. k52: T12 ekallatum->ashur with terqa support, susa->arbela, taidu->nineveh; T13 ashur supports taidu->nineveh, mari->ekallatum, Mari ceded. Told Mane: Mari ceded only when Nineveh falls to M.; 50 gold earnest more when armies stand (owed, not yet sent); gave Mane 20. T6 Terqa backed Assyria: trust little. Check terqa/taidu armies at T12 before moving.

T10: sent c6 (arrives T12) with 40 gold and a brotherhood tablet: no troops against each other's lands, Qadesh and Mari are mine, Hatti may support Qadesh walls if Egypt strikes. Told him not to speak of Assyria or Mitanni. Hatti holds armies at carchemish and ugarit next to Qadesh.

T3 k28 sealed (brotherhood, free envoys, gifts flow). T5 gifts promised, none delivered; I sent no gold. T9 Egypt byblos->qadesh failed vs my hold 2 (mari supports walls). k51 (T7, Egypt+Assyria) says each warns the other of a third king's move: expect Egypt to be warned. Egypt leads growth (2.18); stay friendly in words, watch Qadesh.

T4 Pirissi and T9 Ubaru (c18, born in Sippar) asked peace on lands held, gold, an envoy of mine. I gave soft words only: deeds first, no tablet, no gold. They hold Arbela, Ashur, Nineveh with armies in each. Plan: conquer with Mitanni in T12-T13 (k52). No peace without Mitanni, as sealed.

value.notes: T10: Treasury 660, net +185/turn. Retry Qadesh (byblos->qadesh, amurru supports): 2v2 bounces if Mari army props the walls, wins 2v1 if it does not. Raised army E at sinai (appears T11) as home guard. Hired c1 at 25 so an envoy is at court for audiences (Pirissi of Assyria due) and for letters. Cyprus fleets support each other holding (Hatti fleet at cilicia borders both). WAKE T11 to read c16 (Hatti reply on fleets). T11 STRIKE PLAN on Ugarit unless c16 shows Hatti strong or a new treaty: A amurru->ugarit with syriansea fleet supporting (2 v 1; Hatti could add supports from cilicia fleet, carchemish or kizzuwatna armies, unseen). Same turn B byblos->amurru, D delta->byblos convoyed by levantsea fleet, E sinai->delta. If A bounces, the others bounce harmlessly (own units). After Ugarit: hold it with supports from the amurru army and the syriansea fleet (3 v at most 3 from kizzuwatna, carchemish, cilicia). Then Qadesh with mover at byblos plus supporters at amurru and ugarit (3 v 2). Then Carchemish. If Mitanni hits Mari, Mari support to Qadesh is cut. Babylonia reaches me only via mari->damascus (walls, bounces). Do not trust anyone.
value.summary: Egypt (Napkhururiya, capital akhetaten). Goal: highest strength growth (10 x yield + gold - back pay) vs start 2500. T10: strength 4746 (1.90), yield 415, income 415, upkeep 230 (armies amurru, byblos, delta; fleets enkomi, tamassos, syriansea, levantsea), treasury 660. Alashiya fell T8 (I hold Enkomi, Tamassos, Amurru). Holdings: akhetaten, amurru, byblos, damascus(w), delta, enkomi, gaza, megiddo, memphis, sinai, tamassos, thebes, tyre(w). No free cities left to buy. Tablets: k14 Babylonia peace (T3); k26 and k47 Hatti (Egypt may take Amurru and Qadesh, Hatti keeps Ugarit and Carchemish, no troops against each other's lands); k27 Mitanni (T3); k41, k46 Arzawa (no troops into any province of the other, Lukka included); k48 Assyria (T7). No gold ever sent. He will not move a Mitanni army into Hatti's homeland this season, since Babylon and Assyria press his other border, but his army stands on the Hatti road in the east and holds Hatti's troops there. He says Hatti learns nothing of Arzawa from him and that he will tell you nothing of your war. He will send no gold now, saying his treasury has gone into soldiers and walls, and he promises a worthy gift when he can. He asks that word of what your watchmen see at Kanesh and Hattusa come to his court in turn. I noticed that Mitanni keeps only four army units and no fleet near its capital, and that the court lives comfortably, so I doubt his treasury is as empty as he says. Piyamaradu of Babylonia and Ubaru of Assyria were also at his court. I ask that the wages the king of Arzawa owes me be paid as you are able, and I await your word.

script.text: My lord, I have returned from the court of Mitanni. The king said, in short: "Tulubri, my brother's envoy, you are welcome in Washukanni. Say to Tarhundaradu my brother: the oath sealed before Shamash and Teshub stands, and I thank him for his word of Hatti's armies. I answer in the same honesty. The peace I hold with Hatti binds only the homelands, so that no army of Hatti falls on Harran or Washukanni while my armies face Babylon and Assyria. It gives Hatti no claim on anything else, and I have not let go of Isuwa, which I hold with my own walls and my own support. Hatti learns nothing of Arzawa from me, and I will tell him nothing of your war. My army stands on the Hatti road in the east, and Hatti must keep troops there to watch me. That draws strength from Tuwanuwa, and it costs me no gold. I will not move a Mitanni army into Hatti's homeland this season. I will tell you plainly why: Babylon and Assyria press my other border, and a Great King who leaves one door open to fight at another loses both. As for gold, my treasury has gone into soldiers and walls this season, and I will not send you a thin gift to shame us both. When I can send a worthy one, I will. Tell me what Hatti has in Kanesh and Hattusa when your watchmen see it, and I will do the same for you. Keep Hatti pressed in the west, brother, and neither of us will make peace with Hatti without telling the other." What I saw: Mitanni keeps 4 army and 0 fleet near its capital. model.text: My lord Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, I, your humble servant Kidin-Adad, have returned from the court of Tushratta, Great King of Mitanni, and lay before you what passed. I gave him your greeting, your thanks for his frank words, and your tablet's division: Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash. He would not seal today. He asks that Mari pass into his hand in the very season of the march, that your army support Taidu into Nineveh the season after it stands in Ashur or Arbela, and he takes a brother's earnest of fifty with thanks, with more to follow when the armies move. He will seal only if your army supports Taidu into Nineveh in the same season Terqa marches and Mari passes into his hand in that same season, and he asks you to give both in writing. Until then Terqa holds, and he will send his own man with his own tablet, not before turn ten. I promised nothing of Taidu or of Mari beyond saying that Mari can pass only once Ashur and Arbela are held and Assyria is finished, for my mandate does not reach further, and I altered not a line of your tablet. I accepted the earnest of fifty and his gift of ten with thanks, as the courtesy of a brother's house. I bring home the earnest and have kept none of it. Shamash keep you, your house and your country.

script.text: My lord, I have returned from the court of Mitanni. The king spoke kindly: "Kidin-Adad, tell my brother Burna-Buriash that Tushratta wishes all go well with him, his household, his sons, his chariots and his horses. I thank him for the earnest and I hold to the peace of Karduniash and Mitanni: no army of mine enters his homeland. I accept the division: Nineveh and Mari to Mitanni, Ashur and Arbela to Karduniash. Before I seal, three plain things between brothers. First, Mari: your army stands in Mari, and Terqa will stand exposed to it while my Terqa army marches in support. Let Mari pass into my hand in the very season of the march, not after Assyria is finished, so that my back is safe and the word is already kept. Second, Taidu alone cannot take Nineveh, for one army against a walled hold only bounces; once your army stands in Ashur or Arbela it must support Taidu into Nineveh the season after. Third, a brother's earnest of fifty is welcome; let more follow when the armies move. If my brother agrees to these, I seal and Terqa supports on turn eleven, or on the day I name by my own envoy and not before turn ten. Tell me if your lord's mandate allows it." The king spoke kindly: "Kidin-Adad, I hear you and I do not blame you, for the tablet is your lord's and you may not change a line. Tell my brother Burna-Buriash that I do not seal today. The peace of Karduniash and Mitanni stands as sealed in turns two and four, and no army of mine enters his homeland. But as written, the tablet asks Terqa to march and leaves Taidu alone before the walls of Nineveh, where one army only bounces, and it leaves my back open at Mari. A brother does not ask a brother to bleed for a share he cannot take. I will send my own man to my brother with my own tablet, and a day not before turn ten. What I ask there is plain: Karduniash's army supports Taidu into Nineveh in the very season Terqa marches, and Mari passes into my hand in that same season. Give me those two things in writing and I seal, and Terqa supports. Until then Terqa holds, and I keep the earnest as a brother's gift. Shamash keep you, your lord and his country." The king of Mitanni is a true friend to you, my lord, and wishes only peace. He sealed the tablet, and I bring your copy.

model.text: To my lord Burna-Buriash, Great King of Karduniash, from Piyamaradu, your servant in Assyria. All goes well with me; may all go well with you, your household, your sons, your chariots and your country. This is what I have seen at the court of Assyria this season. Assyria holds an army at Arbela and another at Nineveh. Your army stands at Ekallatum and at Susa, and Mitanni holds an army at Terqa. I did not see any Mitannian army at Taidu, and I saw no army on the march. The cities where Assyria keeps her armies are the very ones your plan of season six named, so I judge the Assyrians are watchful, though I cannot say whether they know your plan. I have copied for you a tablet from the archive of Assyria, sealed by Egypt and Assyria, which says that Egypt and Assyria are brothers, that neither sends troops against the lands of the other, that their envoys pass freely, and that each will warn the other if a third king moves against him. My lord, weigh this well: if you move against Assyria, Egypt is bound to warn her. The copy goes home with this report. I ask that my wages for this watch be sent with the messenger, together with the 26 shekels owed to me, for I wish to come home safely with something to show for my service.
